Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Supply Convoy and Escape
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁补给车队并撤离
前往撤离区
侦察车队路线
阻止车队逃脱

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All right, Commander, our goal is to track down the convoy...
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好的，指挥官，我们的目标是追踪车队...
开始行动吧，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One down. Keep engaging those threats and we'll be out of here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 解决一个。继续对付那些威胁，我们就能离开这里了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The convoy is finished, now get what 'mechs you have to the extraction point and we'll pull you out. Move quickly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车队完了，现在带你手头有多少机甲撤到撤离点，我们把你接出去。动作快点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The guard units are dealt with; a wise move.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 守卫部队已经解决; 明智之举.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Then we make our way to the evac zone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 然后我们开出通往撤离区的路.
后院烧烤

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for destroying the convoy units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁车队单位的任务目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Clever smugglers, hiding in plain sight. Now that their cover's blown, they're likely to call for military backup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这些走私者很聪明，藏在大庭广众之下。既然他们的伪装已经暴露，他们很可能会呼叫军事支援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We maintain a very accurate registry of all military convoys on this planet. Recently, an analyst spotted something odd: a convoy that wasn't accounted for anywhere in our records. It's been regularly traveling along one of our standard logistical routes, and using our logistical comms, which is how it evaded detection for so long. Our signals intercepts tell us they're {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} drivers, so we have to assume they're smuggling right in our own backyard. We don't want to spook them with our own military comm chatter; we need an independent force to intercept and destroy them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们对该星球上所有军事车队都保有极为准确的登记。最近，一名分析员发现了异常：一支在任何记录中都不存在的车队。它一直规律地沿我们的一条标准后勤路线行进，并使用我们的后勤通讯——这正是它长期未被发现的缘故。我们的信号截获显示机师是{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}人，因此我们必须假定他们就在我们自家后院走私。我们不想用自己的军用通讯去打草惊蛇；我们需要一支独立力量去拦截并摧毁他们。
雇主的盟友

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 根据这些勘测图，从这个位置你应该能看到车队的路线。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enemy Reinforcements, get ready for contact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌方增援，准备接敌。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One down. Keep engaging those threats and we'll be out of here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 解决一个。继续对付那些威胁，我们就能离开这里了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Only if we take out that convoy, Meyer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 除非我们干掉了那支车队，梅耶尔.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Seems like our employers may have a leak.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 似乎我们的雇主有内鬼.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's got it, keep firing on those targets until they are neutralized.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打中了，继续向那些目标开火直到它们被消灭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The convoy is finished, now get what mechs you have to the extraction point and we'll pull you out. Move quickly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车队完了，现在带你手头有多少机甲撤到撤离点，我们把你接出去。动作快点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This contract turned out to be slightly more exciting than we were led to believe.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这份合约已证明比我们受引导而相信的那样还要刺激一点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a lock on the target vehicles. They should be to your front. Engage and destory, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已锁定目标车辆。他们应该在你正前方。交战并摧毁，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 是的. 这明显是个陷阱，我们的雇主要我们掉进去. 指挥官，在我联系我们的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}联络人的时候清理那支车队.
秘密补给

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Send a message by not only destroy the convoy, but eliminate their escorts as well.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传递一个信号：不仅摧毁车队，还要消灭他们的护卫。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The ENEMYFACTION scum are trying to get from one place to another. Kill them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: ENEMYFACTION 那些渣滓正试图从一处转移到另一处。干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employers don't really have any more legitimate a claim to this system than anyone else, but they do have the money to hire us, which is a solid argument for ownership.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主对这个星系的主权主张其实并不比其他人更正当，但他们有钱雇佣我们，而这本身就是所有权的一个有力论据。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A routine orbital survey of {TGT_SYSTEM.name} picked up coded transmissions from the surface. Our intelligence experts believe these transmissions come from a well-hidden {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility in this supposedly uninhabited system. Needless to say, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} is not willing to tolerate secret military bases in this region. We need a mercenary company to intercept one of the supply caravans traveling to the secret base. Even if we can't find their facility, we can still starve them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的一次例行轨道勘测接收到了来自地表的加密传输。我们的情报专家认为这些信号来自这个据称无人居住的星系中一处隐蔽的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}设施。不用说，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}不会容忍本区域存在秘密军事基地。我们需要一家雇佣兵公司拦截前往该秘密基地的补给车队。即便找不到他们的设施，我们也能把他们饿死。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The convoy's almost escaped, Commander. You need to step it up or we're going to miss the window of opportunity.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车队快要逃脱了，指挥官。你得加快节奏，否则我们就要错过这次机会了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Then proceed to the evac point for pickup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 然后前往撤离点等待接应.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a lock on the target vehicles. They should be to your front. Engage and destroy, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已锁定目标车辆。他们应该在你正前方。交战并摧毁，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Well done, Commander. Drinks are on me.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 做得不错，指挥官. 我请喝酒.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're tracking multiple units, Commander. That has to be our target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们跟踪到多个单位，指挥官。那一定是我们的目标。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们跟踪到多个单位，指挥官。那一定是我们的目标。
拦截游击队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, this smells political, and that makes me nervous. I suggest we go in, take care of the convoy, and get out again - without asking too many questions. There's a bonus if we clean up all the enemy forces, but that's at your discretion.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这事透着政治的味道，让我很不安。我建议我们进去，解决掉那支车队，然后立刻撤出来——不要多问问题。如果把敌军全部清理干净还有一笔奖金，不过是否动手由你决定。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Guerrilla strikes against our facilities have increased, and our intel says {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} is bankrolling the guerrillas and providing logistical support in the form of small arms, explosives, and medical supplies. We need you to intercept the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} supply convoy and destroy it before it reaches the guerrilla forces.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 游击队针对我们设施的袭击越来越多了，根据我们的情报来看，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}正在资助游击队，以轻武器、炸药和医疗用品的形式提供后勤支援. 我们需要你拦截{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的补给车队，并且在它抵达游击队之前就消灭它.
雇主的盟友

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭游击队车队并摆脱敌人
消灭游击队的补给车队
前往撤离区
拦截补给车队
阻止车队逃脱

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enemy Reinforcements, get ready for contact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌方增援，准备接敌。
祝你好运，指挥官。奥利韦拉通话结束。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One down. Keep engaging those threats and we'll be out of here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 解决一个。继续对付那些威胁，我们就能离开这里了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's got it, keep firing on those targets until they are neutralized.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打中了，继续向那些目标开火直到它们被消灭。
那支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}车队来了，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The convoy is finished, now get what mechs you have to the extraction point and we'll pull you out. Move quickly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车队完了，现在带你手头有多少机甲撤到撤离点，我们把你接出去。动作快点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a lock on the target vehicles. They should be to your front. Engage and destroy, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已锁定目标车辆。他们应该在你正前方。交战并摧毁，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Well done, Commander. Let's debrief back in orbit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得好，指挥官。我们回轨道上做简报吧。
敌意收购

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} convoy carries critical minerals that need to destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}车队运载着必须被摧毁的关键矿物。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, this should be a pretty simple smash and run job. I expect {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} would do it themselves, but don't want to be blamed for the destruction of the goods. That's in our wheelhouse.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这应该是一份相当简单的打了就跑的活。我估计{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}愿意自己干，但不想为货物的毁坏担责。那正合我们的本事。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} convoy regularly transports rare minerals through the region. Our agents have acquired the convoy's travel plans so that you can ambush the convoy. We do not require that you recover the minerals. We just want to keep them out of the enemy's hands.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}车队定期通过该地区运输稀有矿物。我们的特工已取得车队的行程计划，好让你伏击这支车队。我们不要求你回收那些矿物。我们只想让它们不落入敌手。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's got it, keep firing on those targets until they are neutralized.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打中了，继续向那些目标开火直到它们被消灭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} escorts are out of commission, Commander. Our employers will be pleased with the extra carnage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}护卫已经废了，指挥官. 我们的雇主会很满意这场额外的杀戮.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The convoy is finished, now get what 'mechs you have to the extraction point and we'll pull you out. Move quickly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车队完了，现在带你手头有多少机甲撤到撤离点，我们把你接出去。动作快点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The material has been destroyed and our job here is done. Solid work, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 材料已销毁，我们这里的任务完成了. 干得漂亮，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Then we extract at our designated evac zone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 然后我们在我们指定的撤离区域撤离.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: To intercept the convoy we'll need to identify their route.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 要拦截车队，我们需要先确认他们的路线。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a lock on the target vehicles. They should be to your front. Engage and destroy, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已锁定目标车辆。他们应该在你正前方。交战并摧毁，指挥官。
拦截撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Send a message by not only destroy the convoy, but eliminate their escorts as well.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传递一个信号：不仅摧毁车队，还要消灭他们的护卫。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The ENEMYFACTION scum are trying to get from one place to another. Kill them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: ENEMYFACTION 那些渣滓正试图从一处转移到另一处。干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Guess the surveillance picked up something sensitive that {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} would prefer stay a secret.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我猜这次监视发现了一些敏感的东西，而{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}更希望这些信息保持机密.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a report that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has been operating a hidden surveillance base somewhere on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. Unfortunately, they intercepted our spies' reports and have evacuated the base, torching everything useful. We'd like to prevent any of the data they've collected from leaving the planet. We've been able to identify their likely evacuation route, and we need you to intercept their evac convoy and destroy it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们收到报告，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}某处运营着一座隐蔽监视基地。不幸的是，他们截获了我们间谍的报告，已撤离基地并烧毁了所有有用的东西。我们希望阻止他们收集到的任何数据离开这颗行星。我们已确认他们可能的撤离路线，需要你拦截他们的撤离车队并将其摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escorts are down, Commander. That leaves the field wide open, press our advantage.

这结果令人失望，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打中了，继续向那些目标开火直到它们被消灭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The convoy is finished, now get what mechs you have to the extraction point and we'll pull you out. Move quickly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车队完了，现在带你手头有多少机甲撤到撤离点，我们把你接出去。动作快点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Then proceed to the evac point for pickup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 然后前往撤离点等待接应.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This should be a turkey shoot. Move up, make contact, and take the convoy out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这应该就是一场猎杀火鸡一样简单的任务. 行动起来进行接触，然后消灭车队.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a lock on the target vehicles. They should be to your front. Engage and destroy, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已锁定目标车辆。他们应该在你正前方。交战并摧毁，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've got a signal from the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} spotters, Commander. Convoy is incoming.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们收到{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}观测员的信号，指挥官。车队正在驶来。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} convoy is trying to deliver contraband to a hostile faction. Destroy it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一支 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 车队正试图向敌对势力运送违禁品。摧毁它。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: These are going to be lightly armored targets, Commander. The real challenge will be keeping them from making a run for it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这些都是轻装甲目标，指挥官. 真正的挑战是阻止他们逃跑.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're tracking {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} supply convoys that have been delivering weapons and explosives to a self-appointed warlord here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. In return, his fighters have been wreaking havoc on {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} facilities in the region. We need you to interdict the convoy and destroy it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们正在追踪{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的补给运输队，它们一直在向{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的一个自封军阀运送武器和炸药。作为回报，他的战士一直在破坏该地区的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}设施。我们需要你拦截并摧毁这支运输队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we need to stop those weapon convoys.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们得阻止那些武器车队.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车队的护卫完了，指挥官! 干得漂亮.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The convoy is down and our job here is done. Nice work, Commander - you made that look easy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车队完了，我们这儿的活完成了. 干得好，指挥官--你让它看起来很容易.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The convoy is finished, now get what 'mechs you have to the extraction point and we'll pull you out. Move quickly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车队完了，现在带你手头有多少机甲撤到撤离点，我们把你接出去。动作快点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a lock on the target vehicles. They should be to your front. Engage and destroy, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已锁定目标车辆。他们应该在你正前方。交战并摧毁，指挥官。
最后的机会

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Send a message by not only destroy the convoy, but eliminate their escorts as well.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传递一个信号：不仅摧毁车队，还要消灭他们的护卫。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The ENEMYFACTION scum are trying to get from one place to another. Kill them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: ENEMYFACTION 那些渣滓正试图从一处转移到另一处。干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: 'No atomic weapons' is one of the few rules of warfare we've all agreed on. Let's take these guys out, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: '不使用原子武器'是我们都认同的少数战争规则之一。让我们把这些人解决掉，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Seismic disturbances picked up by one of our recon units on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} suggest that someone is conducting underground nuclear tests on this supposedly abandoned world. We believe the culprits are operating out of a secret {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} manufacturing facility, and we've picked up transmissions indicating they intend to move their newly developed weapons to a hidden spaceport and then transport them off-world. Needless to say, this isn't an acceptable outcome for {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的一个侦察单位在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上探测到的地震扰动表明，有人在这个据称已被废弃的世界上进行地下核试验。我们相信肇事者正以一处秘密的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}制造设施为基地，而我们截获的通讯显示，他们打算把新研发的武器运到一处隐蔽太空港，然后运出行星。不用说，这对{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}来说不是可接受的结果。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've picked up vehicle sounds, Commander; this is it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们捕捉到车辆的声音；就是这里。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: What a disaster. I just hope those nukes get intercepted elsewhere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 真是一场灾难. 我只希望这些核武器能在别处被截住.
后勤崩溃

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Send a message by not only destroy the convoy, but eliminate their escorts as well.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传递一个信号：不仅摧毁车队，还要消灭他们的护卫。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The ENEMYFACTION scum are trying to get from one place to another. Kill them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: ENEMYFACTION 那些渣滓正试图从一处转移到另一处。干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: When I hear 'unknown number of military units', I get nervous. This could be tough, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一听到"数量不明的军事单位"，我就紧张。这会很难打，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're tracking a regular {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} logistical convoy through this area, and believe the convoy is carrying critical supplies for an unknown number of military units. We'd like you to destroy the convoy and any supplies it might be hauling. We have no information on what defenses the convoy is likely to have, so assume at least one lance escorting. If so, there is a bonus in it for you if you eliminate that escort lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们正在追踪一支定期经过此区域的 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 后勤车队，并认为该车队正为数量不明的军事单位运送关键补给。我们希望你能摧毁这支车队及其可能运载的任何补给。我们不清楚车队可能配备何种防御力量，因此请假定至少有一个小队护航。若如此，消灭那支护航小队还能为你带来一笔奖金。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: When I hear 'unknown number of military units', I get nervous. This could be tough, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一听到"数量不明的军事单位"，我就紧张。这会很难打，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're tracking a regular {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} logistical convoy through this area, and believe the convoy is carrying critical supplies for an unknown number of military units. We'd like you to destroy the convoy and any supplies it might be hauling. We have no information on what defenses the convoy is likely to have, so assume at least one lance escorting. If so, there is a bonus in it for you if you eliminate that escort lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们正在追踪一支定期经过此区域的 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 后勤车队，并认为该车队正为数量不明的军事单位运送关键补给。我们希望你能摧毁这支车队及其可能运载的任何补给。我们不清楚车队可能配备何种防御力量，因此请假定至少有一个小队护航。若如此，消灭那支护航小队还能为你带来一笔奖金。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've become aware of a convoy transporting supplies to a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility. We'd like those supplies to become 'lost', if you take my meaning. We will provide the coordinates to locate the shipment, and handle any cleanup after the convoy 'goes astray'.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This job seems sketchy, Commander. I suppose that's not a surprise, given the employer, but we should still be cautious.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这活看起来不太干净，指挥官。考虑到雇主，我一点也不意外，但我们还是该谨慎。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Every month, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} sends out another supply convoy loaded with military hardware and valuable electronics. They guard it heavily, so we're not asking you to hit the main force; no sense in throwing away good mercenaries. Instead we want you to pick off the tail end of the convoy. The cargo isn't as valuable as what they send out in the vanguard, but it won't be as heavily defended. Take the convoy out, and we'll send in our people to grab whatever's still intact. We don't really want to get shot at, so we'll pay a bonus if you take out all the defenders, as well.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 每个月，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}都会派出一支满载军用硬件与贵重电子设备的补给车队。他们守卫严密，所以我们不是要你去打主力；没必要白白牺牲好雇佣兵。我们要你去打散车队的尾部。那里的货物不如先头部队运的值钱，但防守也不会那么严密。把车队干掉，我们会派人去收取任何还完好的东西。我们可不想挨枪子，所以如果你把守军全清掉，我们也会额外支付奖金。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Well done, Commander. Let's debrief back in orbit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得好，指挥官。我们回轨道上做简报吧。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're getting word that the main convoy has passed by already, leaving just the trailing elements. Time to make our move.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们收到消息，主车队已经过去了，只剩下尾部单位。该我们动手了。
武器运输队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Obviously, our friends would prefer to salvage the lostech themselves, requiring us to clear out any defending forces. Thus, they're paying more if we clear out the defenders.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 显然我们的朋友更愿意亲自回收这些失传科技，因此需要我们清掉任何防守部队。所以，如果我们清掉守军，他们会付更多钱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: There's a very interesting {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} convoy scheduled to cross through a relatively uninhabited area of {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. We believe the convoy is a shipment of weapons, including at least one intact Star League era weapon system. That could be an enormous payday for us. We want you to blow that convoy apart, and we'll pick through the remains.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 有一支非常有意思的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}车队预定要穿过{TGT_SYSTEM.name}一片相对无人居住的地区。我们相信这支车队运的是武器，其中至少有一套完好的星盟时代武器系统。那可能是我们的一大笔进账。我们要你把这支车队轰碎，然后我们来翻捡残骸。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is exactly the kind of morally ambiguous job that makes me uncomfortable working with pirates, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这正是那种道德上模棱两可的任务，我对与海盗合作感到不安，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Somehow we've let {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} get their hands on one of our less reliable suppliers. It only took them a few days to break her, and now she's ready to spill all kinds of secrets in court. That isn't in our best interests, and since you're talking to us, it's not in yours, either. We'd like to do a little bit of witness tampering, of the fatal variety. She's being transported to a secure facility by ground vehicle. We don't know which vehicle she'll be in, so just take them all out. If you help us send a message by wiping out all the escorts, there's a bonus in it for you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 不知怎么的，我们让{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}抓到了我们一个不太可靠的供应商。他们只用了几天就撬开了她，如今她准备在法庭上倾泻各种秘密。这不符合我们的利益；既然你在跟我们谈，也不符合你的利益。我们想做一点证人干扰——致命的那种。她正由地面车辆押送往一处安全设施。我们不知道她会在哪辆车里，所以把他们都清掉。如果你能连同全部护航一起清除、给我们传个信号，还有一笔奖金。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is exactly the kind of morally ambiguous job that makes me uncomfortable working with pirates, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这正是那种道德上模棱两可的任务，我对与海盗合作感到不安，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Somehow we've let {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} get their hands on one of our less reliable suppliers. It only took them a few days to break her, and now she's ready to spill all kinds of secrets in court. That isn't in our best interests, and since you're talking to us, it's not in yours, either. We'd like to demonstrate what happens to those who snitch. She's being transported to a secure facility by ground vehicle. We don't know which vehicle she'll be in, so just take them all out. If you help us send a message by wiping out all the escorts, there's a bonus in it for you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 不知怎么的，我们让{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}抓到了我们一个不太可靠的供应商。他们只用了几天就撬开了她，现在她准备在法庭上抖出各种秘密。这不符合我们的利益，而既然你在跟我们谈，也不符合你的利益。我们想演示一下告密者的下场。她正被地面车辆送往一处安全设施。我们不知道她在哪辆车里，所以把它们全部干掉。如果你帮我们把所有护卫都消灭以传递信息，另有奖金给你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for destroying the convoy units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁车队单位的任务目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: There aren't many solo operators in this region who I'd describe as 'highly skilled'. I wonder if it's anyone we know?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一带单打独斗的人里，我很少会形容为"技艺高超"的。我在想会不会是我们认识的人？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: There's a convoy of military weaponry being transported in the open on the planet's surface. Normally we'd simply handle it ourselves, but {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} leadership has caught wind of our presence and hired a highly-skilled professional mercenary to cover the convoy's route and intercept any attackers. Being highly-skilled professionals yourselves, we thought perhaps you could pay a visit to this hired gun -- and destroy the convoy while you're at it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 有一支军用武器车队正在行星地表公开运输。通常我们会自己处理，但{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}领导层已察觉到我们的存在，并雇了一名技艺高超的专业雇佣兵来掩护车队路线、拦截任何袭击者。既然你们自己也是技艺高超的专业人士，我们想也许你可以去拜访一下这名雇佣枪手——顺便把车队摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，本地网络上全是关于这场听证会的消息。这份活儿比我们平常干的活更引人注目。不过由你决定；如果我们不接，另一家雇佣兵公司会接。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A friend of our organization has been accused by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} of illegal activities. While under this accusation, she's unable to perform her duties for {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} leadership. Evidence to be used in an upcoming hearing is being transported to a spaceport, for safe-keeping off-planet. Your team is to intercept this convoy and destroy it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们组织的一位朋友被{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}指控从事非法活动。在这项指控之下，她无法为{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}领导层履行职责。将在即将到来的听证会上使用的证据正被运往一处太空港，以便在行星外妥善保管。你的小队要拦截这支车队并将其摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} convoy was ambushed and looted for expensive industrial materials, and the perpetrators, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, are moving the stolen goods to a secure location. We'd like you to strike the convoy and destroy it; our salvage teams will then retrieve our goods from the wreckage.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果这批货值钱到能雇我们来偷，那它的防守一定极其严密。做好准备，指挥官。

Stage an ambush of the convoy, destroy the vehicles, and we'll send in a recovery team to gather the cargo. There's a bonus if you secure the area and eliminate all the convoy guards.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Send a message by not only destroy the convoy, but eliminate their escorts as well.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传递一个信号：不仅摧毁车队，还要消灭他们的护卫。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The ENEMYFACTION scum are trying to get from one place to another. Kill them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: ENEMYFACTION 那些渣滓正试图从一处转移到另一处。干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If this cargo is valuable enough to pay us to steal it, it's going to be extremely well-defended. Be prepared, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果这批货值钱到能雇我们来偷，那它的防守一定极其严密。做好准备，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A team of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} agents has obtained the schedule and manifest of a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} convoy. This convoy's cargo is extremely valuable technological components. We want you to steal them for us. Stage an ambush of the convoy, destroy the vehicles, and we'll send in a recovery team to gather the cargo. There's a bonus if you secure the area and eliminate all the convoy guards.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一支{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}特工小队已获取了一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}运输队的行程与货单。这支运输队的货物是极其珍贵的技术部件。我们要你替我们把它偷回来。设伏袭击运输队，摧毁车辆，我们会派回收小组去收取货物。如果你能控制该区域并消灭所有运输队护卫，还有额外奖金。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for destroying the convoy units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁车队单位的任务目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Don't underestimate the Schrek, Commander. It's tough as hell and carries three PPCs, and has the heat capacity to fire them non-stop.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 别低估士莱克，指挥官。它硬得不像话，装有三门粒子炮，并有足够的散热能力持续开火。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our sources on the planet have alerted us to a convoy of vehicles being transferred to an otherwise undefended military base. If we act quickly, we can destroy that convoy before it has a chance to reinforce the base. Normally we wouldn't be concerned about a simple vehicle convoy, but {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} intelligence operatives report that one of the vehicles is a fully operational Schrek PPC carrier. That's not a threat we can afford to ignore. We need you to eliminate that convoy before they make it to their base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们在行星上的情报来源提醒我们，一支车辆车队正被转移到一处原本无人防守的军事基地。若我们行动迅速，就能在车队有机会增援基地之前将其摧毁。通常我们不会在意一支简单的车辆车队，但{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}情报人员报告说，其中一辆是完全可用的施雷克PPC车辆。那是我们不能忽视的威胁。我们需要你在他们抵达基地之前消灭那支车队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, this smells political, and that makes me nervous. I suggest we go in, take care of the convoy, and get out again, without too many questions. There's a bonus from {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} if we clean up all the enemy forces, but that's up to you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这事有政治味道，而让我紧张。我建议我们进去，处理掉车队，然后撤出来，别问太多问题。如果我们把敌军全清掉，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}会额外付奖金，但那由你决定。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Terrorist strikes against our facilities have increased, and our intel says {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} is bankrolling the terrorists and providing logistical support in the form of small arms, explosives, and medical supplies. We need you to intercept the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} supply convoy and destroy it before it reaches the terrorists.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 恐怖分子针对我们设施的袭击越来越多了，根据我们的情报来看，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}正在资助恐怖分子，以轻武器、炸药和医疗用品的形式提供后勤支援. 我们需要你拦截{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的补给车队，并且在它抵达恐怖分子之前就消灭它.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It's a solid plan, Commander, as long as they're right about the light defenses.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是个稳妥的计划，指挥官，只要他们关于防御薄弱的情报没错。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} control of this world is nearly absolute. We've identified a point of vulnerability, however: they move supplies and weapons by convoy, and those convoys are lightly defended by a single lance of 'Mechs. If we destroy enough of their supply convoys, their other operations will be weakened enough for our forces to move in and take advantage of their fragility. We don't want to tip our hand, however, so we'd like you to engage in a little guerilla warfare on our behalf.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}对这颗星球的控制几乎固若金汤。不过，我们找到了一个可乘之机：他们的补给与武器都靠运输车队运送，而护卫车队的只有一支机甲小队，防御薄弱。只要摧毁足够多的补给车队，他们的其他行动就会被削弱到足以让我方部队趁虚而入、利用其脆弱局面的程度。不过，我们不想过早暴露意图，所以希望你能替我们打一场小小的游击战。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}显然更愿意亲自回收这些失传科技，因此需要我们清除任何防守部队。所以，如果我们清掉守军，他们会付更多钱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We need to make a deniable strike on a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} convoy. Intel shows the convoy is a shipment of weapons, including at least one intact Star League era weapon system. That level of technology could shift the balance of power in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} - something {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} leadership isn't willing to tolerate.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们需要对一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}车队进行一次可否认的打击。情报显示该车队运的是武器，其中至少有一套完好的星盟时代武器系统。那种技术水平可能改变{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的力量平衡——这是{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}领导层不愿容忍的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's got it, keep firing on those targets until they are neutralized.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打中了，继续向那些目标开火直到它们被消灭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The convoy is finished, now get what mechs you have to the extraction point and we'll pull you out. Move quickly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 车队完了，现在带你手头有多少机甲撤到撤离点，我们把你接出去。动作快点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a lock on the target vehicles. They should be to your front. Engage and destroy, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已锁定目标车辆。他们应该在你正前方。交战并摧毁，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've picked up the convoy, right on schedule.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们按计划接上了车队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: What a mess. Aborting mission, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 真是一团糟. 放弃任务，指挥官.
炼狱发射架
未设置
杨氏火炮

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Argo's drive is only operating at a fraction of its potential, Commander. With some time and materials, I believe I can boost the output of the secondary fusion reactors - to put it simply, I'll make the Argo go faster.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿戈号的推进器只发挥了其潜力的一小部分，指挥官。给我一些时间和材料，我相信我能提升次级聚变反应堆的输出——简单说，我会让阿戈号跑得更快。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Argo's drive was enough to get it off the surface of a low-gravity moon, but much of the supporting infrastructure was damaged in the escape, and running the drive at full power requires extensive repairs. Once the repairs are complete, the drive can generate 1.5 g of thrust.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿戈号的推进器足以让它脱离一颗低重力卫星的地表，但逃生时大量配套基础设施受损，要以全功率运转推进器需要大规模维修。维修完成后，推进器能产生1.5G推力。
修复驱动器

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Argo's drive is far more powerful than I suspected. We may not ever bring it completely back online, but for now I can increase our thrust. While 2 g is not comfortable and the crew will complain, we'll cut our travel times significantly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿戈号的推进器远比我猜想的强大。我们或许永远无法让它完全重新上线，但目前我可以提高我们的推力。虽然2G并不舒适，船员也会有怨言，但我们的航行时间将大幅缩短。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Argo can, in a pinch, generate quite a bit more thrust than it first seemed. By repairing a number of drive subsystems meant to increase thrust efficiency, it’s possible to get the Argo up to an uncomfortable 2 g of sustained thrust.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔戈在紧急情况下能产生的推力比最初看起来要多不少。通过修复若干旨在提升推力效率的驱动子系统，可以让阿尔戈维持一段难受的2G持续推力。
升级驱动器

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Argo's drive is far more powerful than I suspected. We may not ever bring it completely back online, but for now I can increase our thrust. While 3 g is not comfortable and the crew will complain, we'll cut our travel times significantly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿戈号的推进器远比我猜想的强大。我们或许永远无法让它完全重新上线，但目前我可以提高我们的推力。虽然3G并不舒适，船员也会有怨言，但我们的航行时间将大幅缩短。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Argo's drive can be upgraded to allow for a severe High-G burn, but it's gonna be a strain on the System and Structure, and your budget.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔戈的驱动器可升级以支持剧烈的高G燃烧，但这会对系统与结构造成负担，也会给你的预算造成压力。
高G过载驱动升级

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Finally I would be able see where to land in advance! No more accidentally landing in a swamp because Darius sent us to the wrong area.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我终于能提前看清着陆地点了！再也不会因为达吕斯把咱们派错了地方，而意外降落在沼泽里了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The current sensor systems have lacked the capabilities to properly map the terrain in our mission drop zones. With some simple rewiring and adding the proper software to the Argo computers, we can adapt the general sensor array to support terrain scans.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目前的传感器系统一直缺乏对任务空降区地形进行精确测绘的能力. 通过一些简单的线路改造，并为阿尔戈号的计算机加装合适的软件，我们就能将通用传感器阵列改造为可支持地形扫描的配置.
传感器-地形测绘

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With this upgrade, my intel will be a lot more accurate of the battle conditions. I hope.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 希望有了这次升级，我的情报对战场状况的把握会精准得多. 但愿吧.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: By further upgrading our sensor systems and connect them to a series of autonomous satellites it would be possible to monitor weather systems and unusual geological characteristics in the whole star system.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 通过进一步升级我们的传感器系统，并将其与一系列自主卫星相连，就有可能监测整个恒星系的气象系统及异常地质特征.
气象监测系统

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With this we can support dropping an additional Mech onto the battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 有了这个，我们就能额外向战场空降一台机甲.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: So it turns out the docking cradles were salvaged for parts and scrap, but the mounting points are still intact. I can get my techs to work fabricating new 'Mech cradles, Commander, but it's gonna take a while to get everything rebuilt. I think there's enough pieces left behind to get one assembled quickly, though.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 结果发现那些对接架已被拆解成零件与废料，但安装点还完好。指挥官，我可以让技师们去制造新的机甲托架，但把所有东西重建起来要花些时间。不过我觉得留下的零件足够快装出一台来。
豹式: 1号空降舱

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This will use up the last of the parts that weren't salvaged, but at least we were able to keep the costs down, right?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这会用掉最后一批没被回收的部件，但至少我们把成本压下来了，对吧？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The first cradle turned out alright, Boss. There's enough scrap left lying around we should be able to construct the bones of a gantry for the next, but we're also gonna need to buy several complex components to get the next cradle ready for use.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 第一个机架做出来还不错，老大。周围剩下的废料应该够我们搭出下个机架的龙门骨架，但我们还需要买几个复杂部件才能让下一个机架准备就绪。
豹式: 2号空降舱

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The cradles can be completed, but Sumire has some concerns. You should talk to her before trying to field a full extra lance, Boss.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 托架可以完成，但苏米尔有些顾虑. 头儿，在尝试投入一整支额外小队前，您应该先和她谈谈.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Half-done now, Boss. It's really starting to look like a proper dropship. I can get started on fabricating parts to assemble the final two cradles from scratch. Producing both sets of parts at the same time should save us a little time and money.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 现在完成一半了，老大。它真的开始看起来像一艘像样的空投艇了。我可以开始从头制造部件，来组装最后两个机架。同时生产两套部件应该能帮我们省一点时间和钱。
豹式: 3号空降舱

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Making sure our people can make it to the mission is the first real step to victory.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确保我们的人能顺利抵达任务地点，是迈向胜利的真正第一步.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: There's more to dropping a lance of BattleMechs from orbit than strapping them to a wall, Commander. Several of the gyros and handling sensors around the ship are damaged or downright missing. If we try to insert the ship from orbit with all four 'Mech cradles occupied, using anything less than an absolutely perfectly balanced load could lead to a very real chance of losing the shuttle and all aboard. We'll need to replace and recalibrate those systems through some test drops before we can make full use of the new Leopard, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，把一支机甲分队从轨道上投下去，可不只是把它们捆在墙上那么简单。舰上好几具陀螺仪和操纵传感器已经损坏，甚至干脆不见了。如果我们载满四个机甲机架从轨道投放飞船，只要载荷不是绝对完美的平衡，就极有可能连穿梭机带机上所有人一起损失。指挥官，我们得先通过几次试投放来更换并重新校准这些系统，才能充分发挥这艘新豹式的能力。
豹式: 4号空降舱

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If we get this up and running, our tactical flexibility will take a big step up, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，如果我们能让这东西投入运作，我们的战术灵活性将向前迈进一大步.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We managed to find someone selling a junked Leopard, Commander. The seller says it 'ran when parked'. If we can get it fully operational again, we'd be able to drop some Heavy Metal!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们设法找到有人在卖一艘报废的豹式，指挥官。卖家说它"停车时还能跑"。如果我们能让它重新完全运作，我们就能投送一些重金属了！
废弃豹式

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Processors that can handle this kind of raw data-bandwidth are LosTech these days, Commander. I'm sorry, but this won't be cheap.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，如今能处理这种原始数据带宽的处理器已属失落科技。抱歉，这不会便宜。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Further Repairs on the Leopard's Mechbays allows more efficient storage of units and equipment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对豹式机甲舱的进一步修复能更高效地储存单位与装备。
豹式: 利用存储区域

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: At this point, I think only ComStar can claim to have better communication infrastructure in a single place.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 事到如今，我想只有通讯之星敢说能在一个地方拥有比我们更好的通讯基础设施了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Freed space on the Leopard allows to store munitions and replacement Parts easier.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 豹式空投艇上腾出的空间使得弹药与替换零件的存储更加便捷.
豹式: 弹药库

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This stuff can't do the work for me, but it comes awfully close. You want to speed things up around here, give me the resources to get these machines back online.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这些材料没法替我把活干了，但已经很接近了。你想让这里的事快点推进，就给我资源让这些机器重新上线。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Many of the Argo's Mech Bay systems were only meant to be used with sophisticated Star League–era automation. Bringing that automation even partially back online is a substantial force multiplier to Yang's skills. Enables second Repair bay to work at 100% efficiency.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿戈号机甲库的许多系统原本只应与精密的星盟时代自动化配合使用。让那种自动化哪怕部分重新上线，都是对杨技能的大幅加成。使第二个维修舱能以100%效率工作。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: There's machines hidden in the walls, under the floor panels — I don't even know what half of it does. But I turned one on and it built a 'Mech leg before I was able to shut it off. We make these work, we'll be moving 'Mechs out of repair in record time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 墙里、地板下都藏着机器——我连一半是干什么用的都不知道。但我启动了一台，在我能关掉它之前它就造出了一条机甲腿。要是我们把它们弄好，我们就能以创纪录的速度让机甲出维修线。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Repairs to the Mech Bay have unearthed a much more extensive system of 'Mech maintenance automation than Yang previously suspected. Once it's back online, many common tasks will become trivial. Enables third Repair bay to work at 100% efficiency.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 机甲库的维修发掘出了比杨先前所料广泛得多的机甲维护自动化系统。一旦它重新上线，许多常见工作都会变得轻而易举。使第三个维修舱能以100%效率工作。
改良的自动化系统

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Okay, what we've got here is a fully outfitted machine shop, and a whole lot of data on 'Mech specifications. Get this back online, and we'll be machining our own parts, probably better than the ones coming out of the Taurian factories. Faster, too.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好，我们这里有一间装备齐全的机加工车间，以及一大堆关于机甲规格的数据。让这里重新上线，我们就能自己加工零件，大概比陶里安工厂出产的更好。也更快。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Maintaining 'Mechs in the Succession War era is complicated by the relative rarity of precision-manufactured parts. The Argo's machine shop, once repaired and brought online, can help address this lack.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在继承战争时代维护机甲之所以复杂，正是因为精密制造的部件相对稀少。阿戈号的机加工车间一旦修好并上线，就能帮助缓解这种短缺。
机甲车间

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You always see cables and stuff hanging down from the ceiling and think, 'What the hell are those for?' Right? Lifting and turning entire 'Mechs. We get them back online, and we can lift a whole 'Mech. I mean, honestly? I just want to see that happen.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你总是看见天花板上垂着线缆之类的东西，心里想"这些到底是干嘛用的？"对吧？那是用来吊起并翻转整台机甲的。我们让它们重新运转，就能吊起一整台机甲。老实说？我就是想亲眼看到那一幕。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: 'Mechs were not really meant to bear their own weight while being refitted with new equipment. The Argo's Mech Bay includes harnesses meant to hoist the 'Mech up for easier access while refitting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 机甲本来并不是为了在换装新装备时承受自身的重量而设计的。阿戈号的机甲库配有吊具，用于把机甲吊起，方便改装时接近。
改造吊具

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The platforms around here are meant to move automatically when they detect the size of the 'Mech we're working on, adjusting to be at just the right height. They're all off-line, and we've been working around that, but… let's get them fixed and speed this up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这附近的平台本该在检测到我们正在作业的机甲尺寸时自动移动，调整到刚好合适的高度。它们全都离线了，我们一直绕着这个干活，不过……让我们把它们修好，加快进度。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Argo's 'Mech cubicles used to have a complex system of movable walkways and scaffolds for accessing any part of a damaged 'Mech. Those walkways, once brought online, make the job of repairing 'Mechs much simpler.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿戈号的机甲隔间过去有一套复杂的可移动走道与脚手架系统，用来接近受损机甲的任意部位。一旦让那些走道重新上线，维修机甲的工作就会简单得多。
维修脚手架

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Argo's Mech Bay is vast, spacious, and meant to be entirely managed by complex automation. Currently, 6 of the 18 total 'Mech cubicles are powered and in working order, and almost none of the automation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿戈号的机甲库广阔、宽敞，本应完全由复杂的自动化系统管理。目前，18个机甲隔间中有6个已通电并处于可用状态，而自动化几乎一点也没有。
1号机甲舱

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've got a lot of extra space in here, Commander. It's just full of junk and pirate garbage, and half of the walls are missing. I could pull my engineers off 'Mech duties and we could probably get another six 'Mech cubicles online. Just say the word.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们这里多出了不少空间，指挥官。只是里面堆满了垃圾和海盗的破烂，一半的墙还不见了。我可以把我的工程师从机甲维护岗上调走，大概能让另外六个机甲机库上线。你一句话就行。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The repaired power conduits allow six more 'Mech cubicles to be powered up and made available. This also brings more of the Mech Bay's automated systems online, making Yang's job easier. Enables second Repair bay, allows work on a second 'Mech's at 50% efficiency.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 修复后的电力导管让另外6个机甲隔间得以通电启用，也让机甲库更多自动化系统上线，减轻杨的工作负担。 启用第二个维修舱，可同时以50%效率维修第二台机甲。
2号机甲舱

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The power's back on to the rest of the Mech Bay, and we can start repairs on the last 6 cubicles. Even if you don't want to fill them with 'Mechs, believe me, I can put the extra space to good use. It's gonna take a shitload of work, though.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 机甲库其余部分的电力已经恢复，我们可以开始修复最后6个隔间了。就算你不打算用机甲把它们填满，相信我，我也能让多出来的空间派上大用场。不过这可是个大工程。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With the Argo's power systems fully online, and enough reinforcement to keep the active Bays from damaging the ship's spine, the final 6 'Mech cubicles can be powered up and put to work. Enables third Repair bay, allows work on a third 'Mech at 33% efficiency..
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 随着阿戈号动力系统完全上线，加上足够的加固使已启用的舱室不会损伤舰体脊骨，最后6个机甲隔间可以通电并投入使用了。 < 启用第三个维修舱，允许以33%效率对第三台机甲作业。。
3号机甲舱

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've found a way to get the whole secondary Mech hangar online, but the cost will be high. But it will be worth it in my opinion, not only does it let us have more Mechs ready, it also gives us more space to work on them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们找到办法让整个第二机甲库上线了，但代价会很高。不过我认为值得：它不仅让我们能备妥更多机甲，还给我们更多维修空间。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
<color=#0033FF>Unlocked through Events.</color>

The secondary Mech Hangar allows for having another 18 mechs readied at any time.

<color=#FF0000>Note: There is no way to move Mechs between the two hangars.</color>
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
<color=#0033FF>通过事件解锁。</color>

次级机甲机库允许随时另外备妥18台机甲。

<color=#FF0000>注意：无法在两个机库之间移动机甲。</color>
机甲舱2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, the medics are talking about all the advanced facilities, and we now have sufficient power to operate it all. We'd need to do a major overhaul of all our Med Bays, but we'd substantially increase our ability to treat severe injuries.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，医护兵们一直在谈论那些先进设施，而我们现在有足够的电力让它们全部运转。我们需要对所有医疗舱做大改造，但我们的重伤救治能力将大幅提升。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Argo specifications had room and infrastructure for actual hospital facilities, rather than just simple Med Bays. With a full hospital's worth of equipment and connections to the ship's library and databases, the MedTechs are able to perform near-miracles of healing. All Med Bays will be converted into Hospital Bays.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿戈号原本的设计规格中，就有容纳真正医院设施的空间与基础设施，而不只是简单的医疗舱。有了完整的医院级设备，以及与舰上图书馆和数据库的连接，医疗技师们能够创造出近乎奇迹的疗愈效果。所有医疗舱都将改建为医院舱。
医院室

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This field hospital has a small number of beds, surgical equipment, and medical supplies. The cost includes the salary of a skilled MedTech to treat your injured MechWarriors.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这处野战医院只有少量的床位、手术设备和医疗用品. 相关费用包含一名熟练的医疗技师的工资，用于治疗受伤的机甲战士.
1号医务室

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, the existing Med Bay is able to keep up, but just barely. Nobody's dying for lack of treatment, but our medics are overworked. Beta Pod has an entire additional medical bay, unused and waiting to be renovated and powered back up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，现有的医疗舱勉强跟得上，但也只是勉强。没人因为得不到治疗而死，但我们的医护兵超负荷了。贝塔舱有一间完整的额外医疗舱，闲置未用，等着翻新并重新通电。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This expanded field hospital allows for two MedTechs to work side by side, meaning more capacity to treat patients. The cost includes the salary of an additional skilled MedTech to treat your injured MechWarriors.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这处扩建的野战医院允许两名医疗技师一起工作，意味着能治疗更多病人. 相关费用包含一名额外的熟练医疗技师的薪水，用于治疗受伤的机甲战士.
2号医务室

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're taking enough injuries to keep our current medical staff fully tasked, Commander, and that makes me worry about our future capacity. These battles aren't getting any easier. We have the space for another Med Bay, and I'm sure we'd find it useful.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们受的伤已经足够让我们当前的医务人员满负荷了，指挥官，这让我担心我们未来的容量。这些战斗不会变得更容易。我们有空间再设一间医疗舱，我相信它会派上用场。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The fully upgraded field hospital has enough bed space, diagnostic equipment, and surgeries to allow fully half the company to be treated at once. The cost includes the salary of an additional skilled MedTech to treat your injured MechWarriors.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 全面升级后的野战医院有着充足的床位、诊断设备以及手术室，足够同时治疗公司的一半人马. 相关费用包括含一名额外的熟练医疗技师的薪水，用于治疗受伤的机甲战士.
3号医务室

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Basic MRB Contract Console that allows bidding on all standard contracts and flashpoints.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 基础型佣兵审核委员会合约控制台，可竞标所有标准合约及冲突点任务.
MRB合约控制台

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Each of the three pods is meant to be a mostly self-sufficient habitation space. Alpha Pod, as its interior labeling designates it, is the only one of the three to have retained its pressure seal, making its interior (mostly) habitable.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 三个舱室中的每一个都意味着一处基本自给自足的居住空间. 阿尔法舱就如同内部标签上标示的那样，是三个舱室中唯一保持气密性的一个，从而使其内部(基本)宜居.
阿尔法舱

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The crew has seen the Beta Pod rec facilities on the ship's floor plans, Commander, and it's all they can talk about. More practically, we'd be able to bring the Beta Pod medical facilities back online.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 船员们在舰上平面图里看到了贝塔舱的娱乐设施，指挥官，他们满嘴都是这个。更实际地说，我们还能让贝塔舱的医疗设施重新上线。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Beta Pod, once repaired, includes what was clearly once a hydroponics facility near the spine of the Argo, and a low-g gymnasium just above that. Neither survived exposure to hard vacuum and stellar radiation, but they're tantalizing indications of the luxuries the Argo once included. +10 Days before Affinities Decay.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 贝塔吊舱一经修复，其中显然曾有一处在阿尔戈脊柱附近的水培设施，其上方还有一间低重力健身房。两者都没能挺过硬真空与恒星辐射，但它们令人遐想地暗示着阿尔戈曾经拥有的奢侈配置。 偏好力衰减前+10天。
贝塔舱

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, there are already a half dozen requests for new facilities for Gamma Pod, ranging from a swimming pool to a DropShip-sized bouncy castle. On a more practical note, we could also begin using the Gamma Pod medical facilities.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，关于伽玛舱的新设施已经有6份请求了，从游泳池到空投艇大小的充气城堡. 有份实际一点的记录是，我们可以开始利用伽玛舱的医疗设施.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Gamma Pod is very much a blank slate, as only its internal support structures survived intact. Rebuilding the habitation decks of the pod still leaves plenty of space for other facilities. +10 Days before Affinities Decay.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 伽马舱基本是一张白纸，只有其内部支撑结构完好幸存。重建该舱的居住甲板之后，仍会剩下充足空间用于其他设施。 < 契合度衰减前+10天。
伽玛舱

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm terrified of the current state of the power system, Commander. Repairing it should be a top priority. We cannot bring most of the Argo's other systems online until the power is stable. Also… I'd avoid touching any exposed deck plating. Just in case.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我对电力系统的现状感到恐惧，指挥官。修好它应当是最高优先事项。在电力稳定之前，我们无法让阿戈号的大部分其他系统上线。另外……我会避免触碰任何裸露的甲板板。以防万一。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Argo's power system is a wreck, and getting a minimal level of power to the ship's systems without constant tripped breakers and brownouts is a minor miracle.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿戈号的动力系统一团糟，能让舰上系统获得最低水平的电力、又不会不断跳闸和电压不足，已经算是个小小的奇迹。
修复后的电力管道

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Notably, upgrading the power system will allow us to provide power to all three habitation pods, which means more room and more Argo systems operational.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 值得注意的是，升级动力系统将使我们能向全部三个居住舱供电，这意味着更多空间，也能让更多阿戈号系统投入运转。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Running power through patched-together conduits isn’t reliable or safe. Upgrading all the conduits throughout the Argo is a monumental task, but necessary for anything that places a significant load on the system.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 通过临时拼凑的导管输电既不可靠也不安全。升级阿戈号全舰的所有导管是一项浩大工程，但对任何会给系统带来显著负荷的东西都是必需的。
改良的电力管道

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a remarkable ship. I continue to be astonished at how advanced portions of the Argo's infrastructure are. We're not even running the drive at half the power it can handle. More power means more thrust, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一艘了不起的船。我不断惊讶于阿戈号基础设施的某些部分有多么先进。我们连它推进器能承受的一半功率都没用到。更多功率意味着更大推力，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Argo was intended to operate at a much higher total power throughput than the jury-rigged conduits can manage. With this upgrade we can bring some weapons online that should help us stave of some attackers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔戈原本设计的总功率传递量远高于这些临时拼凑的导管所能承受。有了这次升级，我们就能让一些武器上线，帮我们挡下一些袭击者。
大容量电力管道

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: There's this game, Commander. No, hear me out, I'm serious! It's called DropShip Commander, and you pilot a Leopard in a bunch of battle scenarios. Now, I'm not saying this game will make me a better pilot. But I'm not saying it won't, either.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 有这么个游戏，指挥官。不，听我说完，我是认真的！它叫《空投艇指挥官》，你在里面驾驶一艘豹式打一堆战斗剧本。我不是说这游戏能让我成为更好的飞行员。但我也不说它不能。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That empty storage space in Gamma Pod, with some additional power conduits, could easily support a handful of 2-D and 3-D game systems. It's no replacement for the training units, but it's more fun.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 伽马舱里那块闲置的存储空间，加上一些额外电力导管，能轻松支持几套2D和3D游戏系统。它替代不了训练单元，但更好玩。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Just look at this, a Candy Machine and deluxe set of AeroTech, you got to learn how Flyboys think, Boss!.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 快瞧这个，一台糖果机和豪华版空战技术套装，头儿，你得学学那些飞行员是怎么想的！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With some more refurbishment the Arcade can be easily upgraded to give more opportunities to relax and unwind.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 只要再稍加整修，娱乐厅就能轻松升级，提供更多放松和消遣的机会.
升级版娱乐厅

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Manipulating of our people is surprisingly easy. I am not sure if this is worrisome or not.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 操纵咱们的人真是出奇的容易. 我都不确定这算不算值得担忧的事了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Introduce an award for the Employee of the week, which involves putting their picture on the wall with a golden frame and a small monetary gift. It's the perfect way to boost egos, just don't tell them it's a fake award that everyone will get it over time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 设立“每周最佳员工”奖项：把他们的照片配上金色相框挂到墙上，再给一份小额奖金。这是激发自尊心的绝佳方式，只是别告诉他们这其实是个假奖项，人人迟早都会得。
本周最佳员工

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I suspect a solid majority of the complaints I've received from the MechWarriors are simple idleness. With fitness facilities, I could solve that idleness for them, Commander. If you take my meaning.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我怀疑我收到的机甲战士投诉中有相当一部分只是闲得慌。指挥官，如果有机身训练设施，我就能替他们解决这份闲情。你懂我的意思。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: MechWarriors have to maintain their physical condition, and doing so in their own quarters is claustrophobic and distracting. Luckily, the Argo has a full gymnasium, needing only repair and power.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 机甲战士必须保持体能，而在自己舱室里锻炼既幽闭又分心。所幸阿尔戈有完整的健身房，只需修理并通电。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I suspect a solid majority of the complaints I've received from the MechWarriors are simple idleness. With fitness facilities, I could solve that idleness for them, Commander. If you take my meaning.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我怀疑我收到的机甲战士投诉中有相当一部分只是闲得慌。指挥官，如果有机身训练设施，我就能替他们解决这份闲情。你懂我的意思。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Now that we got the Argo gymnasium working, we can add some better Equipment and Showers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 既然我们让阿戈号的健身房运作起来了，我们可以加一些更好的设备和淋浴间。
升级版健身房

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I've looked over Gamma Pod, Commander, and most of the original plumbing is intact. With a small amount of effort, we could repair the hydroponics and have fresh herbs and vegetables instead of reconstituted paste in the galley. Just a thought.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我看过伽马舱了，指挥官，大部分原有管道都还完好。只需花点小力气，我们就能修好水培系统，让厨房里有新鲜香草和蔬菜，而不是复原糊。只是个想法。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Near the spine, the spin of the pods isn't sufficient to generate any real apparent gravity. This makes those areas bad for living in, but excellent for growing hydroponic crops. They freshen the air and add variety to mealtimes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在脊柱附近，吊舱的旋转不足以产生任何真正可感知的重力。这使那些区域不适合居住，却非常适合种植水培作物——它们能清新空气，也让餐桌多些花样。
无土栽培室

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I've looked over the Hydroponic Gardens in Gamma Pod, Commander, and there's several key areas we could greatly improve and expand upon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我看过伽马舱的水培花园了，指挥官，有几处关键区域我们可以大幅改进和扩展。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: More hydroponic crops means not only even fresher air, along with an greater variety to our mealtimes, but it would also reduce our monthly costs even further!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 更多的水培作物不仅意味着更清新的空气和用餐时更丰富的种类，还能进一步降低我们的月度开销！
升级版水培花园

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I swear to the gods, trying to read a technical readout in that lounge is impossible. Commander, I need to keep up with the latest tech to do my job, and I can't do it while the MechWarriors are playing beer pong over my head.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我向诸神发誓，在那间休息室里读技术资料根本不可能。指挥官，我需要跟上最新技术才能干好我的活，而机师们在我头顶上玩啤酒乒乓时我做不到。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A library is more than just a database and a stack of e-readers. It requires a dedicated space for quiet study and learning, as far from the raucous lounge as possible.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一座图书馆不止是一座数据库和一排电子阅读器. 它需要远离喧嚣休息区的专用空间，供人静心学习.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A JumpShip pilot told me there's an off-the-books digital distribution service. They get tri-vid and books from DropShips and sell them under the table. It would be more interesting than the decade-old 'Mech magazines Yang keeps putting in the library, anyway.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一名跃迁舰飞行员告诉我，有个不记账的数字分发服务。他们从空投艇上弄到全息影像和书籍，私下出售。不管怎么说，总比杨老往图书室里放的那些十年前的机甲杂志有意思。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Active subscriptions to a variety of e-book services, periodicals, and tri-vid channels make the library even more appealing to everyone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对各种电子书服务、期刊和三维影像频道的有效订阅，让图书馆变得对每个人都更有吸引力.
改良的图书馆

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I've just had to chase another card game out of the mess hall so the staff could clean up, Commander. The crew needs somewhere to relax that isn't also where we're trying to serve meals.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我刚又不得不把一局牌局从食堂赶出去，好让员工打扫。船员需要一个既能放松、又不是我们努力上菜的地方。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A shared social space outside the barracks allows the MechWarriors to bond as a team.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 营房之外的共用社交空间能将机甲战士们拧成一支团队.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The, uh, the engineers were wondering if they could schedule a regular tri-vid event. There's this show, about mercenaries during the civil war, and their 'Mechs are supposed to be historically accurate. I'd— uh, they'd like a space to watch stuff like that.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那个，呃，工程师们想知道能不能安排一个定期的三录节目。有个剧，讲内战时期的雇佣兵，里面的机甲据说是历史准确的。我想——呃，他们想找个地方看这类东西。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A few couches and a table don't make for much of a social space. Drinks, 2-D video screens, and a sound system, on the other hand…
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 几张沙发和一张桌子算不上什么社交空间。而饮料、二维视频屏和一套音响系统就是另一回事了……
升级后的休息室

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Yeah, Boss, with all the Rustgut some of the Boys keep trying to make i thought we should maybe add some less toxic choices for everyone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 是啊，头儿，看着弟兄们老试着酿那锈肠子私酒，我就琢磨着咱该给大家弄点毒性没那么大的选择.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A nice Bar and choice selection of drinks for the Lounge.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 休息室里有个不错的吧台，还有精选的各种饮品.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander. Come on. LOW-GRAVITY SWIMMING POOL. I don't know what there even is to discuss here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官。拜托。低重力游泳池。我不明白这里有什么可讨论的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: When you have a large space with nothing critical in it, where the gravity is too low for living quarters, the obvious choice is to fill it with chlorinated water.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 当你拥有一个很大的空间，里面没什么重要东西，而且重力又不足以建造居住舱时，显而易见的选择是用氯处理过的水(自来水)填满它.
低重力泳池

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander. Come on. LOW-GRAVITY SWIMMING POOL. I don't know what there even is to discuss here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官。拜托。低重力游泳池。我不明白这里有什么可讨论的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Upgraded Low-G Pool with better opportunities for swimming, training and leisure activities.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 升级版的低重力泳池，提供了更好的游泳、训练和休闲活动条件.
升级版低重力泳池

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our internal storage is having enough roadblocks as is, Commander. I can't make it from Engineering to the Mech Bay without tripping over our loose ends and spares. We're managing so much poorly placed inventory right now that crews are losing productivity just trying to find the tools and resources they need.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的内部仓储已经够多阻碍了，指挥官。我从工程部走到机甲库，一路上都会被散落的零碎和备件绊倒。眼下我们管理着这么多摆放不当的库存，光是找工具和材料，各班组的生产力就在流失。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Argo's internal storage is just enough for day-to-day survival, but we'll need to develop an inventory system optimized for the Argo and not just a standard DropShip. This ship's layout and functions are so different from standard that a new unified inventory system needs to be developed from scratch.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿戈号的内部仓储只够日常生存，但我们需要开发一套专为阿戈号优化、而非标准空投艇的库存系统。这艘船的布局与功能与标准型号差异太大，所以必须从零开始开发一套新的统一库存系统。
存储空间

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: 'Mechs assembling 'Mechs so that our 'Mechs can go to battle properly equipped. It might sound silly, but the Argo is a big ship and every bit of efficiency helps us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 让机甲来组装机甲，这样我们的机甲才能装备齐全地上战场。这听起来也许傻，但阿戈号是艘大船，每一点效率都对我们有帮助。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An optimized inventory system for the Argo is an excellent start, but we can cut storage costs further. If you're willing to front the cost for a few, rugged WorkMechs, we'd save a ton of labour and time managing our storage. This will translate into cheaper storage costs in the long run.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为阿尔戈优化库存系统是个极好的开始，但我们还能进一步削减仓储成本。如果你愿意先出钱买几台坚固的工作机甲，我们就能在管理仓储上省下大量人力与时间。长远看这会转化为更低的仓储成本。
机械化存储空间

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm not suggesting that we have robots take everyone's jobs, but it's a fact that machines don't sleep, breathe, eat or complain. Some of our guys could strive to be a little more like that every now and again.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我不是建议让机器人接管所有人的工作，但事实是机器不睡觉、不呼吸、不吃饭、也不抱怨。我们有些人可以时不时努力更像那样一点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Automating the Argo's internal storage is the future. One last upgrade to the storage cells would let us move to an automated drone inventory system with a few pressurized WorkMechs for special work. Depressurizing some of our inventory and making robots do the work will save us a lot of upkeep by letting us assign the labour and resources elsewhere
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 自动化阿戈号的内部仓储就是未来。对储存舱做最后一次升级，就能让我们转向自动化无人机库存系统，配几台增压作业机甲做特殊工作。给部分库存降压、让机器人干活，能让我们把人力与资源调配到别处，省下大量维护费用
自动化存储空间

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, have you seen these simulator pods? They're fantastic! I take back everything bad I've ever said about the Argo. We gotta get these things running ASAP.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，你见过这些模拟器舱了吗？它们太棒了！我收回我说过关于阿戈号的一切坏话。我们得尽快让这些东西运转起来。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This set of networked Battle Pods allow MechWarriors to compete against one another in simulated 'Mech battles, generating experience for participating MechWarriors. Each MechWarrior with less than 200,000 total experience will gain 30 experience points per day. Affinity decays to minimum 5 points
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这套联网战斗舱让机甲战士能在模拟机甲战斗中对战，为参战者生成经验。 总经验不足20万的机甲战士每天获得30点经验。 偏好力最低衰减至5点
1号训练模块

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Farah just told me that the simulators in Beta Pod can network with the others. You know what that means? It means ship-wide tournaments. It means MechWarriors getting stomped in simulated battle by yours truly. We need these simulators, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 法拉刚告诉我，贝塔舱的模拟器可以与其他舱的联网。你知道这意味着什么吗？意味着全舰锦标赛。意味着机师们会在模拟战里被我本人痛揍。我们需要这些模拟器，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Adding more Battle Pods allows for full-lance training simulations, as well as raucous ship-wide tournaments. This increases the amount of experience gained by MechWarriors aboard the ship. Each MechWarrior with less than 500,000 total experience will gain 50 experience points per day. Affinity decays to minimum 10 points
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 增加更多战斗吊舱可以实现全分队训练模拟，以及热闹的全舰锦标赛。这会提升船上机师获得的经验量。 < 每名总经验低于500,000的机师每天将获得50点经验。 < 契合度最低衰减至10点
2号训练模块

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I've got a design for my simulator team's insignia ready to go, Commander. We're gonna get shirts made—and maybe even warm-up jackets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我给模拟器小队设计的徽章图案已经准备好了，指挥官。我们要做T恤——也许还做热身夹克。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With a training space completely packed with Battle Pods, MechWarriors can engage in lance-versus-lance competition, and that inevitably means teams, logos, and pennants. Large-scale competition means even more experience for participating MechWarriors. Each MechWarrior with less than 800,000 total experience will gain 80 experience points per day. Affinity decays to minimum 40 points
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 训练空间被战斗吊舱完全塞满后，机师们可以进行分队对分队的竞赛，而这必然意味着队伍、标志和锦旗。大规模竞赛意味着参赛机师获得更多经验。 < 每名总经验低于800,000的机师每天将获得80点经验。 < 契合度最低衰减至40点
3号训练模块

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Improving the network linkages between our C&C systems should ease some of the burden.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 改善我们指挥与控制系统之间的网络连接，应该能减轻一部分负担.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Command and Control systems were never really intended to support a Light Company's worth of 'Mechs, Commander. If we want to maintain communications with our pilots, we'll need to upgrade our communication networks to deal with the additional bandwidth.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，指挥控制系统原本并非为支持一支轻型连规模的机甲而设计。若要维持与飞行员的通讯，我们就得升级通讯网络以应对额外的带宽需求。
豹式: 升级通讯网络

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The next step will be to standardize the communication hardware between our 'Mechs and the Argo's systems so I can remove an abstraction layer from our ship-side software.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 下一步是统一我们的机甲与阿戈号系统之间的通讯硬件，这样我就能从舰载软件里去掉一层抽象层。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The upgrades continue, Commander. Interfacing this Star League technology with our own Command & Control systems is proving challenging, but there's no problem more money and time can't fix, right?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 升级继续推进，指挥官。把这套星际联盟技术与我们自己的指挥控制系统的对接被证明颇有挑战，但没有更多金钱与时间解决不了的问题，对吧？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Leopard: Command and Control System Integrations
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 豹式: 指挥与控制系统整合

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: There's a lot of work to do on this baby, but we can manage it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这小家伙有很多活要干，但我们应付得来。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The shuttle was allowed to go to rust sitting in the junkyard, Commander. Most parts of the Leopard's basic structure consist of little more than rust and hope. My 'techs can get to work repairing the worst of the damage, but I warn you now, to complete all of the work will be a long process.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，那艘穿梭机被扔在废品场里任由生锈。豹式基础结构的大部分，除了锈迹和希望之外几乎什么都不剩。我的技师可以开工修掉最严重的损伤，但我现在就警告你，要完成全部工作将是一个漫长的过程。
豹式: 关键维修

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: After this she might look like there weren't a family of squatters throwing parties in her every night.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这之后她看起来就不会像每晚都有一家子擅自占住者在里面开派对。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The good news is that the 'Mechs probably won't fall out of their cradles when the Leopard launches, so now we can get started on making sure they won't fall through the floor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好消息是，豹式发射时那些机甲大概不会从机架里掉出来，所以我们现在可以着手确保它们不会漏穿地板了。
豹式: 甲板加固

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The interior is now fit to sleep in. Not that I have been... Anyways, now we can start work on all the problems we can't see.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 内部现在可以住人了。倒不是说我一直住在里面……总之，现在我们能开始处理那些我们看不见的问题了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The interior of the ship is now more or less serviceable, but the underlying structure still needs a lot of work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 飞船内部现在大致可用了，但基础结构仍有大量工作需要完成.
豹式: 基础结构修复

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Frankly I'm surprised there's been no disasters already, Boss. No one reported this to me. If you happen to notice any of my 'techs on septic tank duty over the coming weeks, I promise it's completely unrelated.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 说实话，我很惊讶到现在都还没出事，老板。没人向我报告这件事。如果你接下来几周碰巧看到我的哪位技师被派去清理化粪池，我保证这完全无关。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Turns out the engine mounts are almost completely rusted away Commander. We're gonna need to rebuild them before we can start fixing the engines, otherwise they'll rip themselves out under too much stress.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，结果引擎支架几乎完全锈穿了。我们得先重建它们，才能开始修引擎，否则在过大应力下它们会把自己扯出来。
豹式: 引擎支架更换

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've reached the limit of weight these engines can handle, Commander. It'll take some time to get them back up to spec.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已达到这些引擎能承受的重量极限，指挥官。把它们恢复到规格需要一些时间。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Leopard has lost a lot of engine power over the years rusting away. As it stands, getting down to the planet won't be a problem but it'd be a one way trip with the engines in their current state. I'll help Yang get started on repairing the worst of the damage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 豹式在多年锈蚀中损失了大量引擎功率。就现状而言，降到行星上不是问题，但以引擎当前状态那将是有去无回的单程之旅。我会帮杨开始修复最严重的损伤。
豹式: 引擎大修

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Tune the Engine and drop them hot, Boss.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 调校好引擎，直接让它们热机空降，头儿.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The engine work continues, Commander. We've almost got those engines back up to their rated output. A little more tweaking should do it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 引擎的工作还在继续，指挥官。我们几乎把那些引擎恢复到额定输出了。再微调一下就行。
豹式: 改进引擎调校

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Almost at the home stretch, Commander. We've turned this ship from a home for rats into something I'd feel safe flying myself. Almost.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 快到家了，指挥官。我们把这艘船从老鼠窝变成了我自己都敢开的东西。差一点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Now that the engines and structure are back up to snuff, the next step is to recalibrate the control systems to correctly handle the balance and performance changes that our repairs have caused. We'll need to do a series of orbital drops to accurately gauge the handling characteristics and then punch them into the onboard flight systems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 既然引擎与结构已恢复到位，下一步是重新校准控制系统，以正确处理我们维修所带来的平衡与性能变化。我们需要做一系列轨道投放，以准确测出操控特性，再把它们写进舰载飞行系统。
豹式: 重新校准控制系统

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I wish I'd known you'd see this through before we started, Boss. I could have saved us some time and money if we'd just done this from the start.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我真希望在我们开始之前就知道你会把它做完，老大。要是我们一开始就这么干，本可以省下不少时间和钱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The good news is we're almost at the finish line. Frankly, I never thought we'd get this far, Boss. I've been putting this off so far because of the necessary time and money, but the spine of the ship was bent either during it's past service or while it was rotting away in the junkyard. We're going to have to completely tear down the ship to expose the structural skeleton to complete the work, but after this it will be as good as new!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好消息是我们快到终点线了。老实说，老大，我从没想过我们能走到这一步。我一直在拖延，因为需要的时间与金钱，但舰船的脊骨要么是在它过去服役期间，要么是在废品场里腐烂时被弄弯了。我们得把整艘船拆开，露出结构骨架才能完成这项工作，但做完之后它会像新的一样！
豹式: 加固结构框架

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is it, after this there really isn't anything else we can improve. Well, except buying something bigger than a Leopard.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就是这一下了，这之后真的没什么可改进的了。嗯，除了买比豹式更大的东西。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A full reconstruction of the Leopard, adding several new compartments by expanding its hull. Includes modifying the internal frame, improving the internal wiring and upgrading the engines. The reconstruction will take considerable time and has a very high cost, but once done allows bringing almost anything to away missions.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 豹式空投艇的全面重建，通过扩大船体来新增数个隔舱. 包括修改内部框架、改进内部布线以及升级引擎. 重建将耗费相当长的时间和极高的成本，但一旦完成，几乎可以将任何东西带往外勤任务.
豹式: 船体扩容
咄咄逼人的谈判

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Armor of the Target is breached.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标装甲已被击穿。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the Target, clear area of additional Enemies, and Escape
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁目标，清除区域内额外敌人，然后撤离

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective for AutoComplete, Destroy Assassination Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标（自动完成用）：摧毁刺杀小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, this isn't likely to be resolved by one dead diplomat. Situations like this are good for repeat business.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，死一个外交官不太可能解决问题。这种局面有利于回头客生意。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've been having troubles with {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} for months now, and our negotiations with them have been stalled by a stubborn {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} diplomat. If he were removed from the equation, through a random attack by \"bandits\" for instance, we might be able to make some headway.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们和{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}已经纠缠数月，而与他们谈判一直卡在一位固执的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}外交官身上。如果他从等式里消失——比如遭到“匪盗”的随机袭击——我们也许就能取得一些进展。
雇主的盟友

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, the target is bugging out! Eliminate them before they escape.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，目标正在逃跑！在他们逃掉之前消灭他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, you're in the AO, and we're expecting hostile contacts.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，你已进入作战区域，预计会有敌对接触。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mission accomplished. The target is dead. Well done, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 任务完成. 目标死亡. 做得不错，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Readings indicate the ambushing units are out of commission. The employer will be pleased.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 读数显示伏击单位已失去作战能力。雇主会满意的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Recon has provided the general vicinity of the diplomat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 侦察确认了外交官大致就在附近.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sensors are showing enemy movement beyond our initial count. Be advised you might meet with increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器显示敌军动向超出我们最初的判断。请注意，你可能会遇到更强的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Take the target out, and get to the evac zone. Oliveira out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭目标，然后到撤离区域去. 奥利维拉完毕.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That is our target, sustain fire on that unit!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那就是我们的目标，对那个单位持续开火！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Time to make a withdrawal. No way of getting out clean on this one.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 是时候撤退了. 没办法利落地抽身了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to escape and complete the mission.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家撤离并完成任务。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the Assassination Target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是摧毁刺杀目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to stop the assassination target for escaping, the player will fail if the target escapes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求阻止刺杀目标逃脱，若目标逃脱则玩家失败。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The secondary objective to destroy an additional lance supporting the assassination target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 次要目标：摧毁支援刺杀目标的一支额外小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It's hard for me to overstate what a terrible idea it is to go into a mission with no terrain intel. There could be anything down there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 没有地形情报就出任务有多糟糕，我怎么强调都不过分。下面可能什么都有。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we need an immediate deployment. We've been in pursuit of a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} terrorist for months, and we've finally tracked them to this planet. They've gone to ground but earlier today one of our orbital units spotted them moving on the surface. This is the first verified sighting we've had of the target, and we want you to bring them down immediately, before they're able to slip away again. There hasn't been time to do a full survey of the AO, so you'll be going in blind.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们需要立即部署。我们追踪一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}恐怖分子已有数月，终于把他逼到了这颗星球。他已经藏匿起来，但今天早些时候我们的一个轨道单位发现他在地表活动。这是我们首次确认目击到目标，我们希望你能立刻把他拿下，别让他再次溜走。我们没时间对行动区域做完整勘察，所以你会是盲入。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mission accomplished. The terrorist is dead.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 任务完成. 恐怖份子死亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Readings indicate the ambushing units are out of commission. The employer will be pleased.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 读数显示伏击单位已失去作战能力。雇主会满意的。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器显示敌军动向超出我们最初的判断。请注意，你可能会遇到更强的抵抗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That is our target, sustain fire on that unit!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那就是我们的目标，对那个单位持续开火！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The target might make a break for it once you engage, Commander. Be ready to intercept if they run.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一旦你开始交战，目标可能会突围. 要是他们要跑，就准备拦截他们.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is the place, Commander. Meyer, can you see the target anywhere? We're blind on the ground.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就是这里，指挥官。迈耶，你能看到目标吗？我们在地面上没有视野。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Time to make a withdrawal. No way of pulling this one out of the fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 是时候撤退了. 没办法解决这个麻烦了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That extra lance of enemy forces is why I hate going in without intel. In any case, the terrorist is dead.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌军多出来的那支小队就是我讨厌没有情报时进场的原因. 总之，恐怖分子死了.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那就是我们的目标，对那个单位持续开火！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The target might make a break for it once you engage, Commander. Be ready to intercept if they run.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一旦你开始交战，目标可能会突围. 要是他们要跑，就准备拦截他们.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is the place, Commander. Meyer, can you see the target anywhere? We're blind on the ground.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就是这里，指挥官。迈耶，你能看到目标吗？我们在地面上没有视野。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: These days 'war criminal' basically means anyone on the other side of the battlefield. I wouldn't worry about that 'trial' comment. There won't be one.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如今"战争罪犯"基本上就是指站在战场另一边的人。我不会为那句"审判"的说法担心。根本不会有什么审判。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A wanted war criminal has been spotted on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Unfortunately, he appears to have integrated himself into a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}-aligned mercenary company. We need you to track him down and destroy his 'Mech. If he ejects, we'll take him into custody to be tried before a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} court. If not, no harm done - you'll be paid the same either way.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一名被通缉的战犯在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}被发现。不幸的是，他似乎已经混进了一支亲{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的雇佣兵公司。我们需要你把他揪出来并摧毁他的机甲。如果他弹射逃生，我们会把他收押，交由{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}法庭审判。如果没有，也没什么损失——两种情况下你的报酬都一样。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Kill confirmed, Commander - the target is down and you are cleared for extraction. Get to the rendezvous with the Leopard, and Sumire will bring you home.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That is our target, sustain fire on that unit!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那就是我们的目标，对那个单位持续开火！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're only contracted for a single target here, but we both know it won't be that easy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们在这里只签约打一个目标，但我们都知道事情不会这么简单。

Recent intelligence has revealed a possible location, but we can't possibly chase every lead with our thin resources. We need you to look into this long shot. If you find the spy, destroy them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已经在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}星系搜寻了数周，寻找一名拿走了不属于他们东西的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}间谍。最近的情报揭示了一个可能的位置，但以我们薄弱的人手不可能追查每一条线索。我们需要你去查一下这条希望渺茫的线索。如果你找到那名间谍，就消灭他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm not excited about taking on someone with The Professional's reputation with an under-strength lance, but at least we'll have the element of surprise.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我并不乐意带着一支兵力不足的分队去对付一个有"专家"那种名声的人，但至少我们握有奇袭之利。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The target we'd like your people to eliminate is a notorious killer-for-hire who goes by the name 'The Professional'. They're currently under contract with {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}, and they've been spotted here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, which is extremely concerning for our interests. This mercenary is cagey and cautious and will attempt escape at any indication that they're overmatched. We'd like you to land a low-tonnage lance to engage them, to give them a false sense of security, and then eliminate them before they can escape. We're prepared to offer very generous salvage terms.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们希望你们的人消灭的目标是一名臭名昭著的雇佣杀手，代号"专家"。他们目前受雇于{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}，并已在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}这里被发现，这对我们的利益极为不利。这名雇佣兵谨慎多疑，一有任何处于劣势的迹象就会试图逃跑。我们希望你们投放一支低吨位分队去交战，给他们一种虚假的安全感，然后在它们逃脱之前将其消灭。我们准备提供非常优厚的打捞条款。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A hit-and-run operation sounds straightforward enough, Commander. Just remember that if you get bogged down in fighting the escorts, escape is always an option.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一次打了就跑的行动，听起来够简单明了的了，指挥官. 只是记住如果你陷入了和护卫队的苦斗，撤退始终是一个选择.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, this mission should be simple. A {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} noble is participating in a patrol, as a show of support for the troops. She's insisted on using her ancestral family 'Mech, which is a Cicada CDA-2A. This should make eliminating her quite easy. Recognizing the danger, her handlers have sent along an extremely heavy supporting lance. If you're quick, and aggressive, you should be able to destroy her little Cicada before her escorts can react.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这次任务应该很简单。一位{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}贵族正在参加巡逻，以示对部队的支持。她坚持驾驶家族祖传的机甲，那是一台蝉 CDA-2A。这让除掉她变得相当容易。她的幕僚察觉到了危险，随行派出了一支极重型的支援小队。只要你动作够快、够凶狠，就能在她的护卫做出反应之前摧毁那台小小的蝉。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If I had to guess, Commander, I'd say the 'outlaw' part of this is just propaganda. Outlaw or not, though, the payout's the same for us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果要我猜，指挥官，我会说这其中"不法"那部分只是宣传。不过不管合法与否，对我们来说报酬都一样。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We are offering a sizeable bounty for the head of a local outlaw. The target is a rogue {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} MechWarrior who has attacked {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} personnel and facilities in this system. We need a mercenary company to find her and take her down before she takes out her aggressions on any more of our settlements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们要出一大笔赏金缉拿当地一名不法分子的首级. 目标是一名在这个星系中攻击了{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}人员和设施的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}恶棍机甲战士. 我们需要一家佣兵公司找到她，在她继续攻击我们的定居点之前把她干掉.
