Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，目标正在逃跑！在他们逃掉之前消灭他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Excellent work as always, Commander. When you get back, drinks are on me.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 工作一如既往的漂亮，指挥官. 你回来时，我请你喝一杯.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Find the target, take her out, and proceed to the LZ for evac. Good hunting, Commander. Oliveira out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 找到目标，干掉她，然后前往着陆区撤离. 狩猎顺利，指挥官. 奥利维拉完毕.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那就是我们的目标，对那个单位持续开火！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: There's only one target that matters on this drop, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这次投放只有一个目标要紧，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} MechWarrior is headed to a major military compound on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, where they'll take command of a company-sized 'Mech force, and become untouchable. They're en route to the encampment, but until they arrive, they're vulnerable.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}机师正前往{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}上的一处大型军事营地，在那里他们将接管一支连级机甲部队，从此不可触及。他们正在前往营地的路上，但在抵达之前，他们是脆弱的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An elite MechWarrior has been deployed to take command of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces in this system. We need a skilled mercenary force to remove this MechWarrior before they reach their command, while they're only lightly escorted. Every downed 'Mech will help our cause, so there will be a bonus for complete destruction of the target's supporting forces. Additionally, the MechWarrior's command may send out an escort unit to meet them; expect enemy reinforcements once you engage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一名精英机甲战士被派来接管该星系{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队的指挥权。我们需要一支技术娴熟的雇佣兵力量，在这名机甲战士抵达其指挥部之前、且只有轻装护卫时将其除掉。每击毁一台机甲都有助于我们的事业，因此彻底摧毁目标的护航部队还有奖金。此外，该机甲战士的指挥部可能会派出一支护航单位前来会合；一旦交战，预期会有敌方增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} needs this cleaned up quietly. Our intel shows the former commander has more loyal units than our employers will admit. This fight could escalate quickly, so stay alert.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}希望这件事能悄悄解决. 我们的情报显示，这位前任指挥官掌握的忠诚部队比雇主所承认的要多得多. 这场战斗可能会迅速升级，请保持警惕.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A former {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} commander, backed by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces, has set up his own government. To avoid any unwanted personnel conflicts, and to save our people the stress of fighting their former comrades, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} requires a Merc unit to remove this traitor and keep him from destroying his own people.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一名前{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}指挥官，在{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军队的支持下，建立了自己的政权. 为了避免不必要的人员冲突，并减轻我方人员与昔日同袍作战的压力，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}需要一支雇佣兵部队去除掉这个叛徒，防止他继续伤害自己的人民.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The target was far better prepared for us than our employers led us to believe. Time to dust off and call it even.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标所做的准备比我们雇主所说的还要充分. 是时候拍拍屁股到此为止了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With the backing of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}, this 'king' could prove to be a tough opponent.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Have you seen the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} holo-vid show \"Mercenaries\"? Yes, we're being asked to kill its star, Brock Armstrong. He knows his way around a 'Mech and will have two full lances as escorts.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你看过{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的全息剧集《雇佣兵》吗？没错，我们被要求杀掉它的主演，布洛克·阿姆斯特朗。他对机甲很在行，而且会有整整两支分队作为护卫。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has arranged for a holo-vid celebrity to visit {TGT_SYSTEM.name} in the hopes of rallying the morale of the local citizens. This is an opportunity for {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} psy-ops to instead make them understand how dangerous the region really is. Deploy your lance, find the target, eliminate him. Destroy his bodyguards if you feel so inclined.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}已经安排一位全息影视明星前往{TGT_SYSTEM.name}，以提升当地民众的士气. 这正是{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}心理战部队发挥作用的好机会，让他们真正明白这片区域有多危险. 派出你的小队，找到目标，消灭他. 如果你想的话，也可以一并消灭他的护卫.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've only got their word that this target is a terrorist, but that sort of extralegal maneuvering is why they're hiring us instead of using their own forces. Still, best to be alert for anything.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标是不是恐怖分子只有他们说了算，但正是这种法外操作才让他们雇我们而不是动用自己的部队。尽管如此，最好还是对任何事保持警觉。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've had confirmation from several sources that the leader of an insurgent cell backed by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} is moving in the open. This is a rare opportunity to take out one of the primary enemies of the legitimate {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} regime in {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Additionally, we'll include a bonus payment if you're able to destroy all of the target's escorting units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已从多个渠道得到确认，由{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}支持的叛乱小组头目正在公开活动。这是铲除{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的合法{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}政权的主要敌人之一的难得机会。此外，如果你能摧毁目标的全部护卫单位，我们还会有额外奖金。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得好，指挥官。我们去领钱吧。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I've negotiated a major bump if we DO end up finding the propagandist and eliminating her, as well as a danger-pay bonus if she has any escorts and we eliminate them as well.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果真能找到那名宣传员并除掉她，我已经谈妥了一笔可观的加价；如果她有护卫，而我们也一并清除，还有危险津贴奖金。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: For months, we've had trouble with people here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} being riled up by talk of insurrection, rebellion, independence. Based on top {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} analysts' reports, we believe there's a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} propagandist in the area, stirring up discontent. We've set up a security net to capture her. But we can't cover every possible exit from our net and could use an extra Lance of 'Mechs. If she tries to slip through your assigned territory, turn her unit to slag.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 数月来，{TGT_SYSTEM.name}这里的人一直被叛乱、起义、独立的言论煽动，令我们头疼。根据{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}顶尖分析师们的报告，我们相信这一带有一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}宣传员在煽动不满情绪。我们已布下一张安全网来抓她。但我们无法覆盖网中每一个可能的出口，所以需要一支额外的机甲分队。如果她试图从你的辖区溜过，就把她的单位熔成矿渣。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, this is the region we've been asked to patrol as part of the net.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这就是我们作为警戒网一部分负责巡逻的区域。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mission accomplished. The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} propagandist is dead.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 任务完成. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}宣传员死了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employers need us to keep an eye out for the propaganda agent, as this is one possible escape route she might take.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We had a deal with a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} MechWarrior here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. He helped out with some of our operations, and in turn we kept him supplied with things he couldn't get on the open market, if you know what I mean. But he's decided he's too good to work with us anymore. That's not okay. We want you to go down there and show him that it's not okay. He's probably gonna try to make a break for it. Don't let him escape.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们跟{TGT_SYSTEM.name}这里的一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}机师有过约定。他帮过我们一些行动的忙，作为交换，我们一直供应他一些他在公开市场上弄不到的东西，你懂我的意思。但他现在觉得自己不值得我们合作了。那可不行。我们要你下去让他明白这不行。他大概会试图跑路。别让他逃掉。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've lost three hidden supply bases on this ball of rock, Commander, and all three losses were thanks to one man, a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} MechWarrior tasked with tracking down our activities in this region. We're tired of letting him pick the time and place of battle, so we'd like you to give him a little surprise visit while he's on patrol. He'll be lightly defended but given his paranoia he'll probably have backup waiting nearby, so watch for an ambush.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们在这块石头球上丢了三处隐蔽补给基地，指挥官，而三次损失都归功于一个人——一名被派来追查我们在此区域活动的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}机师。我们受够了他来选定战斗的时间与地点，所以我们希望在他巡逻时给他一次小小的惊喜拜访。他的护卫很少，但鉴于他的多疑，附近大概会有后援等着，所以当心伏击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: From here, you should be able to get eyes on him, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 从这里，你应该可以看到他，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once he's down, head to the evac point for your pickup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他一倒下，就前往撤离点等待接运。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Target eliminated. Mop up the remaining enemies, or head for the evac LZ.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标已消灭. 扫荡剩下的敌人，或前往撤离区.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That is our target, sustain fire on that unit!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那就是我们的目标，对那个单位持续开火！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a disaster. Commander, I'm pulling the plug on this operation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是场灾难。指挥官，我要中止这次行动。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: His 'Mech may be heavy, Commander, but I don't see a lot of 'Mech repair facilities out here, so this might not be as difficult as it looks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他的机甲可能很重，指挥官，但我在这一带看不到多少机甲维修设施，所以这也许不像看上去那么难。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our spies report that a veteran {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} MechWarrior from the Succession Wars retired to this system, and {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} would very much like to keep him retired. Permanently if possible. We've been monitoring a DropShip in orbit around the planet, and believe that they're preparing for a pickup. We need you to drop and intercept this MechWarrior before he can be reactivated. He's likely in a fairly heavy 'Mech, so be careful when you engage him.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的间谍报告，一名继承战争时期的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}老兵机师退役定居在这个星系，而{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}非常希望让他保持退役状态。如果可能的话是永久性的。我们一直在监视轨道上的一艘空投艇，相信他们正准备接人。我们需要你降下去，在这名机师被重新启用之前拦截他。他大概驾驶着一台相当重的机甲，所以交战时小心。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I have a bad feeling about this, Commander. If they want that 'Mech torched, I'm guessing it's relatively powerful. Be careful.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我有不好的预感，指挥官。如果他们想烧掉那台机甲，我猜它相当强大。小心点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of our covert facilities was breached, Commander, in what appears to have been an inside job. A MechWarrior stationed there murdered the rest of the staff and is defecting to {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, taking a valuable {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 'Mech with her. The facility is a total loss, but we don't want that 'Mech falling into enemy hands. Track down the renegade and destroy her 'Mech. We believe she's being escorted by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces, and there's a bonus if you destroy them as well.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们的一处秘密设施被突破了，看样子是内部人员所为。驻守在那里的一名机甲战士杀害了其余工作人员，并叛逃到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}，还带走了一台宝贵的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}机甲。设施已彻底损毁，但我们绝不能让那台机甲落入敌手。找到这名叛徒并摧毁她的机甲。我们认为她正由{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队护送，若你将其一并摧毁，还有额外奖励。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这伙走私者敢采取如此大胆的行动，我们最好假设他们不止有一支象征性部队在那儿. 准备好应付任何情况.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Smugglers funded by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} have set up just outside our borders, causing an ongoing problem for {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} operations. We'd like to cut the head off this particular snake with a targeted, limited, and deniable strike on their leader. Ideally, this will shut them down permanently.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 受{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}资助的走私者在我们的边界外扎了营，持续给{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的行动制造麻烦。我们想对这条毒蛇来个斩首行动：一次精准、有限且可否认的打击，直取他们的头目。若能如愿，这将永久终结他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Buckle up, Commander. This sounds like an extremely tough fight. You know something this valuable is going to be escorted.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 做好准备，指挥官. 听起来这像是一场极其艰苦的战斗. 你知道有些珍贵的东西要护送.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We periodically survey 'empty' worlds just to be certain there's no unexpected activity on them. This time, we got lucky. A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} surveillance team picked up {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} signals from the surface of {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} that correspond to a very heavy 'Mech running through a test-fire sequence. We suspect the enemy is taking the 'Mech out for proving trials, figuring the planet is uninhabited. If we can locate and intercept this 'Mech, we can keep a powerful piece of hardware out of enemy hands.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们定期勘察“空置”星球，只为确认那里没有意外活动。这次我们运气不错。一支{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}监视小队从{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}地表接收到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}信号，对应一台正在跑试射序列的超重型机甲。我们怀疑敌人认为该星球无人居住，正把这台机甲开出来做验证试车。如果我们能定位并拦截这台机甲，就能让一件强力硬件不落入敌手。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Unit One of Player Lance Must Survive
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 玩家小队中的一号单位必须存活

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A lance of hostile {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} has landed nearby.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队已在附近着陆。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another enemy lance in the AO, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 任务区的另一个敌方长枪，指挥官.
又一项任务圆满完成.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Argo, our facility is taking fire over here. We need you to draw that fire off, or we're dead!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔戈，我们这边的设施正在遭到射击。我们需要你引开火力，否则我们就死定了！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Argo, our forces are ready to assist in defending the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔戈号，我们的部队已准备好协助保卫基地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Argo, we're under heavy-- [static]-- hold out-- [static]
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔戈，我们遭到猛烈—— [静电] ——坚守—— [静电]

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Argo, we've taken control of the facility. You need to keep it intact and neutralize the attackers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿戈号，我们已控制该设施。你需要让它保持完好并消灭进攻者。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As long as you're still in the AO, Commander, you'll need to keep the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} base secure.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 只要你还待在作战区域，指挥官，你就得确保 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 基地安全。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} reinforcements are inbound to this location.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 增援正前往此处。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Leopard just dropped another lance into the AO.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，一只豹子{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}刚刚在任务区投下了另一支长枪.
指挥官，已识别敌方炮塔。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I'm seeing hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} units in the area. Our target brought in allies for backup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我发现区域内有敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 单位。我们的目标叫来了盟友助阵。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, more hostiles are entering the area. I've marked their LZ.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，更多敌人正进入区域。我已标出他们的着陆区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we've completed all the primary objectives and you're clear to extract.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们已完成所有主要目标，你可以撤离了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we've got an enemy lance moving towards the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，有一支敌方小队正朝 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 基地移动。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good job, commander. All primary objectives complete. Get to evac, Sumire will pick you up here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得好，指挥官。所有主要目标已完成。前往撤离点，苏米尔会在这里接你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up, commander, a lance of {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} units just entered the area. They're hostile to everyone!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，一支 {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队刚进入区域。他们对所有人敌对！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If we decide to kill these units our employer if offering a bonus.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们决定干掉这些单位，我们的雇主会提供奖励。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If we destroy them we'll get a hefty bonus.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们摧毁他们，会得到一笔可观的奖励。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm on station to pick you up here whenever you're ready, boss.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我已就位，你随时准备好我就在这里接你，老板。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer is offering us some extra cash if we destroy these units too.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们把这些单位也摧毁，雇主会额外给我们一笔钱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer is saying we NEED to kill those units. Prepare to engage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主说我们"必须"干掉那些单位。准备交战。
又解决一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's the first target structure down, Commander. Keep up the pressure.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 第一处目标结构已倒下，指挥官。继续保持压力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We can't complete the contract until those units are destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那些单位不被摧毁，我们就完不成合同。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We'll have to destroy that lance if we want to complete the mission.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 想完成任务，我们得摧毁那支小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: When you're ready to extract, Sumire will pick you up at this location.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你准备撤离时，苏米尔会在这个位置接你。
第二位挑战者已抵达!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Entering the arena is contender number 3!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 进入竞技场的是3号挑战者!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Contender number 4 is joining the rumble!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 4号挑战者正在加入近战!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Contender number 5 has entered the fray!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 5号挑战者已加入战局!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Contender number 6 has arrived, marking the last to join the fight!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 6号挑战者已抵达，标志着最后一位参战者已加入战斗!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Friendly forces are engaging hostile units.  The survival of the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} isn't our main concern, but in a combat zone, strength in numbers matters.  We'll offer support where we can --- keeping them in the fight longer gives us a better shot at earning a bonus.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 友军正在与敌方单位交战。{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的存亡并非我们主要关心的事，但在战区里，人多势众自有其道理。我们会在力所能及处提供支援——让他们撑得越久，我们拿到奖金的机会就越大。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} are dead set on taking over {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}'s territory.  A small group of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}-aligned troops is holding down a key spot, and it's our job to back them up.  Link up with them and push back any {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces that come your way.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}铁了心要夺取{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的领地。一小股{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}阵营部队正守住一处关键地点，我们的任务是为他们提供后援。与他们建立联系，并击退任何朝你们逼来的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Friendly units are moving in to hit the enemy.  Link up with them and try to stall the enemy advance as long as you can.  Just don't push too far out there, Commander --- stay sharp.  Good luck.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 友军单位正在推进打击敌人。与他们建立联系，尽可能久地拖延敌军推进。只是别推得太靠前，指挥官——保持警觉。祝好运。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're heading straight into the thick of it, Commander.  Watch each other's backs, hold off the enemy as long as you can, then get the hell out.  We'll be standing by for your extraction.  Good hunting out there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们正一头扎进最激烈的中心，指挥官。互相照应，尽可能久地拖住敌人，然后就赶紧撤。我们会待命接应你们。祝狩猎顺利。
<color=#FAD02C>超神杀戮！！！</color>

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up, Commander.  Ally command says enemy forces could hit your location any moment now.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官. 友军指挥部说敌军随时可能袭击你们的位置.
更多{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}敌军正在向你处移动.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enemies are closing in --- better brace yourself, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌人正在逼近——最好做好准备，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They've made you, Commander.  Multiple tangos converging on your location.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你被发现了，指挥官。多个目标正向你的位置汇聚。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like you stirred things up, Commander.  More hostiles are on the way!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来你捅了马蜂窝了，指挥官. 更多敌军正在赶来!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Well, you sure got their attention.  I'm showing multiple hostiles incoming on your position.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好吧，你确实引起了他们的注意。我这边显示多个敌人正向你的位置逼近。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forward intel have spotted more bogeys heading your way.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的前沿情报发现更多目标正在向你处移动.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You've definitely riled them up, Commander.  Incoming hostiles!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你确实把他们激怒了，指挥官。敌人来了！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've got more bogeys locking in on your location.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又有更多不明目标锁定你的位置。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up!  More {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} hostiles are on the move.  They're en route to your position!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意！更多{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}敌人正在移动。他们正朝你的位置来！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Additional contacts near the perimeter, Commander.  Brace for contact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 防线附近有更多接触信号，指挥官. 准备接敌.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've got enemies operating in the area.  Keep your eyes open.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们有敌人在这一带活动。睁大眼睛。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enemy reinforcements detected nearby.  They're moving toward your position.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 探测到附近有敌方增援。他们正向你的位置移动。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are advancing --- prepare for engagement.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队正在推进——准备接战.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Your resistance is pulling in additional hostiles around you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你的抵抗正在吸引周围更多的敌人.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Contact!  Multiple {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} hostiles inbound on your position.  Get ready for contact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 接敌! 多个{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}敌军正在向你的位置移动. 准备交战.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Scopes are picking up more bogies, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 测距仪捕捉到更多目标，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 双倍容量弹药箱; 每吨额外增加 10% 弹药量.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enhanced LRM Launchers cannot fire any Specialty Ammunition types. Only basic LRM ammunition will work in missions.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 强化的LRM发射器无法发射任何特种弹药. 任务中仅可使用基础LRM弹药.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Follow-the-Leader Missiles primarily strike the same location on the target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 跟随式导弹优先打击目标上的同一部位.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Guided Ammunition: Gains {0} accuracy if the target is being painted by a TAG. {1} accuracy otherwise.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 制导弹药: 若目标被TAG标记，则获得 {0} 精度; 否则精度 {1}.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: High-Explosive Armor-Piercing: Does a large amount of armor piercing damage at the cost of reduced total damage and less area-of-effect damage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 高爆穿甲弹: 以降低总伤害和范围伤害为代价，可造成大量穿甲伤害.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Inert ammo; does not cook off or explode.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 惰性弹药; 不会因过热而殉爆或爆炸.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Listen-Kill missiles have active targeting: {0} more likely to be intercepted by AMS.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Solid Slug ammo is ineffective against most combat units, but deals a lot of stability damage and is effective against buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 实心独头弹药对大多数战斗单位效果不佳，但能造成大量稳定性伤害，且对建筑物效果显著.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Swarm Missile: Indirect fire; spreads cluster bombs in target area.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蜂群导弹: 间接射击; 在目标区域散布集束炸弹.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This ammunition can deal critical hits, even if the base weapon cannot.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这种弹药可以造成暴击，即使基础武器不能.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This ammunition type can cause wider misses due to smaller margins of error in targeting calculations.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这种弹药因瞄准计算容错范围较小，可能导致更大的偏差.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Minefield has an IFF System and will not detonate on allies.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: When on burning ground, these mines laugh at you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 当处于燃烧地面上时，这些地雷会嘲笑你.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Somehow I doubt there's a lost 'Mech factory on this backwater world. It probably manufactures low-g bicycles or something else useless.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我有点怀疑这颗穷乡僻壤上会有什么失落的机甲工厂。它大概生产低重力自行车或者别的什么没用的东西。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} patrol detected unexpected signals here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, and we'd like you to investigate. Analysis suggests that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has reactivated an abandoned factory on the planet's surface. We don't know what this particular facility was used for, but given the effort they're sinking into this, it must be valuable. We want it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一支{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}巡逻队在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}这里探测到意外信号，我们希望你去调查。分析表明{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}重新启用了行星表面一座废弃工厂。我们不知道这处特定设施原来是干什么用的，但鉴于他们投入的力气，它一定很有价值。我们想要它。

祝你好运，指挥官。奥利韦拉通话结束。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The base is ours, Commander. Well done.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这座基地是我们的了，指挥官. 做得不错.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The facility looks unoccupied save for some automated turrets, Commander. If we can bust those defenses and get inside the perimeter, our employer can send in their salvage crews to take control.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这座设施看来还没有被占领，除了一些自动炮台. 如果我们打破那些防御力量并进入周界，我们的雇主就可以派遣他们的回收人员接管控制.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Turrets. Remember they can spot you from a very long way off, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 炮台. 请记住它们能在很远的距离上发现你，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're here to capture the abandoned factory.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们来夺取这座废弃工厂。
谈判筹码

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a general objective to indicate the player must keep playing and eliminate enemies as they come.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一个通用目标，表示玩家必须继续作战并消灭陆续出现的敌人。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm not sure the outcome will be what they want, but I don't specialize in interstellar politics. It sounds like a declaration of war to me so be prepared for more than a little resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我不确定结果是否会如他们所愿，但星际政治并非我的专长。在我看来，这听起来就像一份宣战书，所以请做好准备，抵抗恐怕不会小。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Trade negotiations between {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} and {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} have broken down. We believe that if we capture and hold a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} military base in the {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} system, we will be able to force them back to the negotiating table. Your job is to take the base and hold it until our forces can occupy it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}和{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}之间的贸易谈判破裂了. 我们相信，如果我们夺取一座位于{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军事基地，就能迫使他们重返谈判桌. 你的任务是拿下基地，并坚守直到我们的部队能够进驻.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I don't buy the 'ancestral fortress' part of this, but the legal maneuverings check out. Commander, a merc company coming in could resolve this quickly and prevent a large-scale conflict.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我不买"祖传要塞"那部分的说法，但法律上的运作倒是查得通。指挥官，来一家雇佣兵公司就能快速解决此事，避免一场大规模冲突。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} family lost a large area of land on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, thanks to dubious legal maneuvering by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} agents. This land includes an important ancestral military base. We need this base taken back from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} and held until this can be sorted out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由于{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}代理人可疑的法律操作，一个{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}家族在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}失去了大片土地. 这片土地上有一座重要的祖传军事基地. 我们需要从{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}手中夺回这座基地，并坚守到问题解决为止.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这就是“祖传堡垒”? 对我来说，这看起来像是一座现代化，可以运作的军事基地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we're preparing a series of operations on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. We've identified a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} military facility that will be ideal for our purposes. We need you to land a strike force, capture the facility, and hold it until we can bring down our people to secure the location. Because this operation is covert and on an extremely tight schedule, you'll be inserting with no topographical intel.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This should be straightforward. Move up, recon the depot, and then occupy it. Once we secure the area, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} will send in their people to loot the place.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这应该很简单明了. 前进，侦察仓库，然后占领它. 一旦我们拿下了这块地方，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}就会派他们的人洗劫这里.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've been tracking the movement of several {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} convoys, and that's allowed us to pinpoint their destinations: a hidden, well-defended logistics depot. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The legal justification here sounds sketchy, Commander, but we're mercenaries, not lawyers. As long as they're happy, we get paid.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这里的法律依据听起来很可疑，指挥官，但我们自己是雇佣兵，不是律师。只要他们满意，我们就能拿到钱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've learned that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have constructed a forward base on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, ignoring the express wishes of the local government. Naturally, the planetary governor is furious, but he can't make a stand against {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} BattleMechs without assistance; {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} has offered that assistance. You are to seize control of the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base and hold it until we gain a legal claim to the facility. We will then sell it back to the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} government at a considerable discount.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们得知{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队无视当地政府的明确意愿，在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上建起了一处前进基地。行星总督自然震怒，但没有援助他无法对抗{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}战斗机甲；{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}已提出提供这一援助。你要夺取{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}基地的控制权并守住它，直到我们获得该设施的合法所有权。届时我们将以相当大的折扣把它卖回给{TGT_SYSTEM.name}政府。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This should be straightforward. Move up, recon the depot, and then occupy it. Once we secure the area, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} will send in their people to loot the place.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这应该很简单明了. 前进，侦察仓库，然后占领它. 一旦我们拿下了这块地方，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}就会派他们的人洗劫这里.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Spazz is a nasty, nasty drug, Commander, but not really recreational in any way. If some MechWarrior wants to burn themself out on the stuff, that's on them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 疯狂是一种非常、非常凶险的药物，指挥官，根本算不上什么娱乐品。如果某个机师想把自己烧在这玩意儿上，那是他自己的事。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've been following this shipment of Spazz that the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} authorities here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} intercepted. You'd think that, given all the things they say about Spazz, they'd have torched the stuff already. But instead they've locked it up in a secure depot. I'm sure they won't mind if we take that stuff off their hands. We have much better uses for it than just blowing it all up.

A month ago, an orbiting spy satellite picked up signs that the facility had been brought back online. Our current guess is that a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} team was dispatched to bring the base back up to operational capacity. We'd rather not have sensitive radar backed by armed turrets and flak batteries aimed at the skies of {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. We'd like you to clear their team out and hold the facility while our own people land to scour it for useful intel.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 十五年前我们失去了{TGT_SYSTEM.name}这里一处设施的踪迹，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}情报部门相信它已被永久关停。一个月前，一颗轨道间谍卫星捕捉到该设施被重新上线的迹象。我们目前的猜测是，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}派出一支小队来让基地恢复运作能力。我们并不希望有敏感雷达配着武装炮塔和高射炮组瞄准{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的天空。我们希望你去清掉他们的小队并守住该设施，直到我们自己的人降落来搜寻有用情报。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've recently discovered a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} military outpost in an extremely inconvenient location, strangling trade and movement for our personnel in the area. Your mission: eliminate enemy defenses, then capture and hold the base long enough for {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces to take possession. We'll support your action by drawing off some of the defenders ahead of time, so if these units retreat to the base, they'll already be weakened by our troops.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I expect the defenses on the facility to be substantial. But if we were bothered by the odds, we wouldn't be mercenaries.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我预计那座设施的防御相当可观。但要是我们会为胜算发愁，我们就不会当雇佣兵了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've learned that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} has been busy working on a new water filtration technology, which is both extremely valuable and likely to shift the balance of power in the region by opening up more worlds for colonization. We've discovered where they're working on the latest prototype. We know that they are monitoring the location of our own 'Mechs in the area, so we need a mercenary lance to make the vanguard assault and catch them by surprise. We'll then take over the facility with {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们得知{TGT_SYSTEM.name}这里的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}一直在忙于研发一种新的水过滤技术，它既极其宝贵，又可能通过开辟更多可殖民世界来改变该地区的力量平衡。我们已经查清他们在哪里研发最新原型。我们知道他们正在监视我方机甲在该地区的动向，所以需要一支雇佣兵分队打头阵突击，杀他们一个措手不及。随后我们将以{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}部队接管该设施。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 从天涯海角弄来的情报能有多大用处？反正我们照样拿钱，说实话我觉得无所谓。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Unremarkable, empty systems like this one are the perfect location for covert intelligence gathering operations. We believe there's a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility here on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} doing exactly that. Monitoring the pattern of DropShips making landings on the planet has led {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} analysts to a remote, apparently empty facility. Until just a few days ago, when we picked up the unmasked signature of a 'Mech's fusion engine powering up. That facility isn't empty, and we want the data stored there.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, if these are just mercantile goods, as they say, I wouldn't expect very aggressive defenses.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，如果这些真如他们所说只是商用货物，我不会指望有多么猛烈的防御。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Apparently {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} controls a network of transports and warehouses in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system, moving mostly mundane merchandise but also a very few highly valuable goods. Our clandestine research efforts have acquired the latest shipping manifests and identified an opportunity for a swift, profitable strike at a key shipping hub. If timed properly, your Mechs can attack quickly and pave the way for a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} extraction team to empty the warehouse of its contents.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 显然，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}控制着{TGT_SYSTEM.name}星系的一张运输和仓储网络，运送的大部分是普通货物，但也有少数高价值货物. 我们的秘密调查获取了最新的运输清单，并发现了对一个关键运输枢纽进行快速且高收益打击的机会. 如果时机掌握得当，你的机甲就能迅速发起攻击，为{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的回收小队搬空仓库里的物资铺平道路.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'll ask the obvious question: how do we know they won't just keep the bioweapons for themselves? Then again, if we second guessed every job, we'd be broke.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我要问那个显而易见的问题：我们怎么知道他们不会把生物武器留给自己？话又说回来，如果我们每份活都这么疑神疑鬼，早就饿死了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've got a developing situation, Commander, and we need immediate aid from a reliable mercenary company. A covert {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} team was investigating reports of a cache of bioweapons on an otherwise abandoned world. We've tracked down four of these caches in the Periphery over the last 20 years, and disposed of them safely. The team was about to signal for an extraction when their signal went dead. We have reason to believe that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have taken control of the cache site, and eliminated our covert team. We need you to take that site and signal our disposal team.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，情况正在发展，我们需要一家可靠雇佣兵公司的立即援助。一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}秘密小队正在调查一处据称存放生物武器储藏点的废弃世界。过去二十年里我们在外围地区追查到四处这类储藏点并安全销毁。小队正准备发出撤离信号时失联了。我们有理由相信{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队已控制了储藏点现场并消灭了我们的秘密小队。我们需要你夺取该现场并向我们的处置小组发信号。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're training a group of MechWarriors to act as a local defense force, and we'd like you to assist in their training. There's a decommissioned {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base that we need to take ownership of. As it's undefended, this is a perfect opportunity for our trainees to practice operating as a team in a low-risk environment. We need you to send along a single experienced MechWarrior to keep an eye on them and model good behavior for them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们正在训练一批机甲战士，让他们担任本地防御部队，希望你能协助他们的训练。有一处已退役的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}基地需要我们接手。由于该基地没有防御，这正是我们的受训人员练习团队协作的绝佳低风险机会。我们需要你派出一名经验丰富的机甲战士随行，照看他们并为他们树立良好的榜样。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是侦察即将被夺取的基地。必须在真正占领基地之前完成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the force that tries to remove the player from the captured base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁试图把玩家赶出已占领基地的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This seems like a mission where afterwards we'll say 'It was supposed to be undefended!', Commander. Be prepared.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这看起来像是那种任务——完事之后我们会说'它本该是无人防守的！'，指挥官。做好准备。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're training a group of MechWarriors to act as a local defense force, and we'd like you to assist in their training. There's a decommissioned {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} base that we need to take ownership of. As it's undefended, this is a perfect opportunity for our trainees to practice operating as a team in a low-risk environment. We need you to send along a single experienced MechWarrior to keep an eye on them and model good behavior for them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们正在训练一批机甲战士，让他们担任本地防御部队，希望你能协助他们的训练。有一处已退役的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}基地需要我们接手。由于该基地没有防御，这正是我们的受训人员练习团队协作的绝佳低风险机会。我们需要你派出一名经验丰富的机甲战士随行，照看他们并为他们树立良好的榜样。
雇主的盟友
对所有势力敌对
对所有人中立
玩家 1
玩家 2
用友方机甲占领基地
夺取已退役的基地.
摧毁敌军
摧毁敌方增援
消灭基地炮塔

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hold Out as Enemies Counter Attack
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在敌军反攻时坚守

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Pacify the Area around the Base
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 肃清基地周边区域
侦察基地

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Area is not clear, Commander. Eliminate the hostiles before continuing to the next Objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 区域尚未肃清，指挥官。先消灭敌人再前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: [GENERIC VO] Sensors are clear, proceed to the next objective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 传感器无异常，前往下一个目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Aww, really? Come on, I want more targets!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 噢，真的吗? 来吧，我要更多目标!
传感器发现不明目标！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Can we blow up some of the buildings?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们能炸掉一些建筑吗?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Get your lance into that base, Commander, and hold out till our employer can get some more people on the ground.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 派你的小队进入那座基地，指挥官，在我们雇主派更多人到地面之前守住.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I think these kids could use some more time on the practice range.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我想这些孩子本可以在靶场花上更多时间的.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: So all we gotta do is just walk in there and stand around? This job sounds like bullshit to me. I wanna learn how to shoot, not stand around!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 所以我们只要走进去站着不动就行? 这活听起来像胡扯. 我想学怎么开枪，不是站着发呆!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Stow it, Meyer. It all worked out fine, and we get paid.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 别说啦，梅耶尔. 结局不错，我们也拿到了钱.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That sucks. Can I shoot some of the buildings anyway?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 真无聊. 无论如何我能不能朝些建筑打几枪?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Well... that certainly was an experience. Darius, I think we should get hazard pay for this kind of mission.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好吧...这真是一次难忘的经历. 达吕斯，我觉得这种任务我们该收取危险津贴.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Yes. Why, do you have something?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 是的. 怎么了，你发现什么了吗?
夭折的殖民地

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Capture Convoy Rally Point and Escort Convoy to Safety
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 占领车队集结点并护送车队至安全地带

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Friendly units to their Destination
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送友军单位前往目的地

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy hunter lance for mission complete.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭猎人小队来完成任务.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect the all units in Convoy during Extraction, suffering no losses.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在撤离过程中保护车队全部单位，不遭受任何损失。
确保车队集结点安全

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy enemy units which will attempt to block the convoy from reaching its destination.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求摧毁试图阻止车队抵达目的地的敌方单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to escape with all the player units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求所有玩家单位成功撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: My guess is that there was a credible threat made on the colony, and that's why they're pulling out. Expect fighting, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我猜是殖民地受到了可信的威胁，所以他们才撤离。准备战斗，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This system was targeted as part of a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} expansion plan. Unfortunately, the colonial plan fell through, and we now have to extract our people from the planet's surface before they're intercepted by hostile forces. As the colony was a secret, thanks to the conflicting and dubious claims on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, we cannot be seen to mount a major rescue operation. We need a deniable middle-man.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这个星系是{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}扩张计划的目标之一。不幸的是，殖民计划落空了，我们现在必须在殖民者被敌对势力拦截之前，把他们从行星表面撤出来。由于对{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}存在互相矛盾且可疑的主权声索，而该殖民地本是秘密，我们不能公开进行一次大规模救援行动。我们需要一个可否认的中间人。
玩家 1
玩家 2

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送车队至安全地带并撤离
前往撤离区

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy hunter lance for mission complete.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭猎人小队来完成任务.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect Convoy as they Embark on the Dropship
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保护车队登上空投舰
在空投舰抵达期间保护车队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们走了！车队已安全离开作战区域。干得好，指挥官。现在把你剩余的部队带到第二撤离区进行撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander. The enemy has deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官。敌方已派出增援，正在途中。预计抵抗会增强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Keep in mind that the convoy will try to stay near you for protection. Continue advancing to get them to the extract point!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 请记住，车队会尽量靠近你寻求保护。继续推进，把他们带到撤离点！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The colonists have assembled into a convoy of vehicles.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 殖民者已经集合到一支车队里了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The survivors of the failed colony are safely away, Commander. Good job.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那些沦陷殖民地的幸存者已经安全离开了，指挥官. 干得好.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a disaster. We need to review the mission logs and see what went wrong.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这真是一场灾难. 我们需要回顾任务日志看看哪里出错了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there are keep them safe until we can get them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你已抵达目标车辆的撤离点。守住那里，在我们把他们弄出去之前保护好他们。
弹药车队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to escape with all the player units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求所有玩家单位成功撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Not much to say, Commander. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} made a tactical fumble, and we're going to bail them out. The convoy lead is privately offering to make sure a few crates of ammo 'fall off the truck' if we get them home.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 没什么好说的，指挥官。{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}在战术上搞砸了，而我们要去把他们捞出来。车队领队私下表示，如果我们把他们送回家，他可以保证让几箱弹药“从车上掉下来”。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've had reports of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} activity near one of our outlying bases. Unfortunately, we already have a military supply convoy in the field, and it will be easy prey for a force of 'Mechs. We need you to rendezvous with the convoy and protect it while it's being evacuated.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们收到报告称在我们一处边远基地附近有{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}活动。不幸的是，我们已有一支军用补给车队在外，它会很容易成为一支机甲部队的猎物。我们需要你与车队会合，并在它撤离期间提供保护。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You heard those scare quotes didn't you boss? Civilian Liaison means Spec Ops. They're in a rush so I got them to promise a few crates of ammo would 'fall off the truck' as a bonus.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你听到那些意味深长的引号了吧老板？“平民联络官”就是特种作战。他们很急，所以我让他们承诺让几箱弹药“从车上掉下来”作为额外报酬。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of our Civilian Liaison Teams has acquired a recently former {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} ammunition depot following the sudden death of much of the staff in an unfortunate incident. We removing the ammunition to a secure location lest if fall into the wrong hands. Your company is to provide security during the extraction.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的一支平民联络队接管了一座不久前还属于{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的弹药库，此前库内大部分人员在一起不幸的事故中突然丧生. 我们正在将弹药转移至安全地点，以免落入不法之徒手中. 你们佣兵连的任务是在转移期间提供安保.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们走了！车队已安全离开作战区域。干得好，指挥官。现在把你剩余的部队带到第二撤离区进行撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander. The enemy has deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官。敌方已派出增援，正在途中。预计抵抗会增强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Keep in mind that the convoy will try to stay near you for protection. Continue advancing to get them to the extract point!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 请记住，车队会尽量靠近你寻求保护。继续推进，把他们带到撤离点！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The ammunition depot is just up ahead, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弹药库就在前方，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there are keep them safe until we can get them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你已抵达目标车辆的撤离点。守住那里，在我们把他们弄出去之前保护好他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy enemy units which will attempt to block the convoy from reaching its destination.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求摧毁试图阻止车队抵达目的地的敌方单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the force of enemies which will try and stop the player from reaching the rally point.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求摧毁试图阻止玩家抵达集结点的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to escape with all the player units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求所有玩家单位成功撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Rumor has it that the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} have been smuggling restricted munitions in among their medical supplies. On the surface, at least, we're being tasked with a humanitarian escort mission.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传言说{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}一直在把受管制弹药藏在他们的医疗物资里偷运。至少表面上，我们接到的任务是执行一次人道主义护送任务。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Contravening all decency and acceptable behavior on the battlefield, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has been targeting our hospitals and medical supplies. We're seeking to redistribute our supplies to safer locations, but one convoy remains without a proper escort. That's where you come in. While {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces will be stretched thin, attempting to intercept all of our separate shipments, you can expect that this one will not go unnoticed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}违反一切战场底线与可接受行为，一直在攻击我们的医院与医疗物资。我们正设法把补给重新分配到更安全的地点，但有一支车队仍缺乏适当的护航。这就轮到你了。虽然{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队会疲于拦截我们各批分散的货运，但你可以预料到这一批不会被忽视。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: When I hear 'rapid' and 'immediate', I'm thinking 'no intel' and 'expect nasty surprises', Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 听到“迅速”和“立即”，我就想到“没有情报”和“准备好迎接可怕意外”，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Less than an hour ago, we lost contact with a covert team tasked with infiltrating a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility. The only reason for them not to respond is if their operation was blown, by discovery or counterintelligence. The research materials they were meant to collect are extremely important, and we can't afford to lose them. We need you to make a rapid and immediate deployment to the the facility, and get our people and their cargo to safety.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 不到一小时前，我们与一支奉命潜入 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 设施的秘密小队失去了联系。他们不回应的唯一可能，就是行动已经暴露——无论是被察觉，还是被反间谍部门识破。他们原本要取回的研究资料极其重要，我们绝不能失去它们。我们需要你立即快速部署到该设施，把我们的人和货物安全撤出。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mercenary force, you are entering a restricted {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} area. Withdraw or you will be fired on.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雇佣兵部队，你们正进入{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的限制区域. 立刻撤离，否则将对你们开火.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The covert team and the research materials are safe. Well done, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 秘密小组和研究材料都安全了. 做得不错，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Try not to get any of them shot or stepped on. Good luck.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 设法别让他们中的任何一个挨枪或被踩踏. 祝你好运.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have an LZ marked for you. Is your team ready to move?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已经为你们标记了着陆区. 你们的队伍准备好出发了吗?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The covert team and the research materials are safe. Well done, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 秘密小组和研究材料都安全了. 做得不错，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Try not to get any of them shot or stepped on. Good luck.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这事可能比{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}说的要复杂，但我们的任务仅限于护送一支运兵车队到撤离点。剩下的情况是别人的问题。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our research facility on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} has been under constant attack from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces for some time. Rather than continue to risk their lives, we are evacuating the noncombatants. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} will pay handsomely for a mercenary unit to protect them from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} aggression.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一段时间以来，我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的研究设施一直受到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}势力的攻击. 我们不愿意让非战斗人员继续冒着生命危险，我们决定撤离他们. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}将为雇佣兵部队提供丰厚报酬，以保护他们免受{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的攻击.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, if that Demolisher has ammo on board, this could be a short and simple mission. Those things are terrifying.

We have people in place prepared to steal those vehicles, but without 'Mechs providing an escort, they'll be attacked as soon as {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} command notices they're leaving without orders. Get the vehicles to an extraction point, and keep them intact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}当局最近接收了一批军用车辆，其中包括一辆可作战的破坏者。这代表该星球上不可接受的军力集结，但也给了我们机会。我们已有人手准备偷走那些车辆，但若没有机甲护航，一旦{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}指挥部发现它们未经命令离营，就会立刻遭到攻击。把这些车辆送到撤离点，并保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Assuming the hostages are still alive, we're going to have a hell of a time keeping them that way.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} DropShip went down on this empty rock, and shortly thereafter we detected a distress signal from the surface. By the time we arrived, the crew had been taken captive by a heavily armed {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force. We don't have an in-system military presence large enough to mount a hostage rescue mission, so we're looking for a competent mercenary company to do it. We need you to reach the facility where the crew is being held, destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units guarding them, and escort them to safety.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander. The enemy has deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官。敌方已派出增援，正在途中。预计抵抗会增强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Expect serious resistance, now that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are alert for a rescue attempt.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 预计会遭遇激烈抵抗，因为{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队已经警觉，准备应对营救行动.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm getting radio chatter from the facility, Commander. It sounds like the crew has staged an uprising.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我收到设施的无线电通话，指挥官。听起来船员发动了起义。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Keep in mind that the convoy will try to stay near you for protection. Continue advancing to get them to the extract point!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 请记住，车队会尽量靠近你寻求保护。继续推进，把他们带到撤离点！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The crew is safely back in orbit, Commander. Well done.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 船员安全地返回了轨道，指挥官. 做得不错.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We need to get to their location and secure the area so they can make their escape.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们需要抵达他们的位置，拿下这一地区，这样他们就可以逃走了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there are keep them safe until we can get them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你已抵达目标车辆的撤离点。守住那里，在我们把他们弄出去之前保护好他们。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求所有玩家单位成功撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm sure that the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} rep thinks they're very clever, but this kind of headhunting is serious. We should expect the enemy to shoot to kill.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我相信{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的那位代表觉得自己很聪明，但这种猎首行动是严肃的事。我们应该料到敌人会下死手。

We've already pacified the base, and {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} made very firm job offers to the scientists at the facility. Almost all of them have accepted. We need to evacuate those scientists before their previous employers hear about their new positions.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Desperation is good for business. I'd guess a broken cease-fire means we're likely to encounter military units on our way to the pickup; stay alert, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 绝望对生意有利。我猜停火协议被破坏意味着我们前往接应点的路上很可能遇到军事单位；保持警觉，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A convoy of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} doctors ministering to those recovering from the recent conflicts here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} have become caught behind enemy lines when the cease fire collapsed. A lance of mechs tasked with the rescue have gone missing, so we are desperate for assistance from anyone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在停火协议破裂后，一支由{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}医护人员组成的车队被困在敌后，他们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上为最近冲突中受伤的人提供医疗援助. 一队负责救援的机甲已经失踪了，因此我们迫切需要任何人的援助.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Here in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has been an oppressive presence for some time, which has led to a number of revolutionary leaders rising up from the common people to strike at the status quo. One such leader has been targeted by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} for elimination. It's in the interest of the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} leadership that this rabble rouser survives.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}星系这里，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}长期以来是一股压迫性的存在，这导致许多革命领袖从平民中崛起，打击现状。其中一位领袖已被{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}列为清除目标。让这名煽动者活下来符合{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}领导层的利益。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I've read a bit about this criminal and the things that she's accused of. I suspect {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} will do anything to eliminate her. If we take this job, we should expect trouble.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我读过一些关于这名罪犯以及她被指控之事的内容。我猜{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}会不惜一切除掉她。如果我们接下这份活，就该预期有麻烦。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A long-time enemy of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} has unexpectedly turned herself into local authorities, and will now be extradited to another system for trial. However, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} does not want to see her testify, and will try to stop her from leaving the planet. We've secured a convoy of armored vehicles to transport the criminal, but we need the extra fire-power of your 'Mechs to guarantee a safe path to the evacuation zone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}的一个长期敌人出人意料地向当地当局自首，如今将被引渡到另一星系受审。然而，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}不希望看到她作证，会试图阻止她离开这颗行星。我们已备好一支装甲车辆车队来押送这名罪犯，但我们需要你机甲的额外火力，以确保通往撤离区的道路安全。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Weapons technicians, huh? Well, I suppose a rescue op is a rescue op, no matter who we're rescuing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 武器技师，是吗？好吧，我想救援行动就是救援行动，不管救的是谁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've got a little problem, Commander, and you're just the people to help us out. The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} authorities raided one of our warehouses. The guns and drugs, they can keep, but they also captured some of our best technicians. We need those people back to continue our work here. They're being transported to the detention center for interrogation, which would not be good for our business at all. We need you to rescue them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们碰上点小麻烦，指挥官，而你们正是能帮我们的人。{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}当局突袭了我们的一处仓库。枪械和毒品，他们留着也行，可他们还抓走了我们最好的几名技师。我们需要那些人回来，好继续在这里干活。他们正被押往拘留中心接受审讯，这对我们的生意可大大不妙。我们想请你把他们救出来。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: There's got to be more to this story than just a simple kidnapping, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这故事背后肯定不只是一次简单的绑架，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I can't imagine why our {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} friends didn't let us know they'd invited a bunch of wealthy merchants to visit. We'd have prepared a welcoming party for them at the spaceport. Instead, it looks like we're going to have to meet up with them out in the field. Luckily, we know where they are; the drivers of their little convoy were pretty happy with the payoff we gave them. We want you to go down there and escort our new friends to safety.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我想不通为什么我们的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}朋友没告诉我们，他们邀请了一群富商来访。不然我们本可以在太空港给他们准备一场欢迎会。结果看来我们得在野外和他们碰面。幸运的是，我们知道他们在哪儿；他们那支小车队的司机对我们给的报酬相当满意。我们要你下去护送我们的新朋友到安全地带。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I suspect that our employers' reluctance to commit their own forces has less to do with any extreme danger of the task, but some distaste with their merchant friend.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我怀疑我们的雇主不愿投入自己的部队，与其说是任务极度危险，不如说是对他们那位商人朋友有些不满。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're looking for a mercenary company with a reputation for discretion. A personal friend of our leadership here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} has requested protection for a convoy of his, but {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} can't commit our own forces to this task. While his convoy is armed and armored, he suspects that his enemies have hired mercenaries of their own to interdict this shipment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们在找一家以谨慎保密闻名的雇佣兵公司。我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}领导层的一位私人朋友请求为他的车队提供保护，但{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}无法把自家部队投入这项任务。虽然他的车队有武装有装甲，但他怀疑他的敌人也雇了雇佣兵来阻截这批货。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander. The enemy has deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官。敌方已派出增援，正在途中。预计抵抗会增强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Excellent work, Commander. The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} convoy safely reached extraction, and I have Sumire moments away from your position for a pick up. Be ready.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Keep in mind that the convoy will try to stay near you for protection. Continue advancing to get them to the extract point!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 请记住，车队会尽量靠近你寻求保护。继续推进，把他们带到撤离点！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Move to their position and provide support.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前往他们的位置并提供支援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Pack it in, Commander. Nothing left to do here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 收工吧，指挥官。这里没别的事了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The truth is, I hate fighting other mercenaries. It seems like such a waste of perfectly good armor and myomer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 真相是，我讨厌和其他佣兵战斗. 这似乎是对优质装甲和麦约摩尔的一种浪费.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've become aware of a target of opportunity. There's a convoy of military supplies moving through unpatrolled regions on the planet below, and we'd like to seize it for ourselves. The problem is that we have credible reports that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are also moving to intercept, and they've hired a skilled mercenary to lead their efforts. We'd like you to capture that convoy instead, and take it to a designated evac zone for pickup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们得知有一处可乘之机的目标。有一支军用补给车队正穿过下面行星上无人巡逻的区域，我们想把它据为己有。问题在于，我们有可靠报告称{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队也在前往拦截，而且他们雇了一名技艺娴熟的雇佣兵来指挥。我们希望你去夺取那支车队，把它带到指定撤离区等待接收。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander. The enemy had deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enemy mercenary, be advised that we will not allow you to capture this convoy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌方佣兵，注意我们是不会允许你们夺走这支车队的.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Excellent work, Commander. The vehicles are safely away.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得漂亮，指挥官. 车辆安全离开了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like I got us here first, boss. You're welcome.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来是我先到这儿了，老大。不用谢。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Pack it in, Commander. Nothing left to do here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 收工吧，指挥官。这里没别的事了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Polite hostages? Huh. I could get used to that.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 有礼貌的人质? 嗯. 我可以习惯的.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, if the convoy has been attacked once, we can just about guarantee that it's going to be attacked again. Somehow, I doubt {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} will give up so easily.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，如果车队已经被袭击过一次，我们几乎可以保证它还会再被袭击。不知怎么的，我怀疑{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}不会这么轻易放弃。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An ally of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name} stands accused of a long list of illegal, unethical and deplorable activities. Proof of her guilt was being transported to a spaceport, for safe-keeping off-planet, when it was attacked by unidentified mercenary forces. The convoy narrowly escaped and we need you to protect it while we arrange for a dropship pickup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}盟友被指控涉及一系列非法、不道德及令人发指的活动. 她的罪证正被运送至太空港以便转移到星球之外保管，但途中遭到不明雇佣兵部队的袭击. 车队勉强摆脱了敌人，我们需要你保护车队，直到我们安排空投艇接应.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, while I imagine they will fire at targets of opportunity you shouldn't rely on support from our employer's lance. They'll be making a bee line for their extraction point.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，虽然我想他们会朝可乘之机的目标开火，但你不该指望雇主那支分队的支援。他们会直扑撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A lance of our heaviest mechs is in poor repair after a long patrol. We have credible intelligence suggesting that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} will attempt to exploit this vulnerability. We have no other significant units available in the area so we need you to drop and run interference while we extract our mechs to a repair facility.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们一队重型机甲在执行了长时间巡逻后状况不佳. 我们有可靠情报表明，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}将试图利用这一弱点. 我们在该地区没有其他主力部队可用，因此需要你们空降，在我们把机甲撤往维修设施的过程中进行掩护.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一旦{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}领导层意识到我们在做什么，指挥官，他们就会试图亲自摧毁这支车队。预期敌方增援会把目标对准车辆。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've received intel that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} is reinforcing one of their key fortifications on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. If we allow them to do so, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} destabilization operations here will be set back by months, possibly years. We need you to intercept the supply convoy and redirect it to a waiting dropship, which will carry the supplies to our insurgent forces on the planet.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们收到情报，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}正在加固他们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的一处关键要塞。若任由他们得逞，我们在这里的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}颠覆行动将倒退数月、甚至数年。我们需要你拦截补给车队，并把它改道送往一艘待命的空投艇，由后者把补给运给该星球上的我方叛乱部队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander. The enemy has deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官。敌方已派出增援，正在途中。预计抵抗会增强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Excellent work, Commander. The convoy safely reached extraction, and I have Sumire moments away from your position for a pick up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得漂亮，指挥官. 车队安全抵达了撤离点，我让苏米尔马上到你们的位置接应.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Get them to the extraction LZ, keep them intact, and then get to the evac point. Oliveira out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 带他们到撤离用着陆区，保证他们安然无恙，然后前往撤离点. 奥利维拉完毕.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Keep in mind that the convoy will try to stay near you for protection. Continue advancing to get them to the extract point!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 请记住，车队会尽量靠近你寻求保护。继续推进，把他们带到撤离点！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Pack it in, Commander. This has turned into a real shit-show.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 结束吧，指挥官. 这里的情况已经变成了真正的狗屎表演.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The supply convoy is right where our employers said it would be.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那支补给车队就在我们雇主所说的位置.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there are keep them safe until we can get them out.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, this is definitely a contract where speed is of the essence. I expect that if {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces locate the asset, they'll rally reinforcements from the captured research facility.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这绝对是一份讲究速度的合同。我预计一旦{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队找到那个资产，他们就会从被占领的研究设施调集增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A surprise attack by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} resulted in the capture of our research facility here in the {TGT_SYSTEM.name} system. At the last moment, when all was lost, a convoy managed to escape with an extremely valuable prototype. With the facility in enemy hands, we need this prototype to reconstruct the work of our scientists. Intercept the convoy before the enemy does, and escort our researchers to safety.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}的一次突袭导致我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的研究设施被夺走了. 在最后关头，几乎失去一切的时候，一支车队设法带走了一件极其珍贵的原型. 由于设施已落入敌手，我们需要这件原型来重建科学家的研究成果. 在敌人之前找到这支车队，并护送我们的研究人员安全撤离.

Payment will be remitted upon our receipt of the convoy and the successful evac of your lance.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect the all units in Convoy during Extraction, suffering no losses.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在撤离过程中保护车队全部单位，不遭受任何损失。
确保车队集结点安全

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy enemy units which will attempt to block the convoy from reaching its destination.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求摧毁试图阻止车队抵达目的地的敌方单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the force of enemies which will try and stop the player from reaching the rally point.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求摧毁试图阻止玩家抵达集结点的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to escape with all the player units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标要求所有玩家单位成功撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a hot one, Commander. It's going to be a crap shoot which one {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} will decide to make their main assault. You need to prepare as if it's going to be this one.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一票很热，指挥官。{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}会决定对哪一处发动主攻，纯属赌运气。你需要按这里会成为主攻来准备。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We need to transfer a prisoner from {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} to another system. This prisoner has allies in {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} that will stop at nothing to set their ally free. To make it harder for them to target the prisoner, we are doing our best to send out mixed signals on the prisoner and when the transfer will be. We are also sending {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces out as 'dummy' convoys, and sending multiple vehicles in each convoy. However, your convoy will be the real one.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们需要把一名囚犯从{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}转移到另一个星系。这名囚犯在{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}有盟友，他们会不惜一切释放他们的同伙。为让他们更难锁定这名囚犯，我们尽力在囚犯本人以及转移时间上放出混杂信号。我们还会派出{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}部队作为"诱饵"车队，并在每支车队中派出多辆车辆。然而，你的车队才是真的那支。
玩家 1
玩家 2
摧毁 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 拦截部队
摧毁 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 增援
确保车队全部单位存活
护送 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 车队前往撤离点

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Convoy to Safety and Escape
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送车队至安全地带并撤离
前往撤离区

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy hunter lance for mission complete.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭猎人小队来完成任务.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect Convoy as they Embark on the Dropship
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保护车队登上空投舰
在空投舰抵达期间保护车队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: And they are away! The convoy is safely out of the AO. Good work, Commander. Now get your remaining forces to the second evac zone for extraction there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们走了！车队已安全离开作战区域。干得好，指挥官。现在把你剩余的部队带到第二撤离区进行撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we have word the prisoner is safely under lock and key; good work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们收到消息，犯人已经安全收押; 干得好.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander. The enemy has deployed reinforcements and they are inbound. Expect increased resistance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官。敌方已派出增援，正在途中。预计抵抗会增强。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Keep in mind that the convoy will try to stay near you for protection. Continue advancing to get them to the extract point!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 请记住，车队会尽量靠近你寻求保护。继续推进，把他们带到撤离点！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Keep the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} units alive and get them to the extraction point. Oliveira out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保证{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}单位活着，带他们前往撤离点. 奥利维拉完毕.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} got here before us. Guess the deception didn't work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}比我们先到了。看来这套欺骗没奏效。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You've reached the extraction point for the objective vehicles. Hold there are keep them safe until we can get them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你已抵达目标车辆的撤离点。守住那里，在我们把他们弄出去之前保护好他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A sturdy and reliable 'Mech, the Centurion is good at both taking and giving a beating. CN9-A models are able to engage at any range, but their damage curve increases as they approach a target. Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.02.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Centurion 是一款坚固可靠的机甲，既能挨打也善于打人。CN9-A 型可在任何距离上交战，但越接近目标，其伤害输出曲线越高。 投放费用倍率：1.02。
缠斗者与通用突击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A sturdy and reliable 'Mech, the Centurion is good at both taking and giving a beating. CN9-A models are able to engage at any range, but their damage curve increases as they approach a target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 百夫长是一款坚固可靠的机甲，既能挨打也能打人。CN9-A 型号能在任何距离交战，其伤害曲线随接近目标而上升。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Panther 9Rs are solid all-around 'Mechs, if a bit on the slow side. They make up for it with Jump Jets, considerable armor, and a hefty punch from their trademark PPC. They've even been used in physical slugging matches to good effect. Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.98.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑豹9R是扎实的全能机甲，只是速度稍慢。它们用跳跃推进器、可观的装甲以及标志性粒子炮的沉重打击来弥补。它们甚至被用于肉搏缠斗并取得不错效果。 投放费用倍率：0.98。
狙击手与轻型缠斗者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Panther 9Rs are solid all-around 'Mechs, if a bit on the slow side. They make up for it with Jump Jets, considerable armor, and a hefty punch from their trademark PPC. They've even been used in physical slugging matches to good effect.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑豹 9R 是扎实的全能机甲，只是稍偏慢。它靠跳跃推进器、可观的装甲和标志性 PPC 的沉重打击来弥补。它们甚至被用于近身肉搏，效果不俗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shadow Hawk 2H is the perfect example of a 'jack-of-all-trades.' It supports weaponry for all ranges, has respectable speed and jump capability, and mounts decent armor. This comes at the cost of excelling at nothing in particular. Quirk: Battle Fists Drop Cost Multiplier: 1.03
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 暗影鹰 2H 是"样样通吃"的完美范例。它具备适用于所有射程的武器，速度与跳跃能力可观，装甲也相当不错。代价是它在任何方面都不特别出众。 特质：战斗铁拳 投放费用倍率：1.03
暗影鹰
散兵与骑兵
暗影鹰

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Shadow Hawk 2H is the perfect example of a 'jack-of-all-trades.' It supports weaponry for all ranges, has respectable speed and jump capability, and mounts decent armor. This comes at the cost of excelling at nothing in particular.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 暗影鹰 2H 是"样样通吃"的完美范例。它具备适用于所有射程的武器，速度与跳跃能力可观，装甲也相当不错。代价是它在任何方面都不特别出众。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Don't let the stubby 'Urbie' fool you, it may look like a walking trash can, but it can mount heavy armor and a grown-up-sized Autocannon. R60s aren't known for their speed, but they are very useful if you can draw the enemy into their firing range. Drop Cost Multiplier: 0.97.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 别被矮墩墩的"城市仔"骗了，它看着像个会走路的垃圾桶，却能装上重型装甲和成人尺寸的自动炮。R60不以速度著称，但如果你能把敌人引到它们的射程内，它们就非常有用。 投放成本倍率：0.97。
重型防御者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Don't let the stubby 'Urbie' fool you, it may look like a walking trash can, but it can mount heavy armor and a grown-up-sized Autocannon. R60s aren't known for their speed, but they are very useful if you can draw the enemy into their firing range.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 别被矮胖的"都市"骗了，它也许看起来像个会走路的垃圾桶，却能装备厚重装甲和成人尺寸的自动炮。R60 不以速度著称，但如果你能把敌人引到它的射程内，它们就非常有用。
盟友回合
-1 主动权

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A DropPod is inbound to this location. Units here are at risk of destruction.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个空投舱正向这个位置降落. 在此区域的单位有被摧毁的风险.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A DropShip is inbound to this location. Units here are at risk of destruction.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一艘空投艇正向这个位置降落. 在此区域的单位有被摧毁的风险.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Click the Melee targeting reticle on the enemy, or press V to cycle through Melee targets. Then, click the Attack button.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 点击敌人身上的肉搏瞄准分划，或按V键切换肉搏目标. 然后，点击攻击按钮.
消耗: 100怒气

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Do you want to start the Withdraw countdown? You will be able to cancel later.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 您确定要开始撤退倒计时吗? 稍后仍可取消.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Eject your pilot. They will be saved from further injuries, but the piloted unit will be unusable for the rest of this mission, and its head location will be destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弹射机师. 机师将免受进一步伤害，但其驾驶的单位在本任务剩余时间内将无法使用，且其头部部位将被摧毁.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Firing weapons suppresses Stealth on this unit for 1 Round.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 使用武器射击导致该单位的潜行效果受压制1回合.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Move the mouse to the edge of the screen (or use W, A, S, and D) to move the camera.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 将鼠标移到屏幕边缘(或WASD键)来移动镜头.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Move your mouse to the indicated point. Click once to select where you wish to move. Click again to choose which direction to face.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 将你的鼠标移到指示点. 点击一次选择你想前往的地点. 再次点击选择朝向.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Outside of combat, your entire lance moves in any order. You can even have multiple units moving at the same time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 不在战斗的时候，你的整个小队可以按任意顺序移动. 你甚至可以同时移动多个单位.
额外消除 20 点热量。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Select a target with your mouse, or press TAB to cycle between targets. Click FIRE when ready.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 用你的鼠标选择目标，或按TAB键切换目标. 准备好了就点击开火.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Select the {0} skill and fire at the enemy target. You may call a shot at any location on the target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 选择 {0} 技能并射击敌方目标. 你可以使用精准射击来射击目标的各个部位.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Select the {0} skill and move to the target location.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 选择 {0} 技能并移动到目标位置.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sensor Lock suppresses Stealth on this unit for 1 Round.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 传感器锁定压制该单位的潜行效果，持续1回合.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 处于该位置的单位有被摧毁的风险.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Use the right mouse button (or Q and E) to rotate the camera.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 使用鼠标右键(或Q和E键)来旋转镜头.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You can spend Resolve to use either of the Resolve abilities, {0} and {1}, located with the rest of the action buttons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你可以花费决心来使用两种决心技能中的任意一种，{0}和{1}，它们位于行动按钮的末尾.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} facility must be running on incredibly narrow margins if they can't afford to protect it themselves. Anyway, Commander, this should be very straightforward.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 的设施若是连自我防护都负担不起，那经营利润一定薄得可怜。总之，指挥官，这次任务应该非常简单直接。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hostile {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have been making increasingly bold incursions toward one of our processing facilities on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. This facility represents a substantial cash investment for {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}, and its destruction would be both politically and financially disastrous. We need a capable mercenary company to defend the site. Payment will be remitted upon the repulsion of all hostile {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌对的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军队一直向我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的一处加工设施发动袭击，袭击越来越肆无忌惮. 这座设施对{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}来说是一笔巨额资金投入，其被摧毁将带来政治和经济上的双重灾难. 我们需要一支有能力的雇佣兵部队来防御该地点. 在击退了所有敌对的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}单位后，我们就会把报酬汇给你.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All right, Commander, we've been tasked with defending this installation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好的指挥官，我们奉命防守这座设施。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Be advised, some of the target buildings are sustaining damage. Your mission is to keep them standing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 请注意，部分目标建筑正在受损。你的任务是让它们保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, a target building has been demolished. Ensure the integrity of the remaining buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，一处目标建筑已被摧毁。确保其余建筑完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, on this outing we have some additional support from our employer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这次行动我们获得了雇主的一些额外支援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort them safely to the generators and we can boost our defensive capability with those turrets activated. Good Luck!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 把他们安全护送到发电机那里，我们就能激活那些炮塔来提升防御能力。祝好运！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Excellent work, Commander - the hostiles are clear and our facility is secure.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得漂亮，指挥官--所有敌人已经被清除，我们的设施安全了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mercenary Commander, we've received word of the assault on your position. Reinforcements are incoming, they are about halfway there. Maintain position and you will be relieved and reinforced shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 佣兵指挥官，我们已收到你所在位置遭袭的消息。增援正在赶来，大约走了一半路程。坚守阵地，你很快就会得到接替和增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They have point defenses set up around the base, they are however offline.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们在基地周边布置了近距离防御设施，不过目前处于离线状态。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors. Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告，指挥官，传感器读数显示多个目标正从多个方向接近。看来进攻方带来了增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a friendly convoy with engineers who are eager to get at those defenses, so they can bring them online.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们有一支友方车队，随行的工兵急于接触那些防御设施，好让它们上线。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have scattered reports of incoming hostiles from multiple directions.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们从多个方向上收到零星报告说有敌人来袭.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're in position! All engineers have disembarked from the Personal carriers. The APCs will scatter and support you, keep the Turrets online and we'll keep firing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们到位了！所有工兵都已从人员运输车下车。装甲运兵车会散开支援你，让炮塔保持在线，我们就会持续开火。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This job doesn't seem all that difficult, but... Turrets? Please. Never send a machine to do a MechWarrior's job.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这活看起来没那么难，可是……炮塔？拜托。永远别派机器去做机师的活。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have an urgent problem that needs an immediate military response, Commander. We've just detected multiple {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} DropShips en route to one of our supply bases. Logistics bases are generally protected by automated turret systems, but this attack force is much larger than the turret systems were meant for. We want you to provide additional firepower in case the turrets aren't enough.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们有个紧急问题需要立即的军事响应。我们刚探测到多艘{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}空投艇正前往我们的一处补给基地。后勤基地一般由自动炮塔系统保护，但这支进攻力量远大于炮塔系统所能应对的规模。我们希望你在炮塔不够用时提供额外火力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Argo, this is {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} local command. Our turrets have been disabled by sabotage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔戈号，这里是{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}本地司令部. 我们的炮台因破坏而失效了.
