Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，一处目标建筑已被摧毁。确保其余建筑完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hey, Darius. Are there supposed to be turrets guarding this place?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 嘿，达吕斯. 这个地方该有炮台守卫吗?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I have a team of engineers that can manually restart the turrets, but that can only be done in person at turret control.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我有一队工程师，他们能手动重启炮台，但只能亲自在炮台控制站做到.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mercenary Commander, we've received word of the assault on your position. Reinforcements are incoming, they are about halfway there. Maintain position and you will be relieved and reinforced shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 佣兵指挥官，我们已收到你所在位置遭袭的消息。增援正在赶来，大约走了一半路程。坚守阵地，你很快就会得到接替和增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Roger, local command. Commander, looks like we have a few more guns on our side.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 收到，本地指挥部. 指挥官，看来我们这边要有些枪炮了.
应该是. 怎么了?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors. Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告，指挥官，传感器读数显示多个目标正从多个方向接近。看来进攻方带来了增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: What a damn disaster. Let's debrief back in orbit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 真是一场该死的灾难。我们回轨道上做简报吧。
加强安保

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, be careful: if there *is* a second attack, the raiders will go all out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，小心点: 如果*有*第二轮攻击，那些袭击者会全力以赴.

Their latest attack was far better organized and equipped than the previous ones, suggesting the raiders are receiving logistical and tactical support from a hostile power. We might not be able to withstand a second attack of that scale. We'd like to hire you to provide additional defensive support.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}上有一处小型{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}基地，一直遭到劫掠者袭击。他们最近一次袭击的组织与装备远比之前几次精良，说明劫掠者正在从某个敌对势力获得后勤与战术支援。我们可能承受不住再一次那种规模的袭击。我们想雇你提供额外的防御支援。

坚守到{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}援军到来

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Apparently spies come in mechs these days.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来现在的间谍都开机甲了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Be advised, some of the target buildings are sustaining damage. Your mission is to keep them standing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 请注意，部分目标建筑正在受损。你的任务是让它们保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, our contracted mission is to defend this factory.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们签约的任务是守卫这座工厂.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mercenary Commander, we've received word of the assault on your position. Reinforcements are incoming, they are about halfway there. Maintain position and you will be relieved and reinforced shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 佣兵指挥官，我们已收到你所在位置遭袭的消息。增援正在赶来，大约走了一半路程。坚守阵地，你很快就会得到接替和增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Various VTOL assets are conducting test flights in the AO.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 各种垂直起降车辆正在作战区域进行测试飞行.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Third Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭第三支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They've got to be kicking themselves for letting their VIP go out without more security. Their screw-up is our payday, though.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们一定在懊悔让贵宾没有更多护卫就出门。不过他们的失误就是我们的收获。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a VIP at a base on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, and we've just received a garbled transmission from a local agent that the base will be attacked by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}. They're striking at the VIP, and they know our forces are not in position to come to his aid. We need a team of competent mercenaries to protect the facility and our personnel.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的一处基地有一位要人，而我们刚收到当地特工发来的一段错乱传输：该基地将遭到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}的攻击。他们的打击目标是那位要人，而且他们知道我方部队无法及时救援。我们需要一支称职的雇佣兵队伍来保护该设施与我们的人员。
玩家 1
玩家 2
敌人来袭
守卫{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}基地

摧毁 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 先锋
确保所有建筑存活

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送工兵装甲运兵车前往基地防御设施

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Third Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭第三支小队
坚守待援
保护{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}VIP

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As expected, we have multiple incoming {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 不出所料，我们遭遇到多个来袭的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}单位.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Be advised, some of the target buildings are sustaining damage. Your mission is to keep them standing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 请注意，部分目标建筑正在受损。你的任务是让它们保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, a target building has been demolished. Ensure the integrity of the remaining buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，一处目标建筑已被摧毁。确保其余建筑完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we need to protect the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} base and keep the VIP safe.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们需要保护这座{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}基地，确保VIP的安全.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort them to the generators and we can boost our firepower and repel the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送他们安全到达发电站，这样我们可以加强自身火力，击退{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hold the base, keep the buildings upright, and eliminate any threats. Oliveira out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 守住基地，保持建筑物屹立不倒，同时消灭任何威胁. 奥利维拉完毕.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mercenary Commander, we've received word of the assault on your position. Reinforcements are incoming, they are about halfway there. Maintain position and you will be relieved and reinforced shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 佣兵指挥官，我们已收到你所在位置遭袭的消息。增援正在赶来，大约走了一半路程。坚守阵地，你很快就会得到接替和增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employers are providing us with extra support, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主正在为我们提供额外的支援，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The engineers are in position and have disembarked from the APCs. The vehicles will scatter and support you; just keep those turrets online.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 工程师已经就位并从装甲运兵车上下来了. 现在车辆将会散开支援你; 请保持那些炮台在线.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors. Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告，指挥官，传感器读数显示多个目标正从多个方向接近。看来进攻方带来了增援。
濒临突破
抵御进攻者保卫基地

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Engineer APCs to Base Defenses in order to take control of them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送工兵装甲运兵车前往基地防御设施，以便夺取其控制权。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Third Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭第三支小队
坚守待援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm guessing our employers know that a hammer blow is coming, so we'll expected to take the brunt of the attack until their reinforcements arrive on the field.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我猜我们的雇主知道一次重锤即将落下，所以我们要承受攻击的主力，直到他们的增援抵达战场。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} industrial lab is at a critical juncture in its R&D program. Any disruption would set us back a decade. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} has discovered this, and they've already interdicted the first lance of 'Mechs that were sent to defend the facility. We need mercenaries to step in and buy the time necessary for further reinforcements to arrive.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一处{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}工业实验室正处于研发计划的关键节点。任何干扰都会让我们倒退十年。{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}发现了这一点，并已拦截了首批派去防卫该设施的机甲小队。我们需要雇佣兵介入，为后续增援抵达争取必要时间。
玩家 1
玩家 2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All we have to do is hold out until the cavalry arrives. Good luck.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们要做的就是守住，直到骑兵赶到. 祝你好运.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Be advised, some of the target buildings are sustaining damage. Your mission is to keep them standing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 请注意，部分目标建筑正在受损。你的任务是让它们保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, a target building has been demolished. Ensure the integrity of the remaining buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，一处目标建筑已被摧毁。确保其余建筑完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, if we lose another building we lose the whole lab. You have to hold on.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，如果我们再失去另外一座建筑物，就会失去整个实验室. 你得守住.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort them safely to the generators and we can bring some additional firepower to this fight.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送他们安全到达发电站，这样我们能给战斗带来一些额外的火力.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mercenary Commander, we've received word of the assault on your position. Reinforcements are incoming, they are about halfway there. Maintain position and you will be relieved and reinforced shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 佣兵指挥官，我们已收到你所在位置遭袭的消息。增援正在赶来，大约走了一半路程。坚守阵地，你很快就会得到接替和增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They have point defense turrets set up around the base. They were taken offline in the last assault, however.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们在基地周围设置了几处防御炮台. 不过，它们在上一轮袭击中离线了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This isn't the first assault on this facility, Commander. Expect significant enemy forces.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这不是第一次进攻这处设施，指挥官。预期会遇到可观的敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors. Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告，指挥官，传感器读数显示多个目标正从多个方向接近。看来进攻方带来了增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} convoy of engineers who can bring them back online.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们这里有一车队的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}工程师能让它们重新上线.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defend Targeted Base Structures from Attackers
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保卫目标基地结构免受攻击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the enemy vanguard force, the first wave.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方先锋部队，也就是第一波。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Engineer APCs to Base Defenses in order to take control of them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送工兵装甲运兵车前往基地防御设施，以便夺取其控制权。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Second Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 摧毁第二支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Third Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭第三支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Objective for tracking the time left in the mission. While the player it told to Hold Out for Reinforcements
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 用于追踪任务剩余时间的目标。同时玩家被告知坚守待援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Optional objective to keep ALL target structures intact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：让所有目标结构保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This all seems extremely straightforward, Commander. There will likely be significant opposition, but nothing we haven't handled in the past.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这一切看起来都极其直接，指挥官。很可能会有可观的抵抗，但不是我们过去没处理过的东西。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our covert operatives on the planet have located a secret {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility that's been abandoned. We have a team inbound to this planet to strip the facility of everything valuable, but our people on the surface tripped some sort of alarm, which means the original owners are probably on their way to level the place and ensure we can't salvage anything. We need you and your people to occupy that base and keep it intact until our team arrives.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们在这颗星球上的秘密特工发现了一处已被废弃的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}设施。我们已派出一支小队前往该星球，要把设施里所有值钱的东西都拆运一空，但我们在地表的人触发了某种警报，这意味着原来的主人很可能正在赶来，打算把那里夷为平地，确保我们什么也捞不到。我们需要你和你的人占领那座基地，并在我们的小队抵达之前保持其完好无损。

坚守待援

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Be advised, some of the target buildings are sustaining damage. Your mission is to keep them standing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 请注意，部分目标建筑正在受损。你的任务是让它们保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, a target building has been demolished. Ensure the integrity of the remaining buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，一处目标建筑已被摧毁。确保其余建筑完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, on this outing we have some additional support from our employer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这次行动我们获得了雇主的一些额外支援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort them safely to the generators and we can boost our defensive capability with those turrets activated. Good Luck!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 把他们安全护送到发电机那里，我们就能激活那些炮塔来提升防御能力。祝好运！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I hope whatever they found in there was worth it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我希望他们在里面找到的东西是值得的.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mercenary Commander, we've received word of the assault on your position. Reinforcements are incoming, they are about halfway there. Maintain position and you will be relieved and reinforced shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 佣兵指挥官，我们已收到你所在位置遭袭的消息。增援正在赶来，大约走了一半路程。坚守阵地，你很快就会得到接替和增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: There's something I still don't get, XO. Why did they abandon this place if it's full of stuff valuable enough that they're willing to flatten the place to keep it out of {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} hands?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 还有一点我不明白，副官。如果这地方的东西宝贵到他们宁愿把它夷平也不让{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}拿到，那他们为什么放弃这里？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They have point defenses set up around the base, they are however offline.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们在基地周边布置了近距离防御设施，不过目前处于离线状态。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors. Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告，指挥官，传感器读数显示多个目标正从多个方向接近。看来进攻方带来了增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a friendly convoy with engineers who are eager to get at those defenses, so they can bring them online.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们有一支友方车队，随行的工兵急于接触那些防御设施，好让它们上线。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're in position! All engineers have disembarked from the Personal carriers. The APCs will scatter and support you, keep the Turrets online and we'll keep firing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们到位了！所有工兵都已从人员运输车下车。装甲运兵车会散开支援你，让炮塔保持在线，我们就会持续开火。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: What a damn disaster. Let's debrief back in orbit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 真是一场该死的灾难。我们回轨道上做简报吧。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a friendly convoy with engineers who are eager to get at those defenses, so they can bring them online.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们有一支友方车队，随行的工兵急于接触那些防御设施，好让它们上线。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're in position! All engineers have disembarked from the Personal carriers. The APCs will scatter and support you, keep the Turrets online and we'll keep firing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们到位了！所有工兵都已从人员运输车下车。装甲运兵车会散开支援你，让炮塔保持在线，我们就会持续开火。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: What a damn disaster. Let's debrief back in orbit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 真是一场该死的灾难。我们回轨道上做简报吧。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可能那么简单，也可能不，指挥官。我们也许稍微落后于前线，但前进作战基地对我们潜在雇主的敌人来说是个诱人的目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've established a forward operations base on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. We need a competent lance to watch it while our regular forces are on maneuver. You should expect intermittent enemy contact from probing attacks and skirmishers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}建立了一处前沿作战基地。我们需要一支称职的分队在我们正规部队机动期间看守它。你应当预料会遭到试探性攻击与散兵袭扰带来的间歇性敌军接触。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Buckle up, Commander. This is going to get exciting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 做好准备，指挥官. 好戏要开场了.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，一处目标建筑已被摧毁。确保其余建筑完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, on this outing we have some additional support from our employer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这次行动我们获得了雇主的一些额外支援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort them safely to the generators and we can boost our defensive capability with those turrets activated. Good Luck!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Maybe this will be a quiet contract for once--
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 也许这次合约能消停一回——

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 佣兵指挥官，我们已收到你所在位置遭袭的消息。增援正在赶来，大约走了一半路程。坚守阵地，你很快就会得到接替和增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They have point defenses set up around the base, they are however offline.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们在基地周边布置了近距离防御设施，不过目前处于离线状态。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, while there's a lot of fighting in the region, the supply depot is well behind the current front lines. I can't help but be suspicious about their 'no intel' claim.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，虽然该区域战斗频繁，但补给站远在当前前线之后。对他们“没有情报”的说法，我实在无法不起疑心。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a centralized supply depot here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, located to support multiple fronts of hostile action. With so many troops elsewhere, we're looking for a lance of Mercs to babysit our outpost. We have no intel that suggests a specific threat, but better to be certain.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}这里有一个集中补给站，用来支援多个敌对战线的行动。由于兵力大多调往他处，我们想找一支雇佣兵分队来看守我们的前哨。没有任何情报显示存在特定威胁，但还是稳妥为上。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} facility must be running on incredibly narrow margins if they can't afford to protect it themselves. Anyway, Commander, this should be very straightforward.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 的设施若是连自我防护都负担不起，那经营利润一定薄得可怜。总之，指挥官，这次任务应该非常简单直接。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hostile {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have been making increasingly bold incursions toward one of our processing facilities on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. This facility represents a substantial cash investment for {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}, and its destruction would be both politically and financially disastrous. We need a capable mercenary company to defend the site. Payment will be remitted upon the repulsion of all hostile {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌对的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军队一直向我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的一处加工设施发动袭击，袭击越来越肆无忌惮. 这座设施对{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}来说是一笔巨额资金投入，其被摧毁将带来政治和经济上的双重灾难. 我们需要一支有能力的雇佣兵部队来防御该地点. 在击退了所有敌对的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}单位后，我们就会把报酬汇给你.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Even though {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} supposedly believes the facility is 'undefended', I'm still expecting a stand-up fight, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 尽管{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}号称认为该设施"无人防守"，我仍然预期会有一场正面硬仗，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As part of a propaganda effort, we've been operating a secret holo-vid broadcasting facility on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. The clearest sign that our efforts are working is that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} agents have spent months searching for the facility. Unfortunately, they've succeeded, and are launching an assault on what they believe to be an undefended installation. While our personnel prepare for evacuation and destroy all the files and documents, we need a team of mercenaries to hold off {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为宣传工作的一部分，我们一直在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}上运营一处秘密全息影像广播设施。我们努力见效的最明显迹象，就是{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}特工花了数月搜寻这处设施。不幸的是，他们成功了，正在对他们认为无人防守的设施发动进攻。在我们的人员准备撤离并销毁所有文件文档时，我们需要一队雇佣兵去拖住{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Attention, pirate scum: you are in violation of {TGT_SYSTEM.name} regulations on the sale and possession of deadly weaponry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，海盗渣滓们: 你们已经触犯了{TGT_SYSTEM.name}法律中有关出售和持有致命武器的条例.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Be advised, some of the target buildings are sustaining damage. Your mission is to keep them standing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 请注意，部分目标建筑正在受损。你的任务是让它们保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, a target building has been demolished. Ensure the integrity of the remaining buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，一处目标建筑已被摧毁。确保其余建筑完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, on this outing we have some additional support from our employer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这次行动我们获得了雇主的一些额外支援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort them safely to the generators and we can boost our defensive capability with those turrets activated. Good Luck!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 把他们安全护送到发电机那里，我们就能激活那些炮塔来提升防御能力。祝好运！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mercenary Commander, we've received word of the assault on your position. Reinforcements are incoming, they are about halfway there. Maintain position and you will be relieved and reinforced shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 佣兵指挥官，我们已收到你所在位置遭袭的消息。增援正在赶来，大约走了一半路程。坚守阵地，你很快就会得到接替和增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Military force has been authorized against your facility. Withdraw immediately or be destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 军队已经得到授权攻击你的设施. 立即撤离，否则将被摧毁.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They have point defenses set up around the base, they are however offline.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们在基地周边布置了近距离防御设施，不过目前处于离线状态。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors. Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告，指挥官，传感器读数显示多个目标正从多个方向接近。看来进攻方带来了增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a friendly convoy with engineers who are eager to get at those defenses, so they can bring them online.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们有一支友方车队，随行的工兵急于接触那些防御设施，好让它们上线。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're in position! All engineers have disembarked from the Personal carriers. The APCs will scatter and support you, keep the Turrets online and we'll keep firing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们到位了！所有工兵都已从人员运输车下车。装甲运兵车会散开支援你，让炮塔保持在线，我们就会持续开火。
职业道德
专家

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保卫目标基地结构免受攻击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the enemy vanguard force, the first wave.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方先锋部队，也就是第一波。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Engineer APCs to Base Defenses in order to take control of them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送工兵装甲运兵车前往基地防御设施，以便夺取其控制权。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：让所有目标结构保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Why would anyone give their target a warning? And what the hell does 'professional ethics' mean? This is bizarre.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 怎么会有人去警告自己的目标？还有"职业操守"到底是什么意思？这太诡异了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have an extremely odd assignment for you. We have a manufacturing facility on the planet below, and we've been aware that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have been scouting in the area. We've expected them to make a move, but we didn't expect them to... send us a warning beforehand? Apparently they've hired a mercenary who contacted us to let us know when the attack would be, because, and I'm quoting, \"professional ethics.\" We have no idea what that means.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们有一个极其古怪的任务给你。我们在下面那颗行星上有一处制造设施，我们一直知道{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队在附近侦察。我们预计他们会有所动作，但没料到他们会……事先给我们发警告？显然他们雇了一名雇佣兵，那人联系我们告知攻击将在何时进行，因为——我引用原话——"职业操守"。我们完全不明白那是什么意思。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔戈号，我的工程师正在启动炮台. 装甲运兵车将散开提供支援.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Argo, this is {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} local command. Our turrets have been disabled by sabotage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔戈号，这里是{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}本地司令部. 我们的炮台因破坏而失效了.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，一处目标建筑已被摧毁。确保其余建筑完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I have a team of engineers that can manually restart the turrets, but that can only be done in person at turret control.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我有一队工程师，他们能手动重启炮台，但只能亲自在炮台控制站做到.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mercenary Commander, we've received word of the assault on your position. Reinforcements are incoming, they are about halfway there. Maintain position and you will be relieved and reinforced shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 佣兵指挥官，我们已收到你所在位置遭袭的消息。增援正在赶来，大约走了一半路程。坚守阵地，你很快就会得到接替和增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Roger, local command. Commander, looks like we have a few more guns on our side.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 收到，本地指挥部. 指挥官，看来我们这边要有些枪炮了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The manufacturing facility is just up ahead. Meyer, any sign of our polite opposition?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 制造设施就在前面. 梅耶尔，有什么我们彬彬有礼的对手的迹象吗?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: To prove which of us is better: your whole company... or me.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 来证明我们哪个更好些: 你的整个公司...还是我.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors. Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告，指挥官，传感器读数显示多个目标正从多个方向接近。看来进攻方带来了增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: What a damn disaster. Let's debrief back in orbit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 真是一场该死的灾难。我们回轨道上做简报吧。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're going to try to keep an assault 'Mech from destroying a facility, without any ground intel. This seems like a really terrible idea, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们要在没有地面情报的情况下，阻止一台突击机甲摧毁一处设施。这看起来真是个糟糕透顶的主意，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have an urgent assignment that we'd like your assistance with, Commander. We have a secret listening post here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, and we've just learned that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} agents have discovered the base's location. We need time to transmit all the data we've gathered to a DropShip in orbit, but they're already advancing on the facility. Worse, we're detecting an engine signature from an assault-class 'Mech closing on the base's location. We need you to drop immediately and protect that base until we can get the data transmitted.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们有一项紧急任务需要你的协助。我们在 {TGT_SYSTEM.name} 设有一处秘密监听哨站，刚刚得知 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 的特工已经发现了基地的位置。我们需要时间把收集到的全部数据发送给轨道上的一艘降落舰，但他们已经在向这处设施推进了。更糟的是，我们探测到一台突击级机甲正朝基地位置逼近的引擎信号。我们需要你立即投放，保护那座基地，直到我们把数据发送完毕。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选目标：让所有目标结构保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, if they're hiring mercs to babysit when their forces are less than a day away they expect trouble. Rumors say {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are in the area, they could present a threat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，如果他们的部队不到一天就能赶到，却还要雇雇佣兵来当保姆，那说明他们预料有麻烦。有传言说{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的部队就在这一带，他们可能构成威胁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a small disused base in a remote part of {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. We need it and are preparing to reactivate it. We'd like to hire you to recon the facility and defend it until our forces can move in. We'll have a lance with you in half a day and a logistics team within 24 hours.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}的一处偏远地区有一座废弃的小型基地。我们需要它，并正准备将其重新启用。我们想请你侦察该设施并防守它，直到我军能够进驻。半天之内我们会有一个小队与你会合，24小时内后勤小组也会抵达。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 请注意，部分目标建筑正在受损。你的任务是让它们保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander it looks like this babysitting job may be heating up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，看来这份保姆差事要升级了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, one of our lances was hit on the way to the facility and has suffered 50% losses.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我方一支小队在前往设施的途中遭到袭击，已损失过半.
指挥官，我们损失了一栋建筑!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I suggest you power up your mechs and get ready.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 建议你们启动机甲，做好准备.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mercenary Commander, we've received word of the assault on your position. Reinforcements are incoming, they are about halfway there. Maintain position and you will be relieved and reinforced shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 佣兵指挥官，我们已收到你所在位置遭袭的消息。增援正在赶来，大约走了一半路程。坚守阵地，你很快就会得到接替和增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The base is secure. Hopefully {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} can hold it themselves, now.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 基地安全了. 希望{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}人能够靠他们自己坚守下来，至少现在.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors. Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告，指挥官，传感器读数显示多个目标正从多个方向接近。看来进攻方带来了增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defend Targeted Base Structures from Attackers
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 保卫目标基地结构免受攻击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy the enemy vanguard force, the first wave.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁敌方先锋部队，也就是第一波。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} mechs back to the base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}机甲返回基地.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 佣兵指挥官，我们已收到你所在位置遭袭的消息。增援正在赶来，大约走了一半路程。坚守阵地，你很快就会得到接替和增援。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告，指挥官，传感器读数显示多个目标正从多个方向接近。看来进攻方带来了增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You must ensure that the survivors reach the facility.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你必须确保幸存者抵达设施.
抵御进攻者保卫基地

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Engineer APCs to Base Defenses in order to take control of them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送工兵装甲运兵车前往基地防御设施，以便夺取其控制权。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hidden Objective: Destroy the Third Lance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 隐藏目标: 消灭第三支小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Setting aside the rumors of LosTech, this contract is an excellent opportunity to take payment in 'Mech parts and salvage rights, as {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} MechTechs are on-site for recovery.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 撇开那些关于失传科技的传言不谈，这份合约是一个以机甲部件和打捞权作为报酬的绝佳机会，因为{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}机修技师就在现场进行回收。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our munitions factory on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} is under threat because of a rumor about a cache of Star League equipment at the site. This malicious gossip about LosTech has brought hungry wolves to our door. We have arranged for a garrison force to be moved into place, but we need mercenary units to protect the factory until our forces arrive.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们位于{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}的军工厂正面临威胁，原因是一则关于工厂所在地藏有星际联盟设备的传言. 这条涉及失落科技的恶意流言，已经把一群饥饿的“豺狼”引到了我们门口. 我们已经安排了一支驻军部队前往，但在他们抵达之前，我们需要佣兵部队来保护工厂.
玩家 1

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Be advised, some of the target buildings are sustaining damage. Your mission is to keep them standing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 请注意，部分目标建筑正在受损。你的任务是让它们保持完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, a target building has been demolished. Ensure the integrity of the remaining buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，一处目标建筑已被摧毁。确保其余建筑完好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, on this outing we have some additional support from our employer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这次行动我们获得了雇主的一些额外支援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, our contracted mission is to defend this factory.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们签约的任务是守卫这座工厂.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort them safely to the generators and we can boost our defensive capabilities.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送他们安全到达发电站，这样我们就能加强自己的防御能力.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mercenary Commander, we've received word of the assault on your position. Reinforcements are incoming, they are about halfway there. Maintain position and you will be relieved and reinforced shortly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 佣兵指挥官，我们已收到你所在位置遭袭的消息。增援正在赶来，大约走了一半路程。坚守阵地，你很快就会得到接替和增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They have point defenses set up around the base. They are, however, offline.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们在基地周围设置了几处点防御设施. 不过，它们，离线了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warning commander, sensors are reading multiple contacts approaching from multiple vectors. Looks like the attacking force has brought reinforcements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告，指挥官，传感器读数显示多个目标正从多个方向接近。看来进攻方带来了增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a friendly convoy with engineers who are eager to get at those defenses and get them firing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们有一支友方车队带着工程师，他们急切地想要前往那些防御设施并让它们开火.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is an ecological disaster, shame on you. Reduces Movement and Stability
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这真是一场生态浩劫，你应当感到羞愧. 降低移动力与稳定性

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This unit moved through rough terrain. It will take 50% stability damage from all attacks until its next activation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该单位穿越了崎岖地形. 在其下次行动前，受到的所有攻击将造成 50% 的稳定性伤害.
崎岖地形

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Burning Forests generate Heat. Thick smoke makes it harder to see and be seen.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 燃烧的森林产生热量，浓烟使得观察与被观察都更加困难.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The mech, the mech, the mech is on fire. Generate 6 More Heat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 机甲，机甲，机甲着火了. 额外产生 6 点热量.
机甲着火

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This unit moved through Chemical Fire. Heatsinking impaired by 10%
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该单位穿越了化学火焰. 散热能力削弱 10%.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Units on standing on and moving across burning terrain sink less heat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 站立在燃烧地形上或在上面移动的单位，散热能力会降低.
化学火焰

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Coolant Pools increase heat venting for units standing in within (-25 Heat). Units passing through Coolant Pools gain the Coolant Splash Effect (-15 Heat per turn for 2 turns).
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对任何站在其中的单位，冷却液池将增加其排热量(-25点热量). 穿过冷却液池的单位会获得冷却液溅洒的效果(每回合-15点热量，持续2回合).

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This unit moved through a coolant pool. Coolant Residue will remove an additional 15 heat on its next activation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该单位穿过了一个冷却液池. 残留的冷却液将在该单位下一轮行动时另外消除15点热量.
冷却液池
冷却液溅洒

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: These mineral deposits interfere with targeting systems. +3 Difficulty to hit units within a Mineral Field. +2 Difficulty for attacks made by units within a Mineral Field.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这些矿物沉积物干扰了瞄准系统. 攻击矿田内的单位 +3 命中难度，矿田内的单位发动攻击 +2 命中难度.
矿田

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a dangerous location. Stand here at your own risk.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一片危险地区. 站在这儿的话，风险自负.
危险地区

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroyed Buildings reduce movement and make you harder to detect, but they provide COVER.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 毁坏的建筑会降低移动速度，让单位更难被侦测到，但它们能提供掩护.
被摧毁的建筑物

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A DropPod might land here. Don't be standing here when it does.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个空投舱可能会落在这里。别在它落地时站在这里。
空投舱降落区域

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A DropShip might land here. Don't be standing here when it does.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一艘空投艇可能会落在这里。别在它落地时站在这里。
空投艇着陆区

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The exposed conduits' electromagnetic discharge interferes with targeting systems. +4 Difficulty to hit units within an Electrical Field. +4 Difficulty for attacks made by units within an Electrical Field.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 外露导管的电磁放电会干扰瞄准系统。对处于电场内的单位命中难度+4。处于电场内的单位发起的攻击难度+4。
电场

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Localized radioactivity interferes with targeting systems, but adds Heat to units passing through. +4 Difficulty to hit units standing in a Radiation Field. +10 Heat for two activations to units passing through a Radiation Field. Makes units harder to detect.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 局部放射性会干扰瞄准系统，但会使穿越其中的单位增加热量. 攻击站在辐射场中的单位 +4 命中难度. 穿越辐射场的单位在两个行动回合内 +10 热量. 使单位更难被侦测到.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This unit moved through intense radiation. It will sink 10 less heat on its next activation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该单位穿越了强辐射区. 下次行动时散热能力将减少 10 点.
辐射场
照明弹极大提升了可见度.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Forest reduces movement and spotting distance, and provides COVER; +1 to fire out of and +2 to fire Into Woods. +10% Stability damage taken in Woods. Reduces enemy Visibility by 20%.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 森林降低移动力与观测距离，并提供“掩护”效果; 从森林中向外开火难度 +1，向森林中开火难度 +2. 在森林中承受的稳定性伤害 +10%. 敌方可见度降低 20%.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This unit moved through geothermal terrain. It will only sink 50% of its normal heat until the end of its next activation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该单位穿过了地热地形. 直到下一轮行动结束前，它的散热能力都只有正常的50%.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Units on Geothermal terrain gain 5 heat per turn and only sink 75% of their normal heat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 位于地热地形上的单位每回合获得 5 点热量，且只能散发正常散热量的 75%.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This unit moved through geothermal terrain. It will only sink 50% of its normal heat until the end of its next activation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该单位穿过了地热地形. 直到下一轮行动结束前，它的散热能力都只有正常的50%.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Units on lava terrain gain 15 heat per turn and only sink 75% of their normal Heat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 位于熔岩地形上的单位每回合增加 15 点热量，且只能散发正常散热量的 75%.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ice reduces movement speed and increases stability damage taken by 30%, but it improves a unit's Heat-sinking ability by 10%.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 冰面会降低移动速度，并使承受的稳定度伤害增加30%，但它能提升单位10%的散热能力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Units cannot move through Impassable terrain.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 单位无法穿过不可通行地形.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Units within Marsh gain 50% stability damage reduction from all attacks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 沼泽中的单位可减少50%所有攻击带来的稳定性伤害.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This design mask has no effect. It is the default Biome design mask.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这种设计遮罩没有特殊效果. 这是默认环境的设计遮罩.
没有效果

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A nearby nuclear detonation has scrambled sensors and electronics.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 附近的核爆炸干扰了传感器和电子设备.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Units near a nuclear detonation suffer -2 accuracy for the rest of combat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 位于核爆炸附近的单位在战斗剩余时间内承受 -2 命中精度惩罚.
次级效果区域

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Localized radioactivity interferes with targeting systems, but adds Heat to units passing through. +4 Difficulty to hit units standing in a Radiation Field. +10 Heat for two activations to units passing through a Radiation Field. Makes units harder to detect.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 局部放射性会干扰瞄准系统，但会使穿越其中的单位增加热量. 攻击站在辐射场中的单位 +4 命中难度. 穿越辐射场的单位在两个行动回合内 +10 热量. 使单位更难被侦测到.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This unit moved through intense radiation. It will sink 10 less heat on its next activation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该单位穿越了强辐射区. 下次行动时散热能力将减少 10 点.
辐射场

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Units travel faster along Roads, especially wheeled vehicles.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 单位沿道路移动更快，尤其是轮式车辆.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Rough Terrain reduces movement speed and causes units to take +50% stability damage from all attacks. +4 Difficulty to hit units within Rough Terrain with Melee attacks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 崎岖地形会降低移动速度，并导致单位承受的所有攻击造成的稳定性伤害增加 50%. 在崎岖地形中对单位进行近战攻击的命中难度 +4.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This unit moved through rough terrain. It will take +50% stability damage from all attacks until its next activation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该单位穿越了崎岖地形. 在其下次行动前，受到的所有攻击将造成 +50% 的稳定性伤害.
崎岖地形

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This unit moved through urban debris. It will take 150% stability damage from all attacks until its next activation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该单位穿过了一片城市废墟. 直到下一轮行动前，它在所有攻击下都会承受150%的稳定性伤害.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Urban Debris reduces movement speed and causes units to take +50% stability damage from all attacks. +4 Difficulty to hit units within Rough Terrain with Melee attacks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 城市废墟会降低移动速度，并导致单位承受的所有攻击造成的稳定性伤害增加 50%. 在崎岖地形中对单位进行近战攻击的命中难度 +4.
城市废墟

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Smoke Drastically reduces Sight and Visibility.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 烟雾极大降低了视野和能见度.
烟幕

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Spore Fields slow all units moving through them. Units standing in Spore Fields suffer an additional 20% damage when hit due to the spores' corrosive effects. +4 Difficulty to hit units passing through Spore Clouds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 孢子场会减缓所有穿过它的单位。站在孢子场中的单位被命中时，由于孢子的腐蚀作用会额外承受20%伤害。穿过孢子云的单位被命中难度+4。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This unit moved through a Spore Cloud. Spores stick to units and interfere with targeting systems. +4 Difficulty to hit this unit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该单位穿过一片孢子云. 孢子附着在单位上干扰了瞄准系统. 攻击该单位命中难度+4.
孢子云
孢子地

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Water reduces movement speed, provides COVER and increases a unit's Heat-sinking ability by 50%.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 水域会降低移动速度，提供掩护，并使单位的散热能力提升50%。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Units cannot move through Deep Water.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 单位无法通过深水.
深水

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Whirlwinds reduce movement and spotting distance as well as increasing Stability Damage taken, but they provide COVER (10% damage reduction against ranged attacks to the front and side; does not stack with BRACE).
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 旋风会降低移动与视野距离，并增加承受的稳定度伤害，但它们提供掩护（对来自正面与侧面的远程攻击减免10%伤害；不与"稳固"叠加）。
断链
摧毁敌方建筑

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} isn't kidding about this being an ambitious target. Expect serious, well-armed resistance. This will not be easy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}说这是个大胆的目标，绝不是开玩笑。预期会遇到顽强且装备精良的抵抗。这不会轻松。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a very ambitious target in mind for you: a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} logistical base. Thousands of tons of armor, ammunition, 'Mech parts, and personnel pass through this facility every day, all on its way to front-line fighting units. A strike at this base will seriously hinder the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces, possibly even turning the tide of battle completely against them. It will be well-defended, and as soon as the assault begins the enemy will scramble reinforcements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们为你定下了一个极为大胆的目标：一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}后勤基地。每天有数千吨装甲、弹药、机甲部件与人员经此设施转运，全部运往前线作战单位。打击该基地将严重削弱{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队，甚至可能彻底扭转战局。它会有重兵防守，而一旦袭击开始，敌人就会紧急调集增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Damn. We need to abort, Commander, before we suffer any more losses.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该死. 我们需要放弃行动，指挥官，在我们遭受更大的损失之前.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good shots, Commander! You scored a solid hit on one of the target structures, keep it up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打得好，指挥官！你结实命中了一处目标结构，继续保持。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Move up to engage the target buildings. Looks like the base has its own defenses.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 行动起来向目标建筑物开火. 看来这座基地有自己的防御力量.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Target building destroyed, good work commander, stay at it and we'll be done in no time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标建筑已摧毁，干得好指挥官，继续这样我们很快就能完工。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: To interrupt the supply chain, we'll need to take out several key structures.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 要打断补给链，我们需要摧毁若干关键建筑。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've demolished the objective buildings. No need to loiter, get to the evac zone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已摧毁目标建筑。不必滞留，前往撤离区。
停止并终止
摧毁敌方建筑

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The contract does not specify any retrieval, Commander. We are to bring the base down and destroy the tech with it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 合约没有指定任何回收项目，指挥官. 我们要把基地毁掉，连同技术一起摧毁.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have reliable information that a remote {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} laboratory is attempting to reverse-engineer sensitive {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} technology in violation of the usage license. They have failed to respond to our communications that they cease and desist these unlawful operations. Therefore, we authorize you to execute the license termination clause upon that facility.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们有可靠的信息表明，一处偏远的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}实验室正违反使用许可试图对敏感的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}技术进行逆向工程. 他们未对我们要求其停止这些非法操作的通知作出回应. 因此，我们授权你对该设施执行许可终止条款.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Approach the base and destroy the designated buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 接近基地，摧毁指定建筑.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Be wary of the base defenders, and watch for any additional patrols in the area. Good hunting, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 小心基地的守卫，并注意这一地区是否有额外的巡逻队. 狩猎顺利，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we're here to shut down a research base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们是来关停一处研究基地的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good shots, Commander! You scored a solid hit on one of the target structures, keep it up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打得好，指挥官！你结实命中了一处目标结构，继续保持。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标建筑已摧毁，干得好指挥官，继续这样我们很快就能完工。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They've got multiple units protecting this facility. Be careful not to get caught in an ambush.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们有多支部队保护这座设施。小心别被伏击。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective for the player to extract their units.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是让玩家撤离其单位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to destroy the targeted buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是摧毁指定建筑。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The objective to eliminate enemy reinforcements who attack.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该目标是消灭来袭的敌方增援。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I don't like the sound of this, Commander. No satellite coverage means no topographical intel. We're going into an unknown situation without a map.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我不喜欢这听起来的样子，指挥官。没有卫星覆盖就没有地形情报。我们要在没有地图的情况下进入未知局面。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've just lost contact with one of our facilities, Commander, and we need your help. Earlier today, our facility here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} received what they believed was a normal data transmission. It was badly garbled, and when they requested it be re-sent, they got no response. Shortly thereafter the base systems began to malfunction, and then we lost contact with both the base and the synchronous satellites covering that region. We'd like you to investigate the facility.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们刚与一处设施失去联系，指挥官，我们需要你的帮助。今天早些时候，我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的设施收到了一段他们以为是常规数据的传输。它严重错乱，他们要求重发后却毫无回应。此后不久，基地系统开始故障，然后我们同时失去了与该基地和覆盖该区域的同步卫星的联系。我们希望你去调查那处设施。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As odd as this sounds... I agree with Mr. Virtanen. Anything that was exposed to that signal needs to be completely destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这听着有点怪...我同意维尔塔宁先生的看法. 任何暴露在那个信号下的东西都需要彻底摧毁.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bkt_KillConfirmed: The garrison is destroyed. Good Work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bkt_KillConfirmed：守军已被摧毁。干得好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Boss, there's a garbage signal blasting out of that base's transmitters. Want me to put it through?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 老板，那座基地的发射器正往外喷垃圾信号。要我接进来吗？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, with comms switched off, I have no idea if the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are part of an attack, or additional victims of the signal.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，由于通讯关闭的关系，我就不知道{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队到底是攻击的一部分，还是这个信号的另一个受害者了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good shots, Commander! You scored a solid hit on one of the target structures, keep it up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 打得好，指挥官！你结实命中了一处目标结构，继续保持。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I wonder if {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} intended this to happen, or if they were themselves infected?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我在想{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}是不是有意让这事发生的，还是说他们自己也感染了?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Target building destroyed, good work commander, stay at it and we'll be done in no time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标建筑已摧毁，干得好指挥官，继续这样我们很快就能完工。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We need to pull out and alert our employers about this situation. Containing this signal is their problem, now.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们需要撤出来，再向我们的雇主警告这一局面. 现在，控制这个信号是他们的问题了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've demolished the objective buildings. No need to loiter, get to the evac zone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已摧毁目标建筑。不必滞留，前往撤离区。
可以撇清关系的毁灭
隐藏目标: 摧毁基地炮台

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They're using us so the raid can't be traced to them. Shooting your own people... This is an ugly situation for them to be in, but nobody said the Periphery was a safe place to work.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们在利用我们，这样袭击就追查不到他们头上。向自己人开枪……对他们来说这处境实在难看，但没人说过外围地区是个能安心干活的地方。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We are looking for a mercenary company to do some covert work for us. We've lost a base to {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, and believe {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} personnel are being interrogated even now. We can't allow those people to spill their secrets, but it would look bad if we were seen to destroy our own base. We need deniability. We need you to level the base, particularly the storage and communications facilities. We'd appreciate it if you ensured there were no living witnesses, and will pay a bonus if you wipe out all the opposition.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们在找一家愿意为我们做一些秘密工作的雇佣兵公司。我们丢了一处基地给{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}，并且相信{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的人员此刻正在被审讯。我们不能容许那些人泄露秘密，但如果被人看到我们摧毁自己的基地，那会很难看。我们需要可否认性。我们需要你把那座基地夷平，尤其是仓储与通讯设施。如果你能确保没有活口，我们会很感激，并会在你清掉所有对手后额外支付奖金。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We should expect heavy resistance; {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} isn't saying what's in that facility, but whatever it is has them riled up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们得做好遭遇强抵抗的准备；{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} 不肯说那座设施里有什么，但无论是什么都让他们很激动。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} manufacturing facility on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} is an illegal intrusion into our territory, and a cover for military personnel and units. Our efforts to resolve this through diplomatic channels have been rebuffed, so we are now turning to a military solution. The facility must be destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 位于{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}制造设施是对我方领土的非法入侵，并且还是军事人员和部队的掩护点. 我们试图通过外交途径解决此事，但遭到了拒绝，因此现在只能诉诸军事手段. 这处设施必须被摧毁.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Depending on what's being produced there, this could be trivial or terrifying. I wish I could be more specific, but our employers don't even know who we're fighting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 取决于那里在生产什么，这可能只是小事，也可能是件可怕的事。我希望自己能说得更具体，但我们的雇主甚至连我们在跟谁打都不知道。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A routine sweep of the planet's surface revealed something unexpected: a power signature coming from the location of an abandoned facility. From the readings we're getting, it could be a 'Mech factory powering up. We're not in a good strategic position to claim the factory, so we need you to find it and destroy it. If we act quickly, we can deal with this before any 'Mechs are produced. If you do come across any newly produced 'Mechs, of course, you should reduce them to scrap as well.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对行星表面的一次例行扫描发现了意料之外的情况：一处废弃设施的位置传出了能量信号。从我们读到的数据来看，可能是某座机甲工厂正在启动。在战略上，我们并不处于能夺取这座工厂的位置，所以需要你们找到它并将其摧毁。如果我们行动够快，就能在任何机甲被生产出来之前解决此事。当然，如果你们确实遇到任何新生产的机甲，也应当把它们打成废铁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} leadership has been taking an increasingly hard line against {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}-affiliated corporate interests in the Rimward Periphery; {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} leadership has recently authorized the military interdiction of assets and resources from our corporate affiliates. Their behavior is tantamount to theft, and cannot go unpunished. We need you to send a message back to them by destroying one of their munitions factories on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}领导层在缘向外围对{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}下属企业的利益集团采取了越来越强硬的立场; 最近，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}领导层甚至授权军方对我们公司附属机构的资产和资源进行查扣. 这种行为无异于盗窃，必须予以惩罚. 我们需要你摧毁他们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}的一座军工厂，以此回敬他们一个信息.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
In the morning briefing, Darius pulls up an inventory spreadsheet on the Leopard's viewscreen. \"We're running a little low on medical supplies. Medipatches, trauma packs, a few other things. It isn't critical yet, but I feel better when we're well-stocked.\"

Sumire frowns. \"Why do we keep patching our supplies in dribs and drabs? Can't we get some kind of 'bulk discount' and get ahead of this problem? Gods know we'll end up using them, and maybe the doctors can speed up our recovery times for a while.\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
晨间简报时，达里乌斯在豹式空投艇的屏幕上调出一份库存表。“我们的医疗物资有点紧张了。医疗贴片、创伤包，还有几样别的。还不算危急，但库存充足时我心里踏实。”

澄美皱眉。“为什么我们的补给总是一点一点地凑？就不能来点什么‘批量折扣’，一次性解决这问题吗？天知道我们最后肯定会用完，说不定医生们还能借机让我们恢复得快些。”

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Buy extra supplies to boost medical efficiency.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
At the sound of the door sliding open, Darius and Yang turn in unison to face you.

\"Commander,\" Darius intones, his voice tinged with exasperation. \"The colony on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} has requested our help--\"

Yang cuts in—he's practically giddy with excitement. \"Boss, they have [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAgroMech],AgroMechs]]! Herders, Farmhands… even a CattleMaster! These are some of the wonkiest machines ever to walk on two legs. You've gotta let me work on them.\"

Darius' frown deepens. \"This is not the best use of our time or resources.\"

\"Come on, Boss.\" Yang clasps his hands, pleading. \"AgroMechs!\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
门滑开的声音响起，达里乌斯和杨同时转身面对你。

"指挥官，"达里乌斯开口，语气里带着恼意。"{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}的殖民地请求我们帮忙——"

杨插话——他简直兴奋得发抖。"老大，他们有[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreAgroMech],农用机甲]]！牧人型、农夫型……甚至还有一台牧牛大师！这些是有史以来用两条腿走过的最古怪的机器。你得让我摆弄摆弄它们。"

达里乌斯的眉头皱得更深。"这不是我们时间或资源的最佳用法。"

"来吧，老大。"杨双手合十，恳求道。"农用机甲啊！"
农业机甲? 真的吗?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Indulge Yang and send some MechTechs.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
As you enter the garden, Darius greets you, holding a basket of strawberries. \"Commander, I've been monitoring the Hydroponics productivity and we're growing more than we're using. So I did a little research on market opportunities.\"

\"I've heard back from two potential customers in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} orbit. One would pay cash for the fresh food. I think I can get ¢75,000, give or take. The other is offering machine tools in trade, which the Mech Bay could use to boost productivity.\"

Darius looks longingly at his basket. \"All offers require a minimum supply of produce, though, and it'll take more than our surplus to fill them. The crew won't like limits on their salad bar.\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
当你走进花园时，达里乌斯捧着一篮草莓迎接你。"指挥官，我一直在监测水培系统的产量，我们种出来的比用掉的多。所以我研究了一下市场机会。"

"{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}轨道上两个潜在客户已经回复我了。一个愿意付现金买新鲜食物。我想我能拿到7万5千C币左右。另一个提出用机床交换，机甲库可以用它来提升生产效率。"

达里乌斯恋恋不舍地看着他的篮子。"不过所有报价都要求最低供应量，而填满它们需要的比我们富余的更多。船员们不会喜欢沙拉吧限量。"

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
As you arrive at the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackMarket],Black Market]] rendezvous, you realize, too late, that something isn't right. There's a burst of lights and sirens as the local authorities surround your group.

A senior officer steps forward. \"This can be easy or hard, Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. Turn over the access codes, secret handshakes, and whatever other tradecraft you use to gain access to the Market, and you'll walk away scot-free, with ¢100,000 C-Bills in your pocket.\"

She crosses her arms in smug determination. \"Or you can pretend you don't know anything and pay a frankly staggering fine for wasting our time.\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
当你抵达[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackMarket],黑市]]会面地点时，你意识到事情不对，但已经太晚。灯光骤起、警笛大作，当地当局包围了你们。

一名资深军官走上前。“{COMMANDER.LastName}指挥官，这事可以简单，也可以麻烦。交出访问代码、秘密暗号，以及你用来进入黑市的一切手段，你就能安然离开，口袋里还有100,000 C-Bill。”

她得意地抱臂。“或者你可以装作什么都不知道，然后为我们浪费时间支付一笔数额惊人的罚款。”

In the morning briefing, Darius is unusually excited. \"Commander, our pirate friends have vouched for us with the cabal that controls access to the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackMarket],Black Markets]] in the Periphery. They'll even waive the usual membership fee!\"

Sumire chuckles darkly. \"We keep such sterling company. Considering our reputation with the Great Houses, though, it's hard to find welcoming ports these days.\"

Dr. Murard reluctantly agrees. \"The Black Markets are almost our only option for new supplies. It's got to be worth the extra scrutiny we'll receive from the system authorities.\"

穆拉德博士勉强同意。"黑市几乎是我们获得新补给的唯一选择。这肯定值得我们因此受到星系当局的额外审查。"

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
As Darius enters the morning briefing room, he slams the door behind him.  \"Why can't we just have nice things? The agents who represent the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackMarket],Black Market]] want us to pay the membership fee. Again.\"

Sumire sighs, \"I suppose it was too much to hope for permanent membership. No honor among thieves, huh?\"

Yang shakes his head. \"Now Sumire, don't go calling us thieves. We're just entrepreneurs, right?\"

Darius ignores both of them. \"Commander, what do you want to do?\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
达里乌斯走进晨间简报室时，随手把门摔上。"我们为什么就不能好好地过日子？代表[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackMarket],黑市]]的那些特工要我们交会员费。又是这样。"

苏米蕾叹气。"我早该知道不该指望永久会员资格。盗贼之间果然没有信义，是吧？"

杨摇头。"好了苏米蕾，别把我们叫盗贼。我们只是企业家，对吧？"

达里乌斯没理他们两个。"指挥官，你想怎么做？"
一起黑市讹诈
失去会员资格
支付打了折的会费.
支付高昂的会费。
支付会费.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Refuse to pay and let membership lapse.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 拒绝付钱，让会员失效.
[¢500，000，被御夫座海盗反感]

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As Darius enters the morning briefing room, he slams the door behind him. \"Those filthy, no good, back-stabbing... pirates!\" Yang tries desparately to keep a straight face. \"How do you really feel, Darius?\" The XO takes a deep breath. \"If we want to retain our access to the [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackMarket],Black Markets]], we're being asked, none-too-politely, to pay another membership fee.\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 当达里乌斯走进晨间简报室时，他随手把门摔上。"那些肮脏的、不怀好意的、背后捅刀的……海盗！" 杨拼命憋住笑。"说真的，达里乌斯，你到底什么感受？" 这位执行官深吸一口气。"如果我们还想保留通往[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreBlackMarket],黑市]]的渠道，我们就得——而且是毫不客气地被要求——再交一次会员费。"
一起黑市讹诈
失去会员资格
支付高昂的会费。
支付过高的会费.
支付贵得离谱的会费.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Refuse to pay and let membership lapse.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 拒绝付钱，让会员失效.
[休闲世界]

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Darius sections off two tables at the far end of the mess as a temporary recreation space. The MechWarriors cheerfully move their card games, and Yang is glad to get them out of his hair.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 达吕斯在食堂另一端隔出了两张桌子作为临时性的娱乐空间. 机甲战士们欢呼着继续他们的牌局，杨很高兴能摆脱他们.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
In the morning meeting, Yang has a complaint. \"The MechWarriors are spending too much time in the Mech Bay. They're playing card games on the floor and getting in the way. Can't they go somewhere else?\"

Darius says, \"I can clarify that they are not to obstruct the crew. Sadly, we don't have any dedicated recreation facilities to keep them occupied. This kind of issue is likely to keep occurring.\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
晨会上，杨有个抱怨。"机师们在机甲库里待太久了。他们在地板上打牌，还挡着路。他们不能去别的地方吗？"

达里乌斯说："我可以明确他们不得妨碍船员。遗憾的是，我们没有任何专用娱乐设施让他们消遣。这类问题很可能会持续发生。"

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Allow card games on the mess deck.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 允许他们在餐厅甲板玩牌.
机甲库中的牌局
达吕斯进行了澄清
将纸牌游戏限制在营房内.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Send the MechWarriors on shore leave.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 送机甲战士去休登岸假.
登岸假
机甲战士们变得更加吵闹了

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The MechWarriors respond well to their space
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 机甲战士对拥有自己的空间反映良好
[阿尔戈号: 无土栽培室]

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Darius opens the morning briefing with a scowl on his face. \"We picked up new supplies a few weeks ago, and we're just now opening some of the crates of machine tools. And, well, I can't believe this has happened again, but…\" Yang practically explodes from his chair. \"We have more frozen [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTripleFBurger],Triple-F Burger]] meat! Do you know how hard this stuff is to come by in the Periphery?\" Dr. Murad sighs audibly. \"Please tell me that the refrigeration was still operational. I don't want a repeat of last time.\" \"Don't worry, Doc—my team will take care of the goods.\" Yang flashes you a winning smile. \"What do you say, Commander? Burgers on the menu?\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 达里乌斯皱着眉开始晨间简报。"我们几周前领了新补给，现在才打开其中几箱机床。而且，嗯，我简直不敢相信这事又发生了，可是……" 杨几乎从椅子上弹起来。"我们又有冻的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTripleFBurger],三F汉堡]]肉！你知道这东西在外缘有多难弄到吗？" 穆拉德博士响亮地叹了口气。"请告诉我制冷还是好的。我不想再重演上一次。" "别担心，博士——我的团队会处理好这批货。"杨朝你露出一个灿烂的笑。"你怎么说，指挥官？菜单上加汉堡？"
要钱选项
销毁那些肉.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Give the crates of meat to Yang.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 把装肉的货箱交给杨.
幸福的意外
机甲技师受损
士气和技师点数提升
没有士气惩罚
重现一款正宗的3F汉堡.
卖掉很多
成功的汉堡

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Task Darius with selling them on the market.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 交代达吕斯把它们卖到市场上.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Later that day, you learn from the planetary news feed that the transport was lost with all hands. It's a tough life here on the Periphery, and survivors quickly learn to look out for their own first and always.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那天稍晚，你从行星新闻播报中得知那艘空投艇全员失踪。在外围区的生活很艰难，幸存者很快学会永远先顾好自己。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
Sumire catches your attention on the bridge. \"Commander, I've picked up a distress call from a nearby civilian transport. It's not exactly our job to assist in matters like this, but we may be the nearest ship available.\"

She studies the display. \"On the other hand, it looks like the ship's engines are in a critical state. They could explode before we get there.\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
苏米尔在舰桥上吸引了你的注意。"指挥官，我收到附近一艘民用空投艇的求救信号。处理这类事情并不算我们的职责，但我们可能是最近的船。"

她盯着显示屏。"另一方面，那艘船的引擎似乎处于危急状态。我们赶到之前它就可能爆炸。"
求救信号
小心调查。
立即发起救援行动。
未发现幸存者
无事发生
别插手。
空投艇自毁
你救出了一些幸存者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sumire falls in beside you as you depart the mess. \"Did you notice the odd moon around this planet? It's quite the point of interest for Periphery scientists… they just can't get enough data on it.\" She eyes you speculatively. \"If we bring the Argo close enough, I could take some sensor readings. Could make for a little easy money. Or, hey, here's an idea, I could take the Leopard down to the surface to do more extensive research. What do you think?\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你离开食堂时，澄美走到你身边。“你注意到这颗星球那颗古怪的月亮了吗？外围地区的科学家对它极感兴趣……他们怎么收集数据都不够。” 她若有所思地看着你。“如果我们把阿尔戈靠近些，我可以做点传感器读数。能轻松赚点小钱。或者——我有个主意——我可以把豹式降到地表做更深入的研究。你觉得呢？”

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sumire catches you after the morning briefing. \"In my downtime, I've been researching this planet. It has some amazing ruins. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
You'd been gathering supplies planetside, but have spent the last hour trying to find Yang. The sound of cheers and pounding metal draws you to the edge of town, where a pair of haphazardly repaired industrial 'Mechs beat on each other.

Yang calls you over. \"Sorry I wandered off, Boss. I heard a guy in the market bragging about this AgroMech fight club. I had to see it for myself.\"

One of the 'Mechs is in notably better condition than the other, but the second clearly has the better -- or possibly drunker -- pilot. The shinier 'Mech finally falls, and a small group of winning bettors collects from the bookie.

Yang gestures to the junkier 'Mech as the cockpit opens. \"You have to meet this pilot. He said 'any AgroMech can be made combat ready, if you’re not afraid of the challenge.' What do you say, shall we buy the victor a drink?\"

你一直在地表收集补给，但过去一小时都在找杨。欢呼声与金属撞击声把你引到镇子边缘，两台草率修好的工业机甲正在互殴。

杨把你叫过去。"抱歉我到处乱走了，老大。我在市场上听一个家伙吹嘘这个农用机甲搏击俱乐部。我必须亲眼看看。"

其中一台机甲状态明显好于另一台，但第二台显然有个更好——或者更醉——的飞行员。那台更光鲜的机甲最终倒下，一小群押中的赌客从庄家那里收钱。

座舱打开时，杨朝那台更破烂的机甲示意。"你得见见这位飞行员。他说过'只要你敢接受挑战，任何农用机甲都能改造成战斗状态'。你怎么说，要不要请这位胜者喝一杯？"

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
In the morning briefing, Sumire had laid out her plans to tour the archeological ruins of {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. \"I've only seen them in Holovids,\" followed by the fateful invitation: \"Commander, you should join me!\"

But now Sumire's splendid views are being ruined by a rabid band of relic hunters, standing between the two of you and the Leopard. Sumire groans. \"This doesn't always happen, Commander, I swear...\"

A voice echoes unexpectedly through the broken buildings. \"These odds aren't very fair. I hope you don't mind if I even them up.\" A man steps out from the shadows on the far side of the smugglers, dressed outlandishly in the style of a Star League era movie star, but brandishing two gleaming pistols.

Two smugglers spin in the gunslinger's direction, then immediately crumple to the dirt, with a spray of blood and an echo of gunshots. After a fusillade of bullets from your and Sumire's sidearms, a third enemy crumples lifelessly. The remaining smugglers flee toward their vehicles.

The gunslinger holsters his pistols in a dextrous flourish. \"You look out of place without your Mech, Commander.\"

\"Uh, have we met?\" asks Sumire.

The man laughs. \"No. I just have a good eye for warriors who have forgotten their swords.\"

但现在苏米蕾的壮丽景色被一帮狂热的遗物猎人毁了，他们挡在你们两人与豹式之间。苏米蕾呻吟了一声。"指挥官，这可不是每次都这样，我发誓……"

一个声音出乎意料地在破败的建筑间回荡。"这赔率不太公平。希望你不介意我把它们拉平。"一个男人从走私者另一侧的阴影中走出来，衣着奇特地模仿星盟时代电影明星的风格，双手却握着两把闪亮的枪。

两名走私者朝枪手的方向转身，随即立刻倒在尘土中，血花飞溅，枪声回荡。在你和苏米蕾的随身武器一阵齐射之后，第三名敌人无声地倒下。剩下的走私者朝他们的车辆逃去。

枪手以灵巧的姿态把双枪插回枪套。"没有机甲的你看起来不太对劲，指挥官。"

"呃，我们见过吗？"苏米蕾问。

那人大笑。"没有。我只是很擅长看出哪些战士忘了带剑。"

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 达里乌斯在最后一个集装箱登记入舱时翻阅着补给清单。"这是最后一批了，指挥官。线缆与数据线、穿引全部线路用的导管、一批扎实的传感器与探针，以及一整套通讯设备，把机库与阿戈号其余部分连起来。" 杨从他肩后探过头来扫视清单。"配线和这地方的眼睛耳朵，我们要的全都有了。机库真的开始看起来有一天能用了。等我们终于找到结构材料，就能拥有把活干完所需的一切。"

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
<color=#BFBFBF>Darius taps through a supply manifest as the last container gets logged into the hold.</color> \"That's the last of it, Commander. Cable and data line, the conduit to run it all through, a solid stock of sensors and probes, and a full set of communications gear to tie the hangar together with the rest of the Argo.\"

<color=#BFBFBF>Yang leans over his shoulder, scanning the list.</color> \"Everything we needed for the wiring and the eyes and ears of the place. Hangar's actually starting to look like it might work one day. We finally have everything needed to finish the job properly, just need the construction crew now.\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
<color=#BFBFBF>最后一个集装箱被登记入舱时，达里乌斯翻着补给清单。</color>“就这些了，指挥官。电缆与数据线、把一切穿起来的导管、一整批传感器与探测器，还有一整套通讯设备，把机库与阿尔戈的其余部分连起来。”

<color=#BFBFBF>杨凑到他肩头扫视清单。</color>“布线和这个地方的眼睛耳朵，我们要的全都有了。机库终于开始像样、有一天也许真能用了。我们终于有了把这项工作彻底完成所需的一切，现在只差施工队了。”

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
<color=#BFBFBF>Yang's voice comes over the comm from the cargo bay, breathless.</color> \"Commander, get down here.\"

<color=#BFBFBF>By the time you arrive, the salvaged transport's cargo container is already cracked open, its contents spilled across the deck plating. Yang crouches beside a stack of dense metal ingots, running a scanner over one.</color>

\"Whatever this thing was hauling cargo for, they packed it right. This is naval-grade Ferro-Aluminum, same stuff Farah's been hunting for the hangar job.\" <color=#BFBFBF>He hefts one of the ingots, testing its weight.</color> \"Can't tell you what it was meant to be used for, they stripped the ID plates clean off the container before it ever left port. Doesn't matter much either way. What matters is we've got it now.\"

<color=#BFBFBF>He does a rough count of the stacked ingots.</color> \"Looks close to a full ton, near as I can eyeball it. Worth having it weighed properly before anybody starts celebrating.\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
<color=#BFBFBF>杨的声音从货舱的通讯器里传来，气喘吁吁。</color>“指挥官，下来一趟。”

<color=#BFBFBF>等你赶到时，那艘被打捞上来的运输船货柜已被撬开，里面的东西散落在甲板上。杨蹲在一堆致密的金属锭旁，用扫描仪扫着其中一块。</color>

“不管这东西是给什么运货的，他们打包得很讲究。这是舰用级铁铝合金，正是法拉为机库那活儿一直在找的材料。”<color=#BFBFBF>他掂起一块金属锭，试了试分量。</color>“我没法告诉你它本来打算用来做什么，货柜还没离港，识别牌就被他们拆得一干二净了。反正也不重要。重要的是它现在在我们手上。”

<color=#BFBFBF>他粗略清点了一下堆放的金属锭。</color>“凭我肉眼估摸，差不多有一整吨。在有人开香宾庆祝之前，最好还是正经称一称。”
获得铁铝合金

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Darius brings a thorny issue to the daily briefing. \"Commander, our relationship with the Federated Suns has been steadily degrading.\" Yang grins, \"Well, we do keep kicking their asses for money. Probably related.\" Darius nods, \"Just so. Purely business, but they're not convinced. As a result, the Mercenary Review Board has invited us to sit down with a Davion envoy and discuss the situation.\" He pauses to let that sink in. \"They're waiting for us right here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}.\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 达里乌斯在每日简报上提出一个棘手问题。"指挥官，我们与联邦太阳的关系一直在稳步恶化。" 杨咧嘴一笑，"嗯，我们确实一直为了钱踢他们的屁股。大概有点关系吧。" 达里乌斯点点头，"正是如此。纯属生意，但他们并不这么认为。因此，雇佣兵审查委员会邀请我们与一位达维昂特使坐下来谈谈此事。"他顿了顿，让这话沉淀一下。"他们就在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}等着我们。"

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sumire explains the unpleasant variation in the usual planetary approach. \"Commander, the port authorities want to search us. Apparently the Argo's gotten onto a watch-list because of our tendency to be spotted in the company of pirates. If we choose not to comply, we're going to pay a hefty fine.\" Yang sounds skeptical. \"If they do search us, I bet they're going to find something to complain about -- real or not.\" Darius has been notably quiet. \"Or... we can try to bribe the inspectors.\" He grins. \"I can work some connections to try to arrange for a sympathetic ear when they come aboard.\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
苏米尔解释了这次例行降落中令人不快的变数。"指挥官，港务当局想搜查我们。显然'阿尔戈'号因为常被发现在海盗身边而上了观察名单。如果我们选择不配合，就得付一大笔罚款。"

杨听起来很怀疑。"要是他们真来搜，我打赌他们总能找出点可抱怨的东西——不管真有没有。"

达里乌斯一直异常安静。"或者……我们可以设法贿赂检查员。"他咧嘴一笑。"我可以动用一些关系，等他们上船时安排个愿意听我们说的人。"
允许搜查。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Douglass…? Through your rush of old memories, Darius goes on. \"He claims to be a friend from your freelancing days. I'll put him through to your quarters.\" Douglass' voice has weathered with age. \"It's been a long time, {COMMANDER.FirstName}. I've heard you've been busy. Me too. But let's not beat around the bush… I need a favor.\" His crew has had a rough go of it lately, and if he doesn't line up a new contract soon, he's going to lose them. Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
Yang bends down, loosening the screws on the venting unit in your private quarters. \"I've got bad news, Boss.\" He pries the grate free, coughing because of the floating particles.

\"Let me guess…\" Darius leans in the doorway. \"Killer dust bunnies?\"

Yang ignores the XO. \"You know the MechTechs are always griping. It's nearly an official pastime in the Mech Bay, but what I'm catching a whiff of sounds like real trouble. They're overworked and underpaid. They want a serious end-of-year bonus. Can't say I blame 'em.\"

\"Aren't we all?\" Darius's grin slips as he pulls up the budget on his compad. \"They know we gotta keep costs down. How about we replace the 'Techs that are complaining? It's risky, but new expenses are popping up every day. What do you say, Commander?\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
杨弯腰松开你私人舱室里通风单元的螺丝。“坏消息，老板。”他撬开格栅，被飘起的灰尘呛得咳嗽。

“让我猜猜……”达里乌斯倚在门口。“灰尘怪兽？”

杨没理这位副官。“你知道机甲技师一直在抱怨。这几乎成了机甲库里的官方消遣。但我闻到的那点味道听起来是真麻烦：他们又累又没拿到该拿的钱，想要一笔正经的年终奖金。我倒不怪他们。”

“我们不都这样吗？”达里乌斯在掌机上翻出预算，笑容淡了。“他们知道我们得压低成本。要不把抱怨的技师换掉？虽然冒险，但新开支天天冒出来。你说呢，指挥官？”

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Blaring klaxons interrupt an otherwise quiet morning routine as several fast-moving ships appear, pacing the Argo. Darius broadcasts their hail to the bridge. \"You're flying through our space, strangers. It's awfully dangerous out here. Just awful, especially for a ragged-looking ship like… the Argo, is it? Tell you what, we'll provide you with a safe passage. For a price, of course.\" While you consider your options, Sumire pipes up. \"Commander, if you can buy me some time, I could do a rapid fire-up of the Leopard. That'll teach them not to mess with us.\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 刺耳的警报打断了原本安静的晨间例程，几艘快速移动的舰船出现，与阿戈号并行。达里乌斯把他们的呼叫广播到舰桥。 "你们正飞越我们的空间，陌生人。这一带危险得很。太危险了，尤其对一艘像……阿戈号这样破烂的船。这么办吧，我们为你提供安全通行。当然，要收点费。" 你正在权衡选择时，苏米蕾开口了。"指挥官，如果你能给我争取点时间，我可以让豹式快速点火。这会教他们别来惹我们。"

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Darius opens the briefing by calling up an official-looking report on the viewscreen. \"There's a Periphery Pox pandemic here on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}.\" He pauses, \"It may be heartless, but we could earn back the entire development cost of our serum!\" Dr. Murad groans. \"Darius, entire cities are quarantined. Heartless isn't the word.\" Sumire raises her voice. \"I found a charity that could manage replication and distribution. Alternately, there's a bloc of companies that will buy replication rights, then sell the serum to the charity.\" She looks at Darius. \"And one company is offering a premium for exclusive rights and total control.\"

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
In the daily briefing, Sumire brings up an open hail from a nearby ship. \"They say their crew has contracted a virulent case of the Periphery Pox, but the local government is preventing them from landing to receive medical care.\"

Darius shrugs. \"We could sell them some of our medical supplies. It would limit us in the MedBay for a bit, but given their situation, I expect they'd pay up.\"

Dr. Murad bristles at this suggestion. \"Spacers should stick together, Commander. Besides, the local authorities might appreciate our generosity.\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
在每日简报中，苏米尔提到附近一艘船的公开呼叫。"他们说船员染上了烈性外围区痘疮，但当地政府不许他们降落接受治疗。"

达里乌斯耸耸肩。"我们可以卖给他们一些医疗补给。这会让医疗舱受点限制，但看他们的处境，我想他们会付钱的。"

穆拉德医生对这种建议很不满。"太空人应该彼此照应，指挥官。再说，地方当局也许会感激我们的慷慨。"

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
Sumire reports a call for help from a nearby ship. \"It's another ship that's contracted the Periphery Pox.\"

Darius begins to speak, but Dr. Murad cuts him off. \"I know what our XO will say.\" She continues in a perfect imitation of Darius, \"We went to the trouble of developing this serum, let's make back some of that investment!\"

With a smile, Darius plays along. \"Speaking for our dear Dr. Murad, we've suffered from the Pox ourselves. Let's give away our serum, and maybe the locals will smile at us afterward.\"

Dr. Murad finishes with, \"If we do sell the serum, I think we could easily get ¢80k.\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
苏米尔报告附近一艘船求援。"又是一艘染上外围区痘疮的船。"

达里乌斯刚要开口，穆拉德医生打断他。"我知道我们的副官会说什么。"她用完美模仿达里乌斯的语气继续，"我们费那么大劲研制出这血清，总得赚回点投资吧！"

达里乌斯笑着配合。"替我们亲爱的穆拉德医生说：我们自己也得过痘疮。不如把血清送出去，说不定当地人以后会对我们笑一笑。"

穆拉德医生收尾道："如果真要卖血清，我想我们轻松能拿到 8 万信用点。"
