Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
你和达里乌斯正在地表一家酒吧拓展关系网，此时正赶上庆祝活动。酒吧上方的显示屏上，一对幸福夫妇的照片配着"王室婚礼"的字样，解释了那些祝酒词。

然而在你邻桌，你意外地听到了自己的名字。"是啊，你们这里的贵族家族可比老家的{COMMANDER.LastName}家族体面多了。他们家那个烂孩子把一切都毁了！就算他们把{COMMANDER.Obj}流放了，那家族也没法把这事翻篇。我们就是外缘的笑柄！"

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defend your honor with your fists.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 用你的拳头守护你的荣誉.
放下往事.
久远的回忆
无事发生

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Take the high road and buy a round of drinks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 堂堂正正地请所有人喝一杯.
你战斗了
你花了钱

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
You and Darius are networking in a planetside bar. As Darius fetches the first round, you overhear the too-loud whispers from a nearby table. \"I'm telling you, those two are MechWarriors!\" 

A hissed response: \"What would you know? It's not like on the Holovids.\"

Out of the corner your eye, you scan the group, and it's like you're gazing into your own past. Three young nobles casually stare in your direction, pampered and comfortable. Written all over their eager faces is a feeling you remember too well: looking for an escape from their safe, predictable lives.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
你和达里乌斯正在地表一家酒吧拓展关系网。达里乌斯去拿第一轮酒时，你听到邻桌传来过于响亮的低语。"我跟你说，那两个人是机师！"

一声压低的回应："你懂什么？又不是全息剧里演的那样。"

你用眼角余光扫过那群人，就像在凝视自己的过去。三名年轻的贵族随意地朝你这边看着，娇生惯养、安逸自在。他们跃跃欲试的脸上写满了一种你太熟悉的感觉：想从安全可预测的生活中逃离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Invite them to a meeting with a client.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 邀请他们与客户见面.
让他们独自呆着.
无事发生
机甲战士的真实生活
直接恐吓他们.
你吓到他们了
[阿尔戈号: 无土栽培室]

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: At your direction, the kitchen reduces meal sizes to make supplies last to the next quarter. Tempers flare, and the MechWarriors start frequent arguments with the kitchen staff over their caloric needs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 根据你的指示，厨房开始减少配餐的饭量来维持补给到下个季度. 情绪开始蔓延，机甲战士们开始频频为自己的热量需要与厨房员工吵架.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Darius mentions that the ship's galley is low on provisions at the daily briefing. \"We need to make a supply run, but the question is when? Putting the crew on reduced rations could work in the short term if things are too tight.\" Everybody else at the briefing groans as they look at you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 达里乌斯在每日简报中提到船上的厨房补给不足。“我们得跑一趟补给，问题是何时去？如果实在紧张，短期内让船员减量配给也行。”简报中的其他人看着你，发出一片呻吟。
授权立刻运营一家杂货店.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Expand Hydroponics to grow more vegetables.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 扩大无土栽培室种植更多的蔬菜.
饥饿的机甲战士是一群难以驾驭的机甲战士
勒紧裤带

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You authorize the kitchen to buy more supplies
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你授权厨房购买更多的物资

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As you approach the mess deck, you overhear members of the Argo's crew complaining. Because they're significantly understaffed, everybody is exhausted from pulling extra shifts to keep things running. It hasn't overwhelmed them yet, but they have dark expectations about the future.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你接近食堂甲板时，无意中听到阿戈号船员在抱怨。由于人手严重不足，每个人都因加班顶班维持运转而筋疲力尽。这还没把他们压垮，但他们对未来有着暗淡的预期。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Discuss the lack of discipline with Darius.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与达吕斯讨论团队缺乏纪律的问题.
让他们私下发泄.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The crew get it out of their systems
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 船员把它从他们的系统中弄出来了
不满蔓延开来
严格纪律
[阿尔戈号: 改良的电力管道]

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In Navigation, Sumire highlights a blinking red alert in the Argo's path. \"We've got some space junk in our way, Commander. Permission to blast it to dust with the Leopard?\" \"Debris,\" Dr. Murad corrects her. \"I recommend that we attempt to avoid it. Otherwise, you risk sending the debris in unexpected directions. You could damage our most vital systems and bays.\" Sumire rolls her eyes. \"The Argo isn't exactly an agile ship. I mean, I'm good, but she's never going to turn on a dime. We've got about five minutes, roughly. We need a decision, Commander.\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在导航室，苏米蕾标出阿戈号航路上一个闪烁的红色警报。"指挥官，有太空垃圾挡住了我们的路。允许我用豹式把它轰成尘埃吗？" "是碎片，"穆拉德博士纠正她。"我建议我们尝试避开它。否则你有把碎片射向意外方向的风险。你可能损坏我们最重要的系统与舱室。" 苏米蕾翻了个白眼。"阿戈号可不是什么灵巧的船。我是说，我技术不错，但她永远不会一个急转就调头。我们大概有五分钟，大约。我们需要一个决定，指挥官。"
机甲库受损
医务室受到的损坏

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Deploy the Leopard to destroy the debris.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 派出豹式摧毁残骸.
机甲库中的爆炸

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Force more power to the engines.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 强制将更多功率输送到引擎.
医务室受到重大损坏
重大成功
少量损毁
轻微擦伤
执行一次标准的规避机动.
表面伤害
意想不到的残骸

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In the daily briefing, Darius brings up the Barracks climate control system. \"Apparently it's started cycling randomly between 'tolerable' and 'the inside of a 'Mech cockpit in a desert.'\" Dr. Murad just shrugs. \"I can replace the fan controllers again, but it may not be money well spent. Something else is going on in the unimproved power conduits, but as the Argo is very old, and very complicated, tracking it down has been difficult.\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 每日简报时，达里乌斯提起了兵营的气候控制系统。"显然它已经开始在'凑合能忍'和'沙漠里机甲座舱内部'之间随机循环了。" 穆拉德博士只是耸耸肩。"我可以再换一次风扇控制器，但这钱可能花得不值。未改造的电力导管里另有蹊跷，可阿戈号太老、太复杂了，要查出来很难。"
彻底重建系统.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Distribute portable fans to those affected.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 向受影响的人分发便携风扇.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Farah fixes the problem, for now
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 法拉修复了这个问题，暂时的

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fix it once and for all
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 完全修好以绝后患
更换风扇控制器.
便携式风扇大多正常运作
便携式风扇正常运作
通风故障

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In the morning briefing, Yang says, \"I've got a mystery here. The cargo lifters need replacing, but someone ripped the diagnostic circuits out of our spares. Unless those are returned, the spares can't balance.\" Dr. Murad makes a face. \"Oh, yes. I raided those to patch holes in the Argo's internal sensors. Without them, the systems won't manage air circulation properly. And then… we get the bad odor funk. Sweat. Old food. Radishes.\" Dr. Murad's faraway gaze returns to Yang. \"I did intend to tell you, but then the Argo went and broke again.\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 晨间简报时，杨说："我这儿出了桩怪事。货运升降机需要更换，但有人把备件里的诊断电路给拆走了。除非把它们还回来，否则备件没法配平。" 穆拉德博士做了个鬼脸。"哦，对。我拆了那些去补阿戈号内部传感器的漏洞。没有它们，系统就无法正常管理空气循环。然后……我们就会闻上那股臭味。汗味。剩饭味。萝卜味。" 穆拉德博士游离的目光重新落到杨身上。"我本来打算告诉你的，可接着阿戈号又坏了。"
购买替代品.
士气下降

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Return the circuits to the lifters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 重新给起重机通电.
花费金钱
破旧的起重机
[阿尔戈号: 多个训练模块]

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In the middle of the afternoon, you find [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] hunkered in the Arcade playing MERCENARIES!, a tie-in to [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHolovidMercenaries],the popular Holovid show]]. \"Commander, have you played this game yet? Maybe it touches a little too close to home. See, I'm managing my own Mercenary company in the Periphery!\" Over {TGT_MW.DET} shoulder, you see charts and data and little icons representing all the 'Mechs at {TGT_MW.Det} disposal. You flash back to Darius' recent run-down of monthly expenses. \"I'm a bit stuck. What do you think I should do?\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 午后时分，你发现[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]窝在街机厅里玩《雇佣兵！》，那是[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreHolovidMercenaries],热门全息剧集]]的衍生游戏。 "指挥官，你玩过这个游戏吗？也许它离现实有点太近了。你看，我在外缘经营着自己的雇佣兵公司！" 从{TGT_MW.DET}肩后望去，你看到图表、数据，以及代表{TGT_MW.Det}麾下所有机甲的小图标。你脑中闪回达里乌斯最近那份月度开支清单。 "我有点卡住了。你觉得我该怎么做？"
医务室奖励
“佣兵!”游戏
打发{TGT_MW.Callsign}去训练模块.
发生了些什么
建议{TGT_MW.OBJ}改善医务室.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Warn {TGT_MW.Obj} to negotiate more on Contracts.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 警告{TGT_MW.Obj}在合约谈判中索要更多.
经验获得

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
The crew is bubbling with enthusiasm about a local cliff-diving competition.

In the morning briefing, Darius says, \"[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] has requested permission to compete. Given the general interest, I'd like you to make the call.\"

Sumire says, \"Let {TGT_MW.Obj} go. It'll be entertaining.\"

Yang adds, \"You could send us—them—all. To cheer {TGT_MW.Callsign} on. It'd be a bonding experience.\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
船员们正为当地的一场悬崖跳水比赛兴奋不已。

在晨间简报中，Darius 说：“[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] 已申请获准参赛。考虑到大家都很有兴趣，这件事就请你来定夺。”

Sumire 说：“让 {TGT_MW.Obj} 去吧。会很有意思的。”

Yang 补了一句：“你可以把我们——他们——全都派去。去给 {TGT_MW.Callsign} 加油。这会是一次增进感情的经历。”
拒绝登岸假请求.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: earns a brave tag and injury
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 获得"勇敢"标记并受伤
获得"勇敢"标记
赢得一个谨慎的特性

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Grant a broad shore leave for anyone to attend.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 授权一般性登岸假给任何想参与的人.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Grant general leave and put {TGT_MW.Callsign} into training.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 授权一般性假期，并让{TGT_MW.Callsign}进行训练.
授权登岸假给{TGT_MW.Callsign}.
士气更加低落

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
You happen to be in the Mech Bay when [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] approaches Yang with a question. \"Uh, Chief? I was wondering if you had any B A eleven hundred Ns in stock. I'd really like to get one installed on my 'Mech.\"

Yang looks at you to make sure you're hearing this, then turns back to {TGT_MW.Callsign} and replies with admirable gravity, \"You don't see those often on the field. Are you sure you want us to install a B A eleven hundred N on your BattleMech?\"

\"Yes sir. [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] says it'll really improve the 'Mech's stability.\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
当[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]带着一个问题走向杨时，你恰好就在机甲库。"呃，总工？我想问问你有没有B A 1100 N的现货。我很想在我的机甲上装一个。"

杨看了看你，确认你听到了这话，然后转回{TGT_MW.Callsign}，以令人钦佩的郑重语气回答："你在战场上可不常看到那种东西。你确定要我们在你的战斗机甲上装一台B A 1100 N吗？"

"是的，长官。[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]说它能大幅提升机甲的稳定性。"
B A 1100 N
解释一下
向{TGT_MW.Callsign}解释这个玩笑.
为难杨
观察事态的发展.
[{TGT_MW.Callsign}: 勇敢]

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
In the Command Center, the comm system squawks.\"Command? Anybody?\" It's [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], with a nervy edge in {TGT_MW.Det} voice. \"There's a big fire in the Barracks! Everybody's out, but… not our stuff. Is there anything else I can do?\"

Dr. Murad calls out a reply. \"How did…\" Her voice is sharp with alarm. Moments later, she continues: \"…Commander, I've turned off power and ventilation, but the fire won't go out while there's oxygen to burn. I'm going to have to remotely vent the pod.\"

\"Commander, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] just found some dusty fire extinguishers behind a panel!\" says {TGT_MW.Callsign}.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
在指挥中心，通讯系统发出刺耳的声音。"指挥？有人在吗？"是[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]，{TGT_MW.Det}的声音里带着一丝紧张。"兵营里起大火了！大家都出来了，但……我们的东西没出来。我还能做点什么吗？"

穆拉德博士出声回答。"怎么会……"她的声音因警觉而尖锐。片刻后，她继续说："……指挥官，我已经关掉电力和通风，但只要有氧气可烧，火就不会灭。我将不得不远程给该舱室泄压。"

"指挥官，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]刚在一块面板后面找到了几个满是灰尘的灭火器！"{TGT_MW.Callsign}说。
营房火灾

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Allow {TGT_MW.Callsign} to try to put out the fire {TGT_MW.REFL}.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 允许{TGT_MW.Callsign}{TGT_MW.REFL}去灭火.
机甲战士受伤
机甲战士受伤

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Send in {TGT_MW.Callsign} and {SCN_MW.Callsign} to put out the fire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 派{TGT_MW.Callsign}和{SCN_MW.Callsign}去灭火.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The fire is contained but the pod is damaged.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火势得到控制，但舱室受损.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The fire is contained with no significant damage
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 火势得到控制，没有造成太大伤害
让舱室向太空排气.
[{TGT_MW.Callsign}: 军人]

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
After hearing that [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] was involved in an accident, you stop by MedBay to visit the MechWarrior as {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:recover|Default:recovers}.

\"Hi, Commander.\" {TGT_MW.Callsign} touches the bandage on {TGT_MW.DET} head. \"I was doing pull-ups on the wall shelf, and it came loose. The shelf above it came down, too. Right on my head.\"

You shake your head, frowning. \"You know those shelves aren't rated for your weight.\"

{TGT_MW.Callsign} laughs. \"I wish I had a better option, Commander. There's just not enough room to roam right now.\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
听说[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]出了事故后，你顺路去医疗舱探望这名机师，此时{TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:recover|Default:recovers}。

"你好，指挥官。"{TGT_MW.Callsign}碰了碰{TGT_MW.DET}头上的绷带。"我在墙上的架子上做引体向上，它松了。上面那个架子也塌了下来。正好砸在我头上。"

你摇头皱眉。"你知道那些架子撑不住你的体重。"

{TGT_MW.Callsign}笑了。"我希望我有更好的选择，指挥官。现在实在没多少地方可以活动。"
士气受到打击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Develop an exercise regimen for the MechWarriors.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为机甲战士们制定锻炼方案.
暂时顺其自然.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 让{TGT_MW.Callsign}制定锻炼方案.
营房健身
机甲战士们得到了一些锻炼

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The MechWarriors get some exercise, unhappily
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 机甲战士们得到了一些锻炼，但并不高兴

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
Under a white sheet in the MedBay, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]'s lifeless body lies between you and Darius. \"By the time the MedTechs started operating, {TGT_MW.Callsign} was beyond repair, Commander. {TGT_MW.DET_C} injuries were exacerbated by {TGT_MW.DET} [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTBI],TBI]].\"

You pass a photo of {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s mother to the XO. \"Make sure you find her and any other next of kin. Inform them immediately.\"

The XO nods. \"There's more. I overheard [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] talking like you got {TGT_MW.Callsign} killed. {SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:weren't|Default:wasn't} the only one. You need to get ahead of these rumors fast.\"

\"{TGT_MW.Callsign} knew the risks. {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} wanted back in the cockpit more than anything.\"

\"You and I know that, but not everyone sees it that way. During the memorial service, you could take ownership of {TGT_MW.Callsign}'s death—appease your critics—but that won't exactly boost morale. Or you can commemorate {TGT_MW.Callsign}. That'll lift spirits, though {SCN_MW.Callsign} might take it the wrong way. It's your call, Commander.\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
在医疗舱的一张白床单下，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]没有生命的身体躺在你和达里乌斯之间。"医疗技师开始手术时，{TGT_MW.Callsign}已经无可挽回，指挥官。{TGT_MW.DET_C}的伤势被{TGT_MW.DET}的[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreTBI],创伤性脑损伤]]加重了。"

执行官点点头。"还有。我无意中听到[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]说，好像是你害死了{TGT_MW.Callsign}。{SCN_MW.SUBJ_C} {SCN_MW.Gender?NonBinary:weren't|Default:wasn't}唯一一个这么想的。你需要尽快压住这些谣言。"

"{TGT_MW.Callsign}知道风险。{TGT_MW.SUBJ_C}比什么都想回到座舱里。"

"你我都知道这一点，但不是所有人都这么看。在追悼会上，你可以为{TGT_MW.Callsign}的死承担责任——平息批评者——但那不会真正提振士气。或者你可以纪念{TGT_MW.Callsign}。那会鼓舞人心，尽管{SCN_MW.Callsign}可能会从不好的角度理解。由你决定，指挥官。"

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
It's Trivia Night, and one of the largest casinos in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} is packed. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] entered and has been on a hot streak.

\"Come on, Commander!\" Darius leans closer, but still has to shout to be heard. \"{TGT_MW.Callsign} just got the last six answers right. Even at a minimum bet, we would have made ¢5,000. Let's see if we can make some money tonight!\"

Just then, [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] totters past, drink in hand. Darius grabs {SCN_MW.OBJ}. \"Better yet, {SCN_MW.Callsign} here gives us four for a high-stakes competition team.\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
今天是问答之夜，{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}最大的赌场之一挤满了人。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]参加了，而且手气正旺。

"来吧，指挥官！"达里乌斯凑近了些，但仍得大声喊才能被听见。"{TGT_MW.Callsign}刚答对了最后六题。就算按最低投注，我们也能赚5千C币。今晚看看我们能不能挣点钱！"

就在这时，[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]手里拿着酒摇摇晃晃走过。达里乌斯拽住{SCN_MW.OBJ}。"更好的是，这里的{SCN_MW.Callsign}能让我们凑成一支四人高额竞赛队。"

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In the middle of the night, you're flung from your bed. Metal screeches deep inside the Argo. Dr. Murad's voice crackles over the comms. \"Everything is under control, Commander, but [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] needs adult supervision.\" Darius drags the pilot into your quarters. \"{TGT_MW.Callsign} discovered how to destabilize a DropShip with a penlaser.\" Quickly {TGT_MW.Det} face reddens. \"It was an accident!\" Darius crosses his arms. \"You've had a lot of accidents. Luckily, nothing major, but this one nearly sent the drive stabilizer flying into the fusion reactors. How do you want to handle this, Commander?\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 半夜时分，你被掀下床。金属声在阿尔戈深处刺耳地尖叫。穆拉德博士的声音在通讯里劈啪作响。“一切都在控制之中，指挥官，但[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]需要有人看着。” 达里乌斯把那名飞行员拖进你的舱室。“{TGT_MW.Callsign}发现了怎么用笔形激光让空投艇失稳。” {TGT_MW.Det}的脸迅速涨红。“那是意外！” 达里乌斯抱起双臂。“你的意外可不少。所幸没有大事故，但这次差点把驱动稳定器甩进聚变反应堆。指挥官，你想怎么处理？”
夜晚的颠簸
实施严格的纪律.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
It wasn't your imagination after all. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] really has been hiding a kitten in {TGT_MW.DET} room, and now that they're both in front of you, the cat is making all sorts of noise at the indignity of being held up for inspection.

You fix {TGT_MW.Callsign} with a stern look until {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:start|Default:starts} talking.

\"Commander, I found this cat in my bag after I came back from shore leave. I think she climbed in looking for food. I didn't have the heart to, you know…\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
原来不是你的错觉。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]确实在{TGT_MW.DET}房间里藏着一个小猫，如今她们俩都在你面前，而那只猫正因为被举起来检查这份屈辱而发出各种叫声。

你板着脸盯着{TGT_MW.Callsign}，直到{TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:start|Default:starts}开口。

"指挥官，我休假回来之后在包里发现了这只猫。我想她爬进去找吃的。我实在不忍心，你知道的……"

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Accept the cat, but make {TGT_MW.Callsign} sweat first.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 接受猫，但先让{TGT_MW.Callsign}出身汗.
我们可以留下它吗?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Send the cat back to the surface.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 把猫送回到地面.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
In your quarters, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] points to a compad. \"Commander, I got an offer from another company, the Gray Death Legion. Their CO, [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGraysonCarlyle],Grayson Carlyle]], is paying top dollar for mercs. He's even offering a kickback to any company he 'poaches' from—a hundred thousand C-bills.\"

\"That's unusual,\" you say, examining the paused image of Carlyle on the compad. \"Go on.\"

\"Carlyle's something else. I played his message over and over. The way he talks… I know he really could shake up the galaxy. And I wanna be a part of that.\" {TGT_MW.Callsign} smiles bittersweetly. \"But this crew is my family and leaving isn’t so easy. What do you think?\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
在你的舱室里，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]指着一个小型电脑。"指挥官，我收到了另一家公司的邀请，灰死军团。他们的指挥官[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGraysonCarlyle],格雷森·卡莱尔]]为雇佣兵开出顶级的价码。他甚至愿意为从他'挖'走的每家公司支付回扣——十万C币。"

"这很不寻常，"你说着，端详着电脑上卡莱尔定格的图像。"继续说。"

"卡莱尔不一般。我把他的留言反复播了很多遍。他说话的方式……我知道他真的能震动这个银河。而我想成为其中一部分。"{TGT_MW.Callsign}苦甜参半地笑了笑。"但这支队伍是我的家，离开并不容易。你觉得呢？"

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Caution {TGT_MW.Callsign} against making a quick decision.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 告诫{TGT_MW.Callsign}不要草率决定.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Encourage {TGT_MW.Callsign} to keep the kickback if {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:leave|Default:leaves}.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 告诉{TGT_MW.Callsign}要是{TGT_MW.OBJ}决定离开的话，就留着那笔回扣.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Give {TGT_MW.Callsign} your blessing if {TGT_MW.SUBJ} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:want|Default:wants} to leave.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 告诉{TGT_MW.Callsign}如果{TGT_MW.OBJ}想走的话，你会送上你的祝福.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
\"It's never going to work,\" says [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]].

\"It'll work,\" says [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]].

\"And even if it doesn't work, it'll be awesome,\" says [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]].

You look curiously over at the three MechWarriors clustered around a table in the mess hall. Noticing your interest, {SCN_MW.Callsign} calls you over, showing you a miniature [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreCatapultSiegeWarfare],medieval catapult]] constructed of dried noodles, bits of edible foam and elastic bands.

\"…Why?\" you ask.

\"We were using utensils at first but the cook took them away,\" says {SCN_MW.Callsign}.

{TRT_MW.Callsign} says, \"If we can get it tuned properly, it'll be great for radishes.\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
"这永远不会成功的，"[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]说。

"会成功的，"[[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]]说。

"就算不成功，也会很酷，"[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]说。

你好奇地看向食堂里围在桌旁的那三名机师。注意到你的兴趣，{SCN_MW.Callsign}把你叫过去，给你看一台用干面条、可食用泡沫碎块和橡皮筋搭成的迷你[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreCatapultSiegeWarfare],中世纪投石机]]。

"……为什么？"你问。

"一开始我们用餐具，但厨师把餐具收走了，"{SCN_MW.Callsign}说。

{TRT_MW.Callsign}说："要是我们能把它调好，对付萝卜会很棒。"

In the morning briefing, Darius has a request to pass along.

\"[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] want to get some training outside of getting shot at by lasers planetside.\"

穆拉德博士指出："我们确实有那些训练模块。它们会很理想，尤其对经验较少的机师。不过……很抱歉，它们还没能运转起来。"

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
In the morning briefing, Sumire asks something unexpected: \"So, what's the story with those MechWarriors bowling in the barracks hallways?\"

Darius crosses his arms over his chest. \"I've already put an end to that. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] were calling it 'corridor bocce'… I shut it down as a matter of discipline.\"

You turn to Darius. \"How much trouble have their games caused?\"

\"They're playing in unused corridors, so not much. But it was only a matter of time before something… or someone… got damaged. We should really repair the gym in Beta Pod instead.\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
晨间简报时，苏米蕾问了个出人意料的问题："那么，那些在兵营走廊里打保龄球的机师是怎么回事？"

达里乌斯双臂抱在胸前。"我已经制止了。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]和[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]把它叫做"走廊地滚球"……我以纪律为由把它禁了。"

你转向达里乌斯。"他们的游戏惹了多少麻烦？"

"他们在闲置走廊里玩，所以麻烦不大。但迟早会有什么东西……或者什么人……被弄坏。我们真该修一下贝塔舱的健身房。"

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You receive a call from Dr. Murad. \"Commander, the Argo is testing me. I have a negative reading from one of our rotational assembly's coupling joints. If it's not repaired quickly, it'll shut down our grav modules. \"Our problem joint is near the reactor shielding, in a very hard to reach place. I can try to patch around it, but I'm not sure that will work. \"What I'd prefer to do is have someone go EVA to perform the repair. [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] has plenty of experience with external ship work, and is ready to attempt the fix. Now, it's a bit risky, and I know how you value your MechWarriors. I'd like your call before I authorize the repair.\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你接到穆拉德博士的呼叫。"指挥官，阿戈号在考验我。我们的一个旋转组件连接处读数异常。如果不尽快维修，它会关停我们的重力模块。 "出问题的连接处靠近反应堆屏蔽层，位置极难接近。我可以试着绕过去打补丁，但我不确定那能行。 "我更希望有人出舱去进行维修。[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]有大量舰外作业经验，并已准备好尝试修复。这有点风险，而我知道你多看重你的机师。在我授权维修之前，我想听你的决定。"

[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] joins you on a supply run in one of {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}'s major cities. As the trip winds down, you realize you're being followed. Not long after, a dirty man with a dangerous sneer steps in front of {TGT_MW.Callsign}. \"We've been looking for you, {TGT_MW.Firstname},\" he says as several more figures close in around you.

You look the man over. \"What's this about, {TGT_MW.Callsign}?\"

\"Ah, this is a little creep I used to know, Commander. Back before I joined up with you. I don't think he likes me much anymore.\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:

你打量了一下那个男人。"这是怎么回事，{TGT_MW.Callsign}？"

"啊，这是个小人渣，我以前认识，指挥官。在我加入你之前。我不觉得他还多喜欢我。"

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
In an unused corridor near Gamma Pod, Darius shows you a strange chart written on the wall in chalk. Each row lists a MechWarrior callsign, and in the columns next to each name: a percentage and a number in C-Bills.

As you compare the C-Bill values and the relative experience of the MechWarriors listed, you realize that this is a perverse betting pool. The percentages must represent the survival odds for each MechWarrior.

Just then [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] rounds the corner and stops short. A stick of chalk falls from {TGT_MW.DET} fingers and snaps on the floor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
在伽马舱附近一条闲置的走廊里，达里乌斯给你看墙上用粉笔画的一张古怪图表。每一行列着一个机师代号，旁边各栏里分别是：一个百分比和一个C币金额。

当你对照那些C币数值和榜上机师的相对经验时，你意识到这是一份变态的赌盘。那些百分比一定代表每位机师的存活几率。

就在这时，[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]转过拐角，猛地停住。一截粉笔从{TGT_MW.DET}指间滑落，在地板上摔断。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
When a crowd of Mechwarriors return from shore leave, [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] trots over to you and Darius, frowning.

\"Commander, I was out drinking when a stranger offered to buy the next round. He started asking about our company, but I could tell that he already knew about us. About you.\" {TGT_MW.SUBJ_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:pause|Default:pauses}, uncertain.

Darius prods {TGT_MW.Obj}. \"Go on, you're not in trouble. Yet. Cut to the end.\"

{TGT_MW.Callsign} clears {TGT_MW.Det} throat. \"He provided a method for secure communication and offered to pay for information about any more contracts we take in the system.\"

{TGT_MW.Callsign}清了清{TGT_MW.Det}嗓子。"他提供了一个安全通讯的方式，并提出为我们在这个星系接下来承接的任何合约情报付钱。"

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Dr. Murad gestures grandly at a bright yellow growth on the corridor wall in front of you. \"Meet the Argo's very own mold problem. It started in the unfinished Gamma Pod, and despite my best efforts, it's spreading unchecked.\" She pokes at it with a screwdriver, frowning. \"I've seen this before, Boss.\" Yang takes the screwdriver out of Dr. Murad's hand and wipes it off. \"I know how to kill it, but whoever you pick for the job needs to be in a HazMat suit. And considering how widespread this infestation is, they're gonna be stewing in that suit for a long time.\" Dr. Murad nods grimly. \"I was afraid of that. Any thoughts on who we should saddle with such an unpleasant task? I suppose we could ask for volunteers…\" \"No one's gonna volunteer for HazMat duty,\" Yang chuckles. \"We may as well draw straws.\"

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
Strolling down the hall, you collide with [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], who seems to be in a hurry. \"Oh, Commander! I was looking for Darius but you'll do… [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] is on the verge of a brawl with [[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]]. We need someone in authority to break this up.\"

You raise your eyebrows. \"You have command experience, don't you, {TGT_MW.Callsign}?\"

{TGT_MW.Callsign} blinks. \"Well, yeah. But on board your ship, I'm just a pilot. I don't want to overstep my rank.\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
你沿走廊漫步，撞上似乎正赶路的[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]。"哦，指挥官！我在找达里乌斯，不过你也行……[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]和[[TRT_MW,{TRT_MW.Callsign}]]快要打起来了。我们需要有权威的人去制止。"

你挑起眉毛。"你不是有指挥经验吗，{TGT_MW.Callsign}？"

{TGT_MW.Callsign}眨了眨眼。"呃，是有。但在你的船上，我只是个飞行员。我不想越级。"

What do you say, Commander?\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在每日简报中，穆拉德博士举起手。“[[TGT_SYSTEM,{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}]]上将会有一场罕见的流星雨。我想，如果我们在观测甲板上近距离观看这一现象，能提振大家的士气。” “听着挺冒险。”达里乌斯摇头。“阿尔戈可没有刹车。” “那我们就在外壳上装一台望远摄像机怎么样？”穆拉德博士坚持道。“[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]自愿去安装。” “也许把豹式降到{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}地表、从安全距离看那些漂亮光点更安全？”杨眉开眼笑。“见鬼，我还可以下厨。你说呢，指挥官？”

Darius meets you in the galley bearing some unfamiliar fruits and a number of spice packets. \"[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] returned from shore leave with gifts: a big bag of this produce, some spices, and a bunch of meat from a hunting trip. I've got no idea what the animal is called, but the haunches are bigger than I am.\" 

He turns one of the strange fruits in the light and its color shifts from green to iridescent purple. \"How do you feel about adding this to our stocks? Could make for a nice change of pace.\"

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
As shore leave ends, your MechWarriors and ship's crew arrive at the spaceport, sharing stories of their adventures and entertainments. Then Darius arrives, his brow furrowed in concern. He pulls you aside and puts his communicator on speaker, so both of you can hear [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]].

\"Commander, I'm in a bit of a situation. I went on an expedition to some nearby ruins, and I, uh, I think I'm being hunted by some of the native wildlife. \"It's not like I'm the only noble-born person on the ship,\" says [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]], slumping low in your guest chair. \"I mean, there's you. Why can't [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] harass you about their stupid idea?\" Apparently when {TGT_MW.Callsign} asked to speak to you privately about something 'Darius wouldn't understand', it was about the trials and tribulations of being nobility.

\"Well, what is {SCN_MW.Callsign}'s idea?\" you ask.

\"I don't know. Something about cooling systems. {SCN_MW.Subj_C} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:want|Default:wants} me to use my 'connections' to get the idea to people who can implement it. And {SCN_MW.Subj} {TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:don't|Default:doesn't} believe me when I say that my birth doesn't automatically open doors like that. And even if it did, I can't waste it on bullshit.\" {TGT_MW.Callsign} gives you a plaintive look, clearly hoping for advice, or at least sympathy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
“船上又不是只有我一个贵族出身，”[[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]说，在你客座椅子里萎靡地瘫着。“我是说，还有你呢。为什么[[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]]不去拿他们那蠢主意烦你？”看来{TGT_MW.Callsign}所谓想私下谈“达里乌斯不会理解”的事，指的就是当贵族有多么苦多么难。

“那么，{SCN_MW.Callsign}的主意是什么？”你问。

“我不知道。好像是散热系统之类的。{SCN_MW.Subj_C}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:想|Default:想}让我用我的‘人脉’把主意传给能实现它的人。而{SCN_MW.Subj}{TGT_MW.Gender?NonBinary:不|Default:不}信我说的：我的出身并不会自动打开那种门。就算会，我也不能把它浪费在胡扯上。”{TGT_MW.Callsign}可怜巴巴地看着你，显然在期待建议，或者至少是同情。

Raised voices echo down the mess deck hallway and you arrive to find [[SCN_MW,{SCN_MW.Callsign}]] nose-to-nose with [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]].

\"I don't care about your noble family! You. Don't. Give. Me. Orders!\" {SCN_MW.Callsign} snarls, poking the other MechWarrior in the chest with each word.

{TGT_MW.Callsign} lifts {TGT_MW.DET} chin. \"Even out here in the Periphery, you should know enough to listen to your betters.\"

{SCN_MW.Callsign}'s fist flashes out before anyone can intervene, sending {TGT_MW.Callsign} staggering, blood erupting from a broken nose.

In the dangerous silence that follows, the room finally notices that you've arrived. A single fork clatters to the floor.

Sumire adds, \"I spoke to a friend at a pharmaceutical research lab, but this bug is beyond the scope of any of his experimental antivirals.\"

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
While inspecting the goods in a crowded marketplace, escorted by [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]] and several other MechWarriors, a berserker roar erupts behind you. You wheel around to see a huge, hairy, leather-clad man bellowing in apparent fury at your group. 

As you prepare for a brawl, Behemoth says, \"Hey, Commander, let me handle this.\" She's grinning. \"You can keep shopping if you want.\"

You step out of her way, but linger a moment.

Behemoth takes a wide stance, raises her fists in the air, and roars back at the berserker down the street. His eyes bulge out and he changes position, leaning forward like he's about to charge, and roars again. In response, Behemoth drops low and roars at the heavens.

Whatever is going on, she seems to have it well in hand.

你正准备开打，巨兽说：“嘿，指挥官，这个交给我。”她在笑。“你想继续逛街也行。”

你让开一步，但停留了片刻。

巨兽岔开腿、双拳举向空中，朝街那头的狂战士吼了回去。那人眼睛鼓起，改变姿势前倾，仿佛要冲锋，又吼了一声。作为回应，巨兽压低身形，朝天空咆哮。

A quick call to the engineer confirms Glitch's report. \"It's very vexing, Commander,\" says Dr. Murad. \"I've recalibrated it for her three times but it never really takes. Something about her biochemistry, maybe.\"

Sumire interrupts your morning rituals with an unusual communication from planetside. \"Commander, you'll want to see this message.\"

As the video playback comes through, you see an older man, grizzled and hard-worn, with an equally-tired looking woman beside him.

\"Uh, hello? This is a message for Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}. We wanted to thank-you for what you've done here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}.\"

He pauses and with encouragement from his wife continues. \"And ah... we've heard that our boy is working for you. He goes by [[TGT_MW,{TGT_MW.Callsign}]]? We were hoping you could contact us and tell us how he's doing. When he left us, we didn't really part on the best of terms. He hasn't talked to us for a long time. But recent events... well, you know. We miss him and we'd really appreciate it if you could give us a little bit of news.\"

苏米蕾在你晨间例程时打断了你，带来一条来自地表的异常通讯。"指挥官，你会想看看这条消息。"

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Alyina Mercantile League is an independent state formed in the wake of Clan Jade Falcon's collapse during the mid-32nd century. Centered on the planet Alyina, the League emerged as a coalition of mercantile interests and planetary governments seeking to establish stability and economic independence in a region long ravaged by Clan conflict. Blending pragmatic governance with a strong focus on commerce, the League fosters cooperation among its member worlds while actively defending its sovereignty through a combination of mercenaries and local forces. Positioned at a crossroads of trade and strategy, the Alyina Mercantile League has become a beacon of order and prosperity in a fractious era.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿莉娜商业联盟是翡翠猎鹰氏族在三十二世纪中叶崩溃之后形成的一个独立国家。联盟以阿莉娜行星为中心，由商业利益方与行星政府结成的同盟组成，力求在一个长期被氏族冲突揉躏的地区建立稳定与经济独立。联盟把务实治理与对商业的强烈关注相结合，在成员世界之间促进合作，同时通过雇佣兵与本地部队的组合积极捍卫自身主权。地处贸易与战略的十字路口，阿莉娜商业联盟已成为这个纷乱时代里秩序与繁荣的灯塔。
阿利纳商业联盟
阿利纳商业联盟

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Amaris Empire was the realization of Stefan's great ambitions. Viewing all the Inner Sphere, and specifically the Star League, as oppressor states who were crushing the Periphery states, Stefan planned a military coup to overthrow the League leadership and take the power. The death of First Lord Simon Cameron in 2751 was his opportunity. The First Lord's death, apparently an accident, later was discovered to be a murder, but it remains unknown if it was the work of Stefan or not. In any case, Stefan approached Richard Cameron, the young successor of Simon, winning his trust, murdering him, all his family and anyone loyal to the Camerons. The Amaris Coup was a great initial success, conquering all worlds of the Terran Hegemony.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿马里斯帝国是斯特凡宏大野心的实现。斯特凡把所有内层星域势力、尤其是星际联盟视为压迫外围国家的压迫者，因而策划了一场军事政变以推翻联盟领导层并夺取权力。2751年第一领主西蒙·卡梅隆之死成了他的机会。这位第一领主的死表面上是意外，后来被发现是谋杀，但是否出自斯特凡之手仍不清楚。无论如何，斯特凡接近了西蒙的年轻继承人理查德·卡梅隆，赢得他的信任，随后谋杀了他、他全家以及一切忠于卡梅隆的人。阿马里斯政变初期大获成功，征服了地球霸权的所有世界。
阿马里斯帝国
阿马里斯帝国

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Arc-Royal Liberty Coalition (ARLC) is a breakaway state formed in the mid-32nd century after the collapse of the Wolf Empire and Clan Wolf's occupation of the Lyran Commonwealth's Arc-Royal region. Centered on the planet Arc-Royal, the ARLC was established under the leadership of Clan Wolf-in-Exile. It represents an alliance of local systems seeking autonomy, rejecting external domination while embracing both the Clan and Inner Sphere traditions. Known for its strong military capability, the Coalition is characterized by its hybrid culture and pragmatic governance, embodying a unique blend of freedom and security within a turbulent Inner Sphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 弧王自由联盟（ARLC）是一个分离国家，于三十二世纪中叶在狼帝国崩溃、狼族占领莱兰联邦弧王地区之后成立。它以弧王行星为中心，在流亡狼族氏族的领导下建立。它代表着寻求自治的地方星系联盟，拒绝外部支配，同时拥抱氏族与内天体两种传统。联盟以强大的军事能力著称，其特征是混合文化与务实治理，在动荡的内天体中体现了自由与安全的独特融合。
阿克罗亚尔自由联盟

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm sorry to learn your mission was a failure, Commander. I hope that occurrences like this will be rare. If they're not, you'll probably be out of 'Mechs before too long.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 得知你的任务失败，我很难过，指挥官。我希望这类事情会很少发生。如果不幸不是，你恐怕很快就会没有机甲可用了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Arano Restoration is the remnant of the former Aurigan Coalition, driven from power by the treachery of Santiago Espinosa. Those still loyal to the Arano family fled into the Rimward Frontier, the expanse of unsettled systems adjoining the Magistracy of Canopus. Many noble houses of the Aurigan Directorate harbor sympathies for the Restoration and its cause: returning the Arano monarchy to power.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿拉诺光复会是前御夫座联盟的残余势力，因圣地亚哥·埃斯皮诺萨的背叛而被驱逐. 那些仍效忠于阿拉诺家族的人逃到了缘向边地，一处紧贴着船底自治区，广袤而动荡的星系. 御夫座理事会的许多贵族家族对光复会及其事业——恢复阿拉诺王室的统治——心怀同情.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It wasn't a total wash, but it sure wasn't a roaring success, either. I understand that not every mission is going to be a gold-star victory, but I hope this isn't an indication of future performance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这次任务算不上彻底失败，但也绝对不是大获成功。我明白不是每次任务都能拿满星凯旋，但我希望这并不预示着今后的表现。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Excellent work, Commander. I was right to put my faith in you. You're a critical part of the Restoration effort.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得漂亮，指挥官。我把信任托付给你是对的。你是复国事业的关键一环。
阿拉诺叛徒
叛徒

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You disappoint me, commander. For the sake of your company, I would hope that this does not become a habit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你让我失望了，指挥官。为了你的公司着想，我希望这不会成为习惯。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Aurigan Directorate replaced the Aurigan Coalition when Santiago Espinosa, adviser to the High Lady Kamea Arano, betrayed her and led a coup against her government. In the years since that coup, Director Espinosa has solidified his hold on the systems of the Directorate, binding the Founding Families to his cause with a mixture of promises and threats. His rule is oppressive and militaristic, with individual liberties sacrificed to the cause of security and stability.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 圣地亚哥·埃斯皮诺萨，至高领主卡梅娅·阿拉诺的顾问，背叛了她，发动政变推翻了她的政府. 于是，御夫座理事会取代了御夫座联盟. 政变后的这些年里，督政官埃斯皮诺萨巩固了他在理事会星系的权力，恩威并施地将创始家族绑上了自己的战车. 他的统治是高压的军国主义统治，个人自由为安全与稳定而牺牲.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Not all battles are so easy to win. Fear not, commander, this is but one minor setback that can be corrected.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 并非所有战斗都那么容易取胜。别担心，指挥官，这只是一次小小的挫折，可以纠正。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good work, my friend. You continue to impress me. House Espinosa - no, all the Aurigan people - are in your debt.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得好，我的朋友。你继续让我印象深刻。埃斯皮诺萨家族——不，所有奥里根人民——都欠你的。
御夫座理事会
理事会

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mercenaries and Soldiers of Fortune are the Inner Sphere main stay of Military Assets. Hired Muscle, expendable and cheap.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雇佣兵与冒险士兵是内天体军事资产的中坚。被雇的打手，可消耗且廉价。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: For someone with your hardware, I expected better things. You let us down, Commander—and I'm gonna be sure to tell everyone I know not to count on you in the future.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 以你手上的硬件条件，我本以为你能做得更好。你让我们失望了，指挥官——我保证会告诉我认识的每一个人，以后别再指望你。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The unsettled and abandoned systems of the Rimward Frontier are a haven for pirates—both in-system predators and renegade JumpShip captains who transport pirate DropShips from one system to another, taking a cut of any illicit profits.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 外围边垂那些无人定居、被遗弃的星系是海盗的天堂——既有星系内的掠夺者，也有叛逃的跳跃船船长，他们把海盗空投艇从一个星系运到另一个星系，从中抽取非法利润的分成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You didn't get the job done like we wanted, but you tried. And I like that kind of guts, even if I'm not entirely happy with the result.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你没能按我们希望的那样完成，但你尽力了。我欣赏这种胆气，即使我对结果并不完全满意。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That went well. Real well. Seems like we did the right thing in calling you in, mercenary. Glad to see we both came out ahead today.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 进展顺利. 非常顺利. 看来请你出手是正确的决定，雇佣兵. 很高兴看到我们今天都获益匪浅.
当地海盗组织
海盗

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm sorry to learn your mission was a failure, Commander. I hope that occurrences like this will be rare. If they're not, you'll probably be out of 'Mechs before too long.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 得知你的任务失败，我很难过，指挥官。我希望这类事情会很少发生。如果不幸不是，你恐怕很快就会没有机甲可用了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Arano Restoration is the remnant of the former Aurigan Coalition, driven from power by the treachery of Santiago Espinosa. Those still loyal to the Arano family fled into the Rimward Frontier, the expanse of unsettled systems adjoining the Magistracy of Canopus. Many noble houses of the Aurigan Directorate harbor sympathies for the Restoration and its cause: returning the Arano monarchy to power.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿拉诺光复会是前御夫座联盟的残余势力，因圣地亚哥·埃斯皮诺萨的背叛而被驱逐. 那些仍效忠于阿拉诺家族的人逃到了缘向边地，一处紧贴着船底自治区，广袤而动荡的星系. 御夫座理事会的许多贵族家族对光复会及其事业——恢复阿拉诺王室的统治——心怀同情.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It wasn't a total wash, but it sure wasn't a roaring success, either. I understand that not every mission is going to be a gold-star victory, but I hope this isn't an indication of future performance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这次任务算不上彻底失败，但也绝对不是大获成功。我明白不是每次任务都能拿满星凯旋，但我希望这并不预示着今后的表现。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Excellent work, Commander. I was right to put my faith in you. You're a critical part of the Restoration effort.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得漂亮，指挥官。我把信任托付给你是对的。你是复国事业的关键一环。
御夫座联盟

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Axumite Providence is a primitive Islamic state in the Deep Periphery. The nearest system is located 1,000 light years anti-spinward of Terra, located at the trailing edge of Orion's Bow.  The Axumites have limited 20th century technology, and little else.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿克苏姆教省是深远外缘的一个原始伊斯兰国家。最近的星系位于地球反旋臂方向1,000光年处，在猎户弓的尾端。阿克苏姆人的技术局限于20世纪水平，此外几乎一无所有。
阿克苏姆天命国

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I've hired raw cadets that have performed better than your company, Commander. In the future, you'd best operate at a higher level, or we might not be willing to offer you contracts aside from garrison duty.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我雇来的生瓜蛋子新兵表现都比你的队伍强。以后你最好拿出更高的水准，否则除了驻防任务，我们可能就不愿再给你合同了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Calderon Protectorate is a small Periphery state located spinward of the Taurian Concordat. The Protectorate began as a collection of small settlements newly-colonized by the Taurian Concordat, an effort which started with the Far Lookers movement and was backed by Concordat financial interests
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 卡尔德隆保护国是位于陶里安协约国旋臂方向的一个小型外缘国家。保护国最初是一批由陶里安协约国新殖民的小型定居点，这项努力始于"远望者"运动，并得到协约国金融利益方的支持

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Out here in the Periphery, it's always a life-or-death struggle for mercenaries. That's why I appreciate your efforts to complete the mission, even if you couldn't manage it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在外围地区，对雇佣兵来说永远是生死攸关的搏杀。所以即便你没能完成任务，我依然感谢你为此付出的努力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good job, Commander. The Calderon Protectorate thanks you for your service. It's always refreshing to deal with a true professional when one hires mercenaries.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得好，指挥官。卡尔德隆保护国感谢你的效力。雇雇佣兵时能碰上一个真正的专业人士，总是令人神清气爽。
卡尔德隆保护国
卡尔德隆保护国

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Untouched by attacks from the Word of Blake, the Protectorate actively worked to improve the fledgling nation's industrial base and used the developing manufacturing resources to help boost the economy through exports. The improved manufacturing base also gave the CPM local sources of supply, and military recruitment picked up both as a result of the more enthusiastic amongst the energized citizens of the protectorate and the swarms of immigrants from the Concordat who fled to the Protectorate to escape the ruling military junta.  The Protectorate further improved its economic base by establishing trade ties with the nearby Filtvelt Coalition and Fronc Reaches, as well as the more distant Raven Alliance - and these ties also helped to secure the Protectorate's borders.  Eighty-one years after the Calderon Protectorate was formed, on 29 August 3147, Protector Sam Calderon and Kaff Doru announced that Doru's twelve-year-old daughter Reva and Calderon's eight-year-old son Bryant would marry once Bryant turned eighteen. Until then, the two nations would expand their trade relations and engage in mutual defense operations, with additional safeguards to prevent events like the Bromhead Massacre of 3067.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由于未遭布雷克之言的攻击，保护国积极致力于改善这个初生国家的工业基础，并利用发展中的制造资源，通过出口提振经济。改进后的制造基础也为CPM提供了本地供应来源，军事招募也随之上扬——既有保护国公民中更热心者的踊跃，也有大批为逃避执政军政府而从协约国逃往保护国的移民。保护国还通过与附近的菲尔特地联盟和弗朗克边疆，以及更遥远的渡鸦联盟建立贸易关系，进一步夯实其经济基础——这些纽带也有助于保障保护国的边界安全。卡尔德隆保护国成立八十一年后，3147年8月29日，保护者萨姆·卡尔德隆与卡夫·多鲁宣布，多鲁十二岁的女儿雷瓦与卡尔德隆八岁的儿子布莱恩特将在布莱恩特满十八岁后成婚。在此之前，两国将扩大贸易往来并开展共同防御行动，并附加额外保障措施，以防止再出现像3067年布罗姆黑德惨案那样的事件。
卡尔德隆保护国
卡尔德隆保护国

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nueva Castile isn't actually a faction per se, but more a typical outer periphery area in flux.  It is lacking in HPG stations, and so far out of touch with the rest of the inner sphere that hardly anyone knows what's really going on there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 新卡斯蒂利亚其实不算一个严格意义上的势力，更像是外围地区一个处于变动中的典型边远区域。它缺少HPG站，与内层星域其余部分脱节得几乎没人知道那里到底在发生什么。
新卡斯蒂利亚

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Chainelane Isles is not a unified realm, but rather a collection of waring planet-states and minor principalities fighting with mostly pre-mech tech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 钱莱恩群岛并非一个统一的国度，而是由众多相互征战的星球国家和次要公国组成的集合体，其战争手段主要依靠前机甲时代的科技.
钱莱恩群岛

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Circinus Federation are effectively a highly organized pirate group that operates under the guise of being the legitimate armed forces of a democratically elected government.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 切尔西努斯联邦实质上是一个组织严密的匪盗集团，以民选政府的合法武装力量为伪装活动。
圆规座联合会

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Circinus Federation are effectively a highly organized pirate group that operates under the guise of being the legitimate armed forces of a democratically elected government.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 切尔西努斯联邦实质上是一个组织严密的匪盗集团，以民选政府的合法武装力量为伪装活动。
圆规座联合会
血灵

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Named for the esprit-de-corps that bound the original 800 Clan warriors, Clan Blood Spirit ironically became the most isolationist and bitter of the Clans. They believed that the other Clans had abandoned the way set down by Nicholas Kerensky.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 血灵氏族的名称源于团结最初800名氏族战士的团队精神。然而讽刺的是，血灵氏族最终成为了所有氏族中最孤立、最苦涩的一个。他们认为其他氏族已经背弃了尼古拉斯·克伦斯基所制定的道路。
血灵氏族
血灵

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Clan Burrock is one of the original 20 Clans founded by Nicholas Kerensky, and is regarded as one of the more enlightened of the Crusader Clans as far as their treatment of commoners and freeborn.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 岩蜍氏族是尼古拉斯·克伦斯基创立的原始20个氏族之一，在对待平民与自由出生者的方式上，被视为十字军氏族中较为开明的一支。
伯洛克氏族
云眼镜蛇

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The only Clan defined by its incorporation of organized religions, Clan Cloud Cobra's warrior-priests are organized into Cloisters and dedicated themselves to an overarching concept known as The Way.  Clan Cloud Cobra are one of the Warden Clans, who seek to preserve the inner sphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为唯一以纳入组织化宗教为特征的部族，云眼镜蛇的战士祭司按“隐修院”编制，献身于一个被称为“道”的总体理念。云眼镜蛇是守护者部族之一，致力于保存内层星域。
云蛇氏族
云眼镜蛇

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Coyote Clan was responsible for the invention of the OmniMech and is one of the strongest of the Warden Clans. The Coyotes were also known for their mystical beliefs, based on native American religious practices.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 郊狼氏族是万能机甲的发明者，也是守望者氏族中最强大的氏族之一. 郊狼氏族还以其基于美洲原住民宗教习俗的神秘信仰而闻名.
郊狼氏族
钻石鲨

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally known as Clan Sea Fox, and often referred to as the Merchant Clan, the Diamond Sharks were among the most powerful and progressive of the Warden Clans.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 钻石鲨最初被称为海狐氏族，常被称作商人氏族，是守护者氏族中最强大、最进步的一支。
氏族钻石鲨
钻石鲨
火沸沸

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Probably the most fractious of the Clans, the Fire Mandrill are as likely to fight each other as they are an enemy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可能是各部族中最易内斗的，火沸沸彼此开战的可能性不亚于与外敌开战。
氏族火沸沸
火沸沸
鬼熊

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Among the most powerful of the Clans, the Ghost Bears were defined by their conservative 'wait and see nature' and their deep familial relationship with each other.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 身为氏族中最强大的几支之一，幽灵熊的特征是其保守的"观望"天性以及彼此间深厚的家族式纽带。
鬼熊
歌利亚蝎

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Goliath Scorpion Clan was obsessed with recovering any and all lost artifacts of the fallen Star League, sending Seekers fueled by necrosa visions far and wide to recover them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蝎狮氏族痴迷于寻回覆灭星盟的一切失落造物，派出由死灵幻象驱动的探寻者远赴四方将其收回。
歌利亚蝎
地狱马

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Known for their prominent use of combat vehicles in front-line forces, the Hell's Horses lived by the motto that man came before machine and all members were valued as being part of a greater whole, including freebirths.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 以在前线部队中大量使用战斗车辆而闻名，地狱马的座右铭是人先于机器，所有成员——包括自由出生者——都被视为更大整体的一部分而受到重视。
氏族地狱马
地狱马
地狱马
氏族地狱马
地狱马
冰恶棍

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A fierce, quick-handed Clan bordering on reckless, the Ice Hellion Clan often grasped for prizes beyond their reach and could be their own worst enemy. Ice Hellion warriors prized the ability to strike first above other considerations.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 冰地狱狮是一个凶猛、出手迅速的部族，几近鲁莽，常伸手去抓超出自身能力的东西，可能是自己最大的敌人。冰地狱狮战士把先手打击的能力看得比什么都重。
冰恶棍
玉鹰

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Staunch traditionalists and aggressive fighters, the Jade Falcons were central in the creation of the Crusader philosophy. They live by the mantra 'might makes right'
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为坚定的传统主义者与好斗的战士，玉猫部族在十字军哲学的创立中处于核心地位。他们奉行“强者即正义”的信条。
玉鹰氏族
玉鹰
玉鹰

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Gutted in the fight for Terra and the proceeding ilKhan Trial, with 98% percent of their forces on Terra perishing in the struggles, Clan Jade Falcon's survivors numbered roughly 120, with many of those severely injured. Clan Jade Falcon then began serving as a bodyguard Clan vowing to protect the ilKhan and the reborn Star League under new leadership after abandoning the Mongol Doctrine and choosing a new Khan.  The most intact part of the Falcon's Touman was their Warfleet, which helped Clan Wolf units to keep watch over the other Clans invited to the IlClan's founding ceremony.  The remaining forces in the Occupation Zone were either conquered by Inner Sphere factions or splintered into newer incarnations of the Clan. One maintains the Clan Jade Falcon identity and is led by Khan Jiyi Chistu, the other, composed by the bulk of the Falcon's Merchant Caste, is the Alyina Mercantile League, led by Merchant caste Syndic Marena.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在争夺地球的战斗及随后的伊尔汗大考验中被彻底打残，驻地球部队有98%在战火中覆灭，翡翠猎鹰氏族的幸存者仅约120人，其中许多人身负重伤。此后翡翠猎鹰放弃蒙古教义、选出新可汗，转而充当护卫氏族，誓言保护伊尔汗与重生星盟的新领导层。猎鹰图曼中最完整的一部分是其战舰队，它协助狼族部队看管受邀参加伊尔汗建国典礼的其他氏族。占领区内的残余部队要么被内天体势力征服，要么分裂成该氏族的新化身。其中一支保持翡翠猎鹰氏族的身份，由可汗吉伊·奇斯图统领；另一支由猎鹰商人种姓的主体组成，即阿莉娜商业联盟，由商人种姓理事玛蕾娜领导。
玉鹰氏族
玉鹰

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Clan Mongoose was one of the original twenty Clans founded by Nicholas Kerensky, named for the creature on Shadow that preyed upon the dangerous venom worms and thus endeared itself to Shadow's colonists. While the Clan did well enough for itself during the first half of the twenty-ninth century, its heavy reliance upon politics over honorable combat alienated other Clans and eventually sealed its fate when Clan Smoke Jaguar won the right to Absorb them in 2868. After a brutal campaign the Jaguars prevailed and, save for some aerospace pilot heritages taken by Clan Cloud Cobra, Clan Mongoose's legacies ceased to exist.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 獴氏族是尼古拉斯·克伦斯基创立的原始二十个氏族之一，得名于影星上一种捕食危险毒虫的生物，因此深受影星殖民者的喜爱。虽然该氏族在二十九世纪前半段发展得相当不错，但它过度依赖政治而非荣誉战斗，使其他氏族疏远，最终在2868年烟虎氏族赢得吸收它的权利时注定了它的命运。经过一场残酷的战役，烟虎胜出，除了一些被云眼镜蛇氏族收走的航空飞行员血脉之外，獴氏族的传承不复存在。
新星猫

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Clan marked by their own unique brand of mysticism, the Nova Cats are guided by visions and portents, and even its Khans first consulted with the Oathmaster before undertaking any action which could affect the Clan.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 新星猫是一个以独特神秘主义风格著称的部族，他们受幻象与预兆指引，就连可汗在采取任何可能影响部族的行动之前，也要先咨询誓约长。
氏族新星猫
新星猫

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Clan Protectorate is a unique province within the Free Worlds League, formed under the leadership of Clan Sea Fox and inspired by the vision of Lady Julletta Marik. Recognizing the strategic and economic advantages of partnering with Clans rather than opposing them, Lady Julletta facilitated the Protectorate's creation as a semi-autonomous region blending Clan efficiency with Free Worlds League governance. The Protectorate is centered around worlds granted to Clan Sea Fox in exchange for their mercantile prowess, fostering stability and prosperity through trade and mutual cooperation. It represents an ambitious experiment in hybrid governance, uniting Clan and Inner Sphere ideals within the Marik realm.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 氏族保护国是自由世界联盟中一个独特的省，在海狐氏族领导下建立，灵感来自朱莱塔·马里克女士的构想。朱莱塔女士认识到与氏族合作、而非对抗它们的战略与经济优势，促成保护国作为一个半自治区域建立，把氏族效率与自由世界联盟的治理融为一体。保护国以那些为换取海狐氏族的商业才能而授予他们的世界为中心，通过贸易与相互合作促进稳定与繁荣。它代表着一次雄心勃勃的混合治理实验，在马里克领域内把氏族与内天体的理想结合起来。
氏族保护领
海狐

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Clan Sea Fox is the original name of Clan Diamond Shark. Clan Sea Fox and Clan Snow Raven had a falling out, and in response Clan Snow Raven created the Diamond Shark, a predator designed solely to hunt and kill the Sea Foxes who lived in Strana Mechty's oceans. After most of the Sea Foxes had been killed, Clan Sea Fox petitioned the Grand Council to change its name to Clan Diamond Shark. Several sea foxes were preserved by the Clan and placed on other worlds, where they flourished. As a result, Clan Diamond Shark changed its name back to Clan Sea Fox by 3100. The Diamond Shark/Sea Fox Clan has relied heavily on its Merchant Caste since its inception, giving them more power and freedom than most Clans. Though many believe them to be weak because of their democratic attitudes toward their lower castes, the Diamond Sharks maintained one of the largest and most elite toumans among the Clans.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 海狐氏族是钻石鲨氏族的原名。海狐氏族与雪鸦氏族发生争执，作为回应，雪鸦氏族创造了钻石鲨——一种专为猎杀斯特拉纳·麦赫蒂海洋中海狐而设计的掠食者。在大部分海狐被杀之后，海狐氏族向大议会请愿，要求改名为钻石鲨氏族。该氏族保存了几只海狐并安置到其他行星上，它们在那里繁衍兴旺。因此，钻石鲨氏族在3100年前又把名字改回了海狐氏族。钻石鲨/海狐氏族自创立起就严重依赖其商人种姓，给予他们的权力与自由远超大多数氏族。尽管许多人因其对低等种姓的民主态度而认为他们软弱，钻石鲨仍保有着氏族中规模最大、最精锐的图曼之一。
海狐氏族
海狐
海狐

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: 50 years after Clan Diamond Shark officially changes its name back to Clan Sea Fox, they proceed to buy all of the Free Worlds League's ComStar assets and absorbs all Wolf Empire's working and nonworking HPGs. They also supplied Clan Wolf for their campaign to Terra.  Clan Sea Fox, after the rise of the IlClan, began bonding mercenary contracts across Federated Suns and Draconis Combine space, quickly replacing the MRBC.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在钻石鲨部族正式改回海狐部族之名50年后，他们着手买下自由世界联盟的全部通讯之星资产，并吸收狼帝国所有可运行与不可运行的HPG。他们还为狼部族的远征地球行动提供补给。在伊尔克兰崛起之后，海狐部族开始在联邦太阳国与龙脉联合体空间内串联雇佣兵合同，迅速取代了MRBC。
海狐氏族
海狐

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Founded 2807. The Clans are descended from the self-exiled remnants of the Star League Defense Force, who left the Inner Sphere following the collapse of the Star League. Upon reaching what is now known at the Pentagon Worlds, the SLDF fell to infighting, prompting Nicholas Kerensky, son of General Aleksandr Kerensky, to embark on a second exodus deeper into coreward space. Those who left with him were eventually reformed into the Clans, a strictly militant society who would go on to reconquer the Pentagon Worlds and later stage an invasion of the Inner Sphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 成立于2807年. 氏族源自星际联盟防卫军（SLDF）中自我流放的残余部队，他们在星际联盟崩溃后离开了内天体. 抵达如今被称为五角星世界的地区后，SLDF陷入了内部纷争，促使亚历山大·克伦斯基将军之子尼古拉斯·克伦斯基开始第二次大迁徙，向更深的银河核心方向进发. 跟随他离开的人员最终被重组为氏族——一个严格的军事化社会，他们后来重新征服了五角星世界，并进一步发动了对内天体的入侵.
烟虎

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Clan Smoke Jaguar was among the most aggressive and warlike of the Clans, even at the expense of more peaceful endeavors, and were early supporters of the Crusader philosophy.  They are noted for repressing anyone but their own Warrior Caste.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 烟虎氏族是氏族中最具侵略性和最好战的成员之一，即便以牺牲更为和平的事业为代价，并且是十字军哲学的早期支持者。他们以压制除自身武士阶层以外的所有人而为人所知。
烟虎氏族
烟虎
雪鸦

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Masters of compromise and manipulation, Clan Snow Raven were opportunists of the highest order, possessing an almost un-Clanlike sense of self-preservation and a willingness to sell their services to the highest bidder.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为妥协与操纵的大师，雪鸦氏族是最高级别的机会主义者，拥有近乎不像氏族人的自保意识，以及把服务卖给出价最高者的意愿。
雪鸦氏族
雪鸦
星蝰蛇

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A conservative Clan, the Star Adders are known for their pragmatism and their strategic (rather than tactical) view towards battle, as well as treating freeborn that proved themselves as equals.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星蝰氏族是一个保守的氏族，以实用主义和注重战略（而非战术）层面的作战观念而闻名，同时也以平等对待那些证明了自己价值的自由生而著称.
星蝰氏族
星蝰蛇
钢蝰

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Steel Vipers had the toughest training regime of any Clan save the Blood Spirits, graduating fewer but more elite warriors, and were more discriminating against freebirths than other Clans.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 钢蛇氏族拥有除血灵氏族外所有氏族中最严苛的训练制度，培养出的战士数量更少但更为精锐，并且比其他氏族更歧视自由生者.
钢蛇氏族
钢蝰
石狮

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Named from the feline inhabiting the northern mountains of Tokasha, Clan Stone Lion was created from the remaining Homeworld members of Clan Hell's Horses after the Abjuration of their Inner Sphere portion in 3075
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 以栖息在托卡沙北部山脉的猫科动物命名，石狮氏族是在其内天体分支于3075年被弃绝之后，由地狱马氏族余下的本土星系成员创建的
石狮氏族
石狮

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Clan Widowmaker was one of the original twenty Clans. Their homeworld was Roche, settled in 2812. Known as an extremely aggressive Clan, they had a relatively short history before their Absorption by Clan Wolf.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 寡妇制造者氏族是原始二十个氏族之一。他们的母星是罗什，于2812年殖民。作为一个以极度好斗著称的氏族，他们在被狼族吸收之前历史相对短暂。
氏族造寡妇者

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The chosen Clan of Nicholas Kerensky, the Wolves have dominated Clan society since their inception. Less formal and more flexible than others, Clan Wolf emulated its namesake by blending caution with decisiveness.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为尼古拉斯·克伦斯基选中的部族，狼族自创立以来一直主导着部族社会。狼部族比其他部族更少形式、更为灵活，以其同名者（狼）为榜样，把谨慎与果断融为一体。
氏族狼

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Clan Wolf-in-Exile is a splinter faction of the original Clan Wolf, one of the twenty Clans created by Nicholas Kerensky. Born from the destruction of the original Clan Wolf in the Refusal War, the Wolves-in-Exile continued to uphold the Warden traditions of their forebears under the leadership of Khan Phelan Kell by siding with the Inner Sphere
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狼族流亡者是原狼部族的分裂派系，而狼部族是尼古拉斯·克伦斯基所创二十个部族之一。流亡之狼诞生于原狼部族在拒绝战争中的覆灭，他们在可汗费伦·凯尔的领导下站在内层星域一边，继续坚守先辈的守护者传统。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
One of the original twenty Clans, Clan Wolverine was Annihilated in the years after Operation KLONDIKE, officially for having detonated nuclear devices to destroy a genetic repository of Clan Snow Raven and for opposing Nicholas Kerensky and the Clans as a whole. 

The Clans subsequently went to great lengths to purge Clan Wolverine from their history. They refer to the former Clan Wolverine only as the \"Not-Named Clan\". Instead of properly referring the \"IIC\"-style evolution of the Wolverine BattleMech as the Wolverine IIC, it was renamed the Conjurer (Hellhound). More than two hundred years after Clan Wolverine's annihilation, the mere comparison of a Clan warrior to an animal identified as wolverine, in a completely unrelated situation and by a person not accustomed to Clan society, was still considered a shocking insult that might elicit a violent response.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
作为原始二十个氏族之一，狼獾氏族在克朗代克行动之后的岁月里被灭绝，官方理由是它引爆核装置摧毁了雪鸦氏族的一处基因库，并反对尼古拉斯·克伦斯基与整个氏族体制。

此后氏族们不遗余力地把狼獾氏族从历史中抹除。他们只把前狼獾氏族称作"无名氏族"。狼獾战斗机甲那种"IIC"式演化本应称为狼獾IIC，却被改名为咒术师（地狱犬）。在狼獾氏族被灭绝两百多年后，仅仅把一名氏族战士比作一种被认作狼獾的动物——在完全无关的场合，由不熟悉氏族社会的人做出——仍被视为可能招致暴力回应的惊人侮辱。
狼獾氏族

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Far be it from a simple organization like ComStar to reprimand you in matters of warfare, Commander, butâ€¦ your performance on that operation was positively abysmal. We roundly condemn your inadequacies.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 像通讯之星这样简单的组织本不该在作战事务上斥责你，指挥官，但……你在那次行动中的表现实在糟糕透顶。我们对你的无能予以严正谴责。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: ComStar, the institution and religion, grew out of the Star League Department of Communications, as reenvisioned by Jerome Blake, Minister of Communications. ComStar is transnational, beholden to none of the Successor States, and its priesthood exclusively controls access to the only means of faster-than-light communications, the HyperPulse Generators. ComStar facilities and personnel are sacrosanct, a status enforced aggressively by the institution; offending statesâ€”even entire Successor Statesâ€”can find themselves cut off from the rest of the Inner Sphere, unable to communicate or trade. The current head of ComStar is Primus Julian Tiepolo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 通讯之星(ComStar)，作为一个机构与宗教，脱胎于星际联盟通讯部，由时任通讯部长杰罗姆·布雷克重新构想而创立. 通讯之星是跨国组织，不对任何继承国效忠，其教士阶层独掌着唯一超光速通讯手段——超脉冲发生器的使用权. 通讯之星的设施与人员神圣不可侵犯，这一地位由该机构极力维护; 冒犯它的国家——甚至是整个继承国——都可能发现自己被内天体其余部分隔绝，无法通讯与贸易. 通讯之星目前的领袖是首席主教朱利安·蒂耶波洛.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It seems apparent that while you failed to achieve our goals, you engaged the enemy for as long as you were able. Better luck next time, Commander. May the Spirit of Blake be with you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这看起来似乎很显然，虽然你没有达成我们的目标，但已经尽你所能来和敌人交战了. 希望你下次能走运一些，指挥官. 希望布雷克的精神与你同在.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: ComStar congratulates you on your successful mission, mercenary. We are pleased you've been able to assist us so thoroughly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 康星祝贺你任务成功，佣兵。我们很高兴你能如此彻底地协助我们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Far be it from a simple organization like ComStar to reprimand you in matters of warfare, Commander, butâ€¦ your performance on that operation was positively abysmal. We roundly condemn your inadequacies.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 像通讯之星这样简单的组织本不该在作战事务上斥责你，指挥官，但……你在那次行动中的表现实在糟糕透顶。我们对你的无能予以严正谴责。

ComStar is transnational, beholden to none of the Successor States, and its priesthood exclusively controls access to the only means of faster-than-light communications, the HyperPulse Generators. ComStar facilities and personnel are sacrosanct, a status enforced aggressively by the institution; offending statesâ€”even entire Successor Statesâ€”can find themselves cut off from the rest of the Inner Sphere, unable to communicate or trade. The current head of ComStar is Primus Julian Tiepolo.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: ComStar congratulates you on your successful mission, mercenary. We are pleased you've been able to assist us so thoroughly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 康星祝贺你任务成功，佣兵。我们很高兴你能如此彻底地协助我们。
黑暗种姓

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dark Caste is largely a mystery. Equipped with ancient Clan mechs from their Golden Century as well as old mothballed SLDF mechs, the Dark Caste appear to be little more than Clan renegades and bandits, raiding Deep Periphery states with impunity and marauding at will. They have no leadership or goals, they exist only to survive at any cost.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑暗种姓大体是个谜。他们装备着来自黄金世纪的古老氏族机甲以及旧封存的SLDF机甲，看起来不过是氏族的叛徒与匪徒，肆无忌惮地劫掠深远外缘国家，任意横行。他们没有领袖或目标，只为了不惜一切代价生存。
黑暗种姓

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Come now, mercenary—did you even try to complete the contract, or did you believe we'd pay you for your own inadequacies? Such a dismal performance cannot be rewarded, only reprimanded.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 得了吧，雇佣兵——你到底有没有尽力去履行合同，还是以为我们会为你自己的无能付钱？如此糟糕的表现得不到奖赏，只能受到训斥。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Federated Suns is one of the five Successor States of the Star League, located rimward and spinward of Terra. Ruled by House Davion, the Federation is the most powerful of the five, and the people of the Federation pride themselves on their self-proclaimed role as defenders of justice and liberty. The Federation is quite capable of ruthless, decisive action, though, and its idealism readily gives way to pragmatism when called for. The current ruler of the Federation, Prince Hanse Davion, is an experienced and unconventional military commander. The Federation's alliance with the Lyran Commonwealth effectively ended the Third Succession War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 联邦太阳国是星际联盟的五个继承国之一，位于地球的外缘方向与顺旋方向。它由达维昂家族统治，是五国中最强大的一个，其人民也以自封的正义与自由捍卫者自居而自豪。不过，这个联邦同样能采取无情而果断的行动，必要时其理想主义也会让位于务实。联邦现任统治者汉斯·达维昂亲王是一位经验丰富、不循常规的军事指挥官。联邦与莱兰联邦的结盟实质上终结了第三次继承战争。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Well, let it never be said House Davion does not believe in charity. Obviously, your skills could not be equivalent to our own regular armies—so we do not blame you for your inability to complete the contract.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 嗯，可别让人说戴维恩家族不信慈善。显然，你的本领无法与我们正规军相提并论——所以我们不怪你没能完成合同。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Excellent performance, Commander. The Federated Suns are pleased with what you have accomplished and the skill you've evidenced. Expect our payment in full!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 表现出色，指挥官。联邦太阳国对您的成就与展现出的技艺十分满意。报酬将足额奉上！
恒星联邦

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Come now, mercenary—did you even try to complete the contract, or did you believe we'd pay you for your own inadequacies? Such a dismal performance cannot be rewarded, only reprimanded.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 得了吧，雇佣兵——你到底有没有尽力去履行合同，还是以为我们会为你自己的无能付钱？如此糟糕的表现得不到奖赏，只能受到训斥。
