Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, our employer reports that their operative is still alive, so if we rescue them, we get a bonus.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们的雇主报告说他们的特工还活着，所以如果我们救出他们，就会获得额外奖励.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: How do they know? We just got here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们怎么知道的? 我们才刚来这儿.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: No rescue, and no key. That poor person died for nothing.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The heartbeat monitor is transmitting from this location; if you decide to rescue the operative, move into the area and pick them up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 心跳监视器是从这个地方发送出来的; 如果你决定营救特工，就进入这一地区接上他们.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The key is safe. Well done, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 密钥安全了. 做得不错，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We never even found out their name. Sometimes I hate this business.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们甚至都不知道他们的名字. 有时我讨厌干这行.

未使用的击杀目标（供自动完成）

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} scientist is a top weapons researcher, and extremely valuable to any faction that employs her.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这名{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}科学家是顶级武器研发人员，对任何雇佣她的派系来说都是极有价值的.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we perform a substantial amount of scientific research here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have been sabotaging our research stations, stretching our defenses thin. We've just learned that their ultimate target is a key scientist in our weapons development program. They've launched an assault that we believe is intended to capture her. We need you to reach the facility where she's stationed and extract her to safety.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}这里进行着大量科学研究。{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队一直在破坏我们的研究站，把我们的防御摊得太薄。我们刚得知他们的最终目标是我们武器研发项目中的一位关键科学家。他们已发动一次袭击，我们相信其意图是俘获她。我们需要你抵达她驻守的设施，把她安全撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I can only imagine what Yang is going to say to the idea of infecting one of our 'Mechs with hostile code.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我只能想象杨听到要给我们的机甲染上敌方代码会说什么。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've discovered a facility where {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} researchers have developed a new computer virus that targets the control mechanisms of our 'Mechs. We can't build an effective defense against this virus without a sample of its code to work with. We need you to get one of your 'Mechs within range of the research facility and download the virus into its systems. Then extract the infected carrier 'Mech so we can analyze the virus.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们发现了{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}研究人员的一处设施，他们研发出一种新型计算机病毒，专门攻击我们机甲的控制机制。没有病毒代码样本，我们无法建立有效防御。我们需要你让你的一台机甲进到该研究设施范围内，把病毒下载进它的系统。然后撤出被感染的载体机甲，好让我们分析这病毒。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protect the infected unit until you reach the extraction LZ, where Sumire will pick you up. Good luck, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在你抵达苏米尔接应你的撤离用着陆区之前，保护好被感染的单位. 祝你好运，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's it, mech recovering our Secondary Target is scraped. S&R will look for what's left. That objective is failed. Focus on the Primary.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 完了，回收我们次要目标的那台机甲报废了。搜救队会去找剩下能用的东西。那个目标失败了。专注主要目标。
早告诉过你了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You want to do what with my 'Mechs?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你想对我的机甲做什么？
公司机密

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Locate the scientist. She'll need to ride along in one of the mechs, so keep that mech safe until extraction.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 找到那位科学家。她需要搭乘其中一台机甲，所以要保证那台机甲安全直到撤离。
未使用的击杀目标（供自动完成）

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I think I've lost track of how many layers of betrayal this represents. Is this a quadruple-cross? This must be some scientist.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我已经数不清这是第几层背叛了。这是四重反水？这位科学家可真不简单。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A scientist for a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} conglomerate has turned industrial spy for a rival corporation from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}. She was privy to numerous industrial secrets that we would prefer not to fall into our competitor's hands. The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} leadership has offered to sell her back, but we intend to use the false hope of negotiations to buy you time to extract the scientist through more proactive means.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}一家企业集团的科学家已投身为来自 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} 的竞争对手公司充当工业间谍。她掌握着大量工业机密，我们绝不希望这些机密落入竞争对手手中。{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 高层提出把她卖还给我们，但我们打算利用谈判的虚假希望来为你争取时间，以更主动的方式把这位科学家营救出来。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The enemy has to be expecting an attempt to break their siege, so there will be significant resistance.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of our VIPs is in a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} facility on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. We need to get her offworld, but the building is surrounded by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces. You will sweep aside the opposition, recover our VIP, and transport her to a designated landing zone for extraction. Be prepared for opposition - the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units surrounding the embassy won't let you extract our personnel without a fight. Payment will be issued when you deliver our VIP alive and in one piece.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的一位贵宾在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的一处{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}设施里。我们需要把她送出行星，但那栋建筑被{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队包围。你要清扫对手，接回我们的贵宾，并把她送到指定着陆区撤离。为遭遇抵抗做好准备——包围使馆的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队不会让你安然带走我们的人员。当贵宾活着、完好地送到时，报酬即行支付。

That DropShip was carrying a valuable piece of technology as cargo, and while we are willing to write off the ship itself, we very much need to recover the cargo. Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的一艘空投艇在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}星系发生了技术故障. 最后的通讯显示它已进行了硬着陆. 那艘空投艇搭载了一件极其珍贵的技术设备，虽然我们可以放弃空投艇本身，但我们非常需要将货物找回. 卫星图像显示，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的部队已经回收了这批货物，并将其存放在附近的一个设施中. 我们需要你突袭那座设施，把东西找回来.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}在这儿真的一筹莫展了. 这种客户正合我胃口.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The scion of a {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} mercantile concern has been missing for months. We suspect a kidnapping by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}, but there's been no ransom demand. A local group of sympathizers on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} recently picked up a garbled message from the scion indicating that she's being held in a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility there. Our intel failed to trace her to {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, so any loyal mechs are several jumps away. We need your help to extract her.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一位{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}商界要人的继承人已失踪数月。我们怀疑是{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}绑架，但一直没有收到赎金要求。{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上一群当地同情者最近收到这位继承人发来的一条含混不清的消息，表明她被关押在那里的某处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}设施中。我们的情报未能追踪她到{TGT_SYSTEM.name}，所以任何忠诚的机甲都在好几个跳跃之外。我们需要你帮忙把她救出来。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: [通用语音] 次要资产正在受损，指挥官！
祝你好运，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Excellent work, commander. The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} VIP is on her way home.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得漂亮，指挥官. {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的VIP在回家的路上了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: First step. Find our target in the location of the last known signal...
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 首先. 在最后一次侦测到目标信号的地点寻找...

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a straightforward retrieval. Locate the VIP and get to the Evac Zone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一个简单明了的回收任务. 找到VIP然后前往撤离区域.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Locate the painter. He'll need to ride along in one of the mechs, then keep that mech safe until extraction.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 找出那位画家。他需要搭乘其中一台机甲随行，然后在撤离前保护好那台机甲。
未使用的击杀目标（供自动完成）

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, I don't pretend to understand what's so offensive about this painting, but they take that sort of thing seriously out here. As for retrieving the painting, apparently it's worth even more after all this controversy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我不假装明白这幅画有什么冒犯之处，但这里的人对这类事很认真。至于取回那幅画，显然经过这一番争议之后它更值钱了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} philanthropist is a patron of the arts here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. A favored painter has been accused of heresy by the system's religious police. These zealots are propped up by foreign {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} agents. He'll be extradited to face trial and likely execution in {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} territory. We can't allow that to happen, but we don't want to incur reprisal from the religious leaders. That's where you come in. Locate the painter, rescue him and, at the personal request of the patron, recover the painting that started this whole mess.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一位{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}慈善家是{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}这里的艺术赞助人。他赏识的一位画家被该星系的宗教警察指控为异端。这些狂热分子由外国{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}特工扶持。他会被引渡受审，很可能在{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}领地被处决。我们不能让这种事发生，但又不想招致宗教领袖的报复。这就需要你了。找到那位画家，把他救出来，并且应赞助人本人的请求，找回引发这一连串麻烦的那幅画。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If this is the next season of Rough Riders, we need to not let Yang know. He'll trade our whole payment for early access.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果这是《粗野骑手》的下一季，我们可千万别让杨知道。他会把我们整笔报酬都换去买提前观看权。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have an opportunity to get our hands on the next season of a popular holovid series before it's sent out for general distribution. Fans will pay through the nose to get a copy even a few weeks early. All you have to do is go to the secure {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility where the data is being stored, and our agent will transmit the data directly to your 'Mech. Oh, if you have a chance, pick the agent up, too? He's holed up in a secondary facility.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们有机会赶在一部热门全息剧集公开发行之前拿到下一季。粉丝们愿意花大价钱买哪怕是早几周拿到的拷贝。你要做的只是前往存放数据的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}安全设施，我们的特工会把数据直接传送到你的机甲上。哦，如果有机会，把那名特工也接出来？他藏在次级设施里。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It must take some serious chutzpah to insist on a clause like that in your contract. I'm impressed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敢在合约里坚持这样的条款，得有多大的胆子。我印象深刻。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have an ongoing relationship with a well-known mercenary, and one of the elements of that relationship that they insisted on was an insurance policy: if they're captured, we're obligated to mount a rescue attempt. They've been captured by {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces, and that's triggered the rescue clause. They managed to escape on their own but have no way off the planet, and are surrounded by hostiles. We need you to reach the facility where they're hiding and pick them up.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们与一位知名雇佣兵保持着长期合作关系，而他们坚持的一项合作条件是一份保险条款：一旦他们被俘，我们有义务发起救援行动。他们已被{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队俘获，这触发了救援条款。他们设法自行逃脱了，但没有离开这颗行星的途径，而且四周都是敌人。我们需要你抵达他们藏身的设施并把它们接走。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, if this is the real thing, it's going to be defended like you can't even imagine. This one will be tough.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，如果这是真货，它的防守会超乎你的想象。这一场会很难。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} defector has given us an extremely interesting and time-sensitive piece of information, and we need a fast response. Before joining our side, this defector worked at a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} facility on this planet. She claims she was responsible for extracting data from a device that sounds, from her descriptions, very much like a Star League era memory core. We don't know what data is on it, but {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} cannot be allowed to keep it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一名{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}叛逃者给了我们一条极其有趣且时效紧迫的情报，我们需要快速反应。在投向我们这边之前，这名叛逃者在这颗行星上的一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}设施工作。她声称自己负责从一个装置中提取数据，从她的描述看，那东西非常像星盟时代的记忆核心。我们不知道上面是什么数据，但不能让{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}留着它。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, this seems like a rough fight. We'll be the shield that blocks the head of the spear. If any support units do make a showing, only engage if you're in a good position after dealing with the 'Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这看起来是场硬仗。我们将是挡住矛尖的盾。如果真有支援单位露面，只在处理完机甲后处于有利位置时再交战。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A high tonnage {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance will shortly make planetfall, at the behest of a group of petty nobles and commercial interests. Intel suggests this is the vanguard of a larger force of conventional tanks and infantry, and they're scouting the region for a suitable landing site. We need a competent mercenary company to intercept the 'Mechs and stop the invasion before it gets underway. If their planet-side allies send any support, you are to wipe them out as well.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一支高吨位的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}分队即将降落，此事受一群小贵族与商业利益方的请求。情报显示这是一支更大规模常规坦克与步兵部队的前卫，他们正在该区域侦察合适的着陆场。我们需要一家称职的雇佣兵公司拦截这些机甲，在入侵展开之前将其阻止。如果他们的行星地表盟友派出任何支援，你也要把他们一并消灭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a straightforward battle, Commander. Finding a military lance in a backwater like this should be no challenge at all.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是场简单明了的战斗，指挥官. 在这样闭塞的地方要找到一支军事小队根本就算不上挑战.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our intelligence confirms a lance of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} military units is engaged in maneuvers on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, within a region we control. This is an aggressive action and {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} operations are at risk as long as this lance is allowed to move unimpeded. Hunt down the enemy lance and eliminate it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的情报证实，一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军事小队正在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}参加演习，就在我们的控制区内. 这是一次侵略性的行为，如果这支小队不受阻碍地行动，那{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的行动就会受到威胁. 追捕并消灭这支敌方小队.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A milk run, just as we expected. Good work, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一如我们所料，轻松一趟。干得好，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A primary target is damaged, Commander! Keep it up!

狩猎愉快，指挥官。奥利韦拉通话结束。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I don't know what went wrong, Commander, but we need to evac before we suffer any more losses.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我不知道哪里出了问题，指挥官，但我们得在承受更多损失之前撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: These guys are amateurs. Get eyes on them, take them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这帮人是业余的。锁定他们，干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've got them, Commander. Right out in the open.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们逮到他们了，指挥官。就在开阔地里。
清除雇佣兵

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Find, engage and destroy the enemy Mercs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 找到、交战并摧毁敌方雇佣兵。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I don't like fighting other mercenaries, but that's the nature of the business.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我不喜欢跟其他雇佣兵打，但这就是这行的性质。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're currently trying to engage in long-term operations in this system, which runs counter to {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} interests. They've hired a well-regarded mercenary outfit to engage {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} operatives on the planet's surface, and the mercenaries have sent a single, well-armed lance. We'd like you to counter that lance, by intercepting and destroying it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们目前正试图在这个星系进行长期行动，这与{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的利益相冲突。他们雇了一支口碑很好的雇佣兵部队，在行星地表与{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}的干员交战，而那些雇佣兵派出了一支装备精良的单一分队。我们希望你去反制那支分队，将其拦截并摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Keep them off balance. And be careful, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 让他们猝不及防. 还有小心，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're facing professionals, so we should expect well-armed and disciplined opposition.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们面对的是专业人士，所以应该预期装备精良、纪律严明的对手。
清剿行动

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If these guys are that hard to track down, they must be pretty competent. Expect a tough fight, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果这些家伙这么难追踪，那他们一定相当厉害. 预计会有场硬仗，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We believe that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has landed an elite lance on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. Its continued presence inside contested territory is unacceptable, and threatens to distract our own forces into trying to track it down and engage it. We need you to locate and eliminate this lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们确信{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}已经在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}空降了一支精英机甲小队. 该部队持续存在于争议领土的行为不可接受，并可能迫使我方分兵追踪与之交战. 我们需要你找到并消灭这支小队.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Let's keep our eyes peeled, commander. This feels like a trap.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们睁大眼睛，指挥官。这感觉像个陷阱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Well, that certainly could have gone better.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好吧，那本来肯定可以变得更好.
前沿观察员

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We don't have any intelligence about other possible enemy forces on the ground, Commander, so keep your eyes open.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们没有关于地面其他可能敌军的任何情报，所以睁大眼睛。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our scouts have observed {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} military units covertly surveying military and industrial targets. This increased activity from {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} near several priority facilities suggests a strike is coming soon. We're tasking you with intercepting the scout lance that's identifying targets, and eliminating it before it can report back.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的侦察兵发现{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军事单位正在暗中勘察军事与工业目标。{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}在若干优先设施附近的活动日益频繁，说明打击即将来临。我们派你去拦截那支正在标定目标的侦察分队，并在它回报之前将其消灭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sweep the area, find them, and clear them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 扫荡这一地区，找到他们，清除他们.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Well done, Commander. That should slow down {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} offensive.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 做得不错，指挥官. 这应该能减缓{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}的攻势.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've got solid intel that the enemy lance is in the region.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们有可靠情报显示敌方小队就在该区域。
转入地下

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An OPTIONAL primary objective to destroy the second enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选的主要目标：摧毁第二支敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're in the middle of nowhere, Commander, so that means no witnesses. Convenient.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们身处荒无人烟之地，指挥官，也就是说没有目击者。真方便。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we were tracking a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} Leopard DropShip through this region when we lost its signal. Orbital scans suggest the ship made landfall here on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, probably hoping to go to ground and hide the military lance it was carrying. It would be convenient if that lance were to disappear, and {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} analysts believe they've isolated the area the target lance is trying to hide in.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们一直在追踪一艘{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}豹式空投艇穿过这一区域，随后失去了它的信号。轨道扫描显示该舰在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}上着陆，大概是希望转入地下并藏起它运载的军用分队。如果那支分队消失会方便得多，而{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}分析师相信他们已经锁定目标分队试图藏身的区域。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a disaster. We need to cut our losses and get out of here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这真是一场灾难. 我们必须止损并离开这儿.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've got the enemy lance on radar, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷达上发现敌军分队，指挥官。
硬接触

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Buckle up, Commander. Two heavily-armed lances? This is going to be tough.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 做好准备，指挥官. 两支全副武装的小队? 这会有点艰难.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In violation of local treaties, a significant combat unit consisting of two lances of 'Mechs has dropped on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. Your task is to assault and dislodge the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force. You will send a definitive message: Unsanctioned military operations on {TGT_SYSTEM.name} will be eliminated with extreme prejudice. Leave none standing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 违反当地条约，一支由两支机甲分队组成的可观战斗单位已在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}降落。你的任务是突击并驱逐{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队。你要发出一个明确的信号：在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上未经批准的军事行动将被以极端手段清除。一个不留。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Take care moving forward, as we are expecting heavy resistance.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If they just set down, they may not be battle-ready; we might catch them with their metaphorical pants down.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果他们刚刚落地，就可能还没有做好战斗准备; 也许我们能打他们个措手不及.

They're heavily armed so expect strong resistance.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: They pick these empty worlds for conducting exercises in hopes of keeping it a secret. Too bad for them, I suppose.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们挑选这些空旷星球进行演习本想保密. 可惜运气不好.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have intel that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} is conducting military exercises on this backwater world. This is an opportunity to covertly advance {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} interests in the region. We need a deniable force to intercept their drills and provide them with some live-fire exercises instead. We believe there is a primary lance of 'Mechs and a supporting lance of vehicles.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们获得情报，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}正在这个穷乡僻壤进行军事演习。这是秘密推进{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}在该地区利益的机会。我们需要一支可否认的部队去拦截他们的演练，改为给他们提供一些实弹演习。我们相信有一支主力机甲分队和一支支援车辆分队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Move up, make contact, and wipe them out.

最后一台机甲

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Not much to say, Commander. Shoot to kill.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 没什么可说的，指挥官. 往死里打.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A lance of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} BattleMechs has been rampaging in {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} territory on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. They've been razing population centers, burning fields and refineries, looting storage facilities. They're clearly doing everything they can think of to drive our people out. This is terrorism, pure and simple. We need you to find them and destroy them - no escape, and no prisoners.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}战斗机甲小队一直在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}领地里肆虐。他们烧毁居民点、焚烧农田与炼油厂、劫掠仓储设施。他们显然在尽其所能把我们的人赶走。这是纯粹的恐怖主义。我们需要你找到并消灭他们——不许逃脱，不要俘虏。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is going to be a stand-up fight, Commander - your lance against the opposing force's.

逮捕令

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Seek out the brigands in their territory and stop their piratical ways.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在他们的领地中找出那些匪徒，制止他们的海盗行径。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we can expect to face experienced pilots in elderly 'Mechs and vehicles. But be careful; there could be more of these 'bandits' than {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} is letting on.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们可以预料到会面对驾驶老旧机甲与车辆的老练飞行员。但要小心；这些"匪徒"可能比{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}透露的更多。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} citizens here have been suffering at the hands of a local band of brigands - remnants from a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} battalion that saw action in the Third Succession War. With no prospects or funds, they've become common criminals. You are to eliminate them, down to the last 'Mech and vehicle.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这里的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}民众一直饱受一伙本地匪徒之苦——他们是曾在第三次继承战争中参战的一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}营的残部。由于毫无前途与资金，他们沦为了普通罪犯。你要消灭他们，直到最后一台机甲和车辆。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Good job, Commander. The people can get back to their lives again.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Remind these bandits what disciplined MechWarriors can do.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 提醒这些土匪纪律严明的机甲战士能做什么.
马奇诺防线

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've faced fixed emplacements many times commander, but in this case they might not be obviously clustered around a base. If they have good lines of fire it could get interesting, but nothing we can't handle.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们面对固定工事已经很多次了，但这次它们可能不会明显聚集在基地周围。如果它们拥有良好的射击线，情况可能会变得有意思，但也不是我们应付不了的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our scouts have observed {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} military engineers constructing fortified gun emplacements in a contested region. We'd like you to locate and destroy all the heavy weapons and bunkers from a specific section of their line. You are free to engage any enemy mobile forces in the AO, we will provide additional compensation at standard rates for any elements you destroy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我方侦察兵发现{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的军事工程师正在一处争夺中的区域构筑加固炮台。我们希望你去定位并摧毁其防线某一特定区段内的所有重型武器与掩体。你可以自由交战责任区内的任何敌军机动部队，你摧毁的任何单位我们都将按标准费率额外支付报酬。

扫荡

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A partial lance of damaged 'Mechs doesn't sound too bad, Commander. If we're able to bring them down mostly intact, this could mean excellent salvage opportunities.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一支残缺的受损机甲分队听起来不算太糟，指挥官。如果我们能让它们大体完好地倒下，这可能意味着极好的打捞机会。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: After a recent skirmish with our forces, the surviving units of a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance escaped the battlefield. We believe they've managed to partially repair their 'Mechs, and that means they're a loose end that {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} would like to see tied off, permanently. Track down these survivors and finish them for good.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在最近与我们部队的一次小规模交战后，一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}分队的幸存单位逃离了战场。我们相信他们已设法部分修复了他们的机甲，这意味着他们是一个{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}希望永久了结的尾巴。找出这些幸存者，彻底了结他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is the last known position of the enemy lance, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这里是敌方小队最后的已知位置，指挥官.
爱管闲事的邻居

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Enemy units are nosing around where they don't belong. Shut them down.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌方单位正在不该出现的地方探头探脑。让他们停机。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, this could be a wild goose chase. Of course, if there's nothing to find, they haven't wasted the time of their own 'Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这可能是一趟白跑。当然，如果什么都找不到，那他们就没浪费自家机甲的时间。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: For weeks now, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have been scouting territory near {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}-controlled land. Previous surveys of this land shows nothing of interest, yet there they are. Whatever it is that they've found, we don't want them to have it. Go in there and destroy them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 数周来，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队一直在{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}控制区附近的领地侦察。此前对这片土地的勘察显示那里毫无值得注意之处，可他们就在那儿。不管他们发现了什么，我们都不想让他们得到。进去把它们摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, you've arrived in the region where the enemy was last detected.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，你已抵达上次侦测到敌人的区域。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Excellent work, Commander. Though I do wonder what they were looking for...
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干得漂亮，指挥官. 但是我很想知道他们在那里寻找什么...

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Move forward and clear them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前进并清除他们.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a straightforward battle, Commander. Finding a military lance in a backwater like this should be no challenge at all.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是场简单明了的战斗，指挥官. 在这样闭塞的地方要找到一支军事小队根本就算不上挑战.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We believe there is a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance operating on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, within a region we control. All {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} operations are at risk as long as this lance is allowed to move unimpeded. Patrol the area, find the enemy lance, and eliminate it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们相信一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}小队正在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}星系，一个我们所控制的区域活动. 只要这支小队能够自由行动，那所有{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的行动就都会受到威胁. 巡逻这片地区，找出敌方小队，消灭它.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A milk run, just as we expected. Good work, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一如我们所料，轻松一趟。干得好，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A primary target is damaged, Commander! Keep it up!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个主要目标已受损，指挥官！继续保持！
狩猎愉快，指挥官。奥利韦拉通话结束。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: These guys are amateurs. Get eyes on them and take them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这些家伙都是些外行. 盯住并干掉他们.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've got them, Commander. Right out in the open.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们逮到他们了，指挥官。就在开阔地里。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An OPTIONAL primary objective to destroy the second enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选的主要目标：摧毁第二支敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I really like 'loud and fatal' as a job description, Commander. I may get it put on a plaque.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我真的很喜欢"响亮而致命"这个职位描述，指挥官。也许我该把它刻在牌子上。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're planning an operation and to pull it off, we need the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} authorities to be temporarily distracted. We need you to create that distraction. We'll point you at a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} patrol. You do something loud and fatal to them. Meanwhile, we execute our operation and give you a cut of the proceeds. Oh, and there may be reinforcements. That's good; that's one less lance to get in our way.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们正在筹划一次行动，而要成功，就需要让{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}当局暂时分心。我们需要你来制造这场干扰。我们会为你指明一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}巡逻队。你去给他们来点动静大又致命的东西。与此同时，我们执行自己的行动，并分你一杯羹。哦，对了，可能还会有增援。那正好；那就少一支小队来挡我们的路。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Oh, and remember there will likely be reinforcements, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哦，记住可能会有援军，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is the place. Time to start the party, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就是这个地方. 是时候开始派对了，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选的主要目标：摧毁第二支敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Intentionally provoking a patrol to get it to call for reinforcements. What does it say about our jobs that this isn't the craziest mission we've done?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 故意挑衅一支巡逻队让它呼叫增援。这份活不算我们干过最疯的任务，这说明我们的工作是什么样子？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have an operation planned to raid a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} logistical base, steal everything that isn't nailed down, and sell it on the black market. There's a missing element in the plan: you. We need you to draw off a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} patrol so that we can move into the base unopposed and load the goods. We figure that you hit the patrol, they call for reinforcements, and then you take those out as well. Then, we sell the stuff and split the take with you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们计划了一次行动，要突袭一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}后勤基地，把没钉死的东西全偷走，再在黑市上卖掉。计划里缺了一环：你。我们需要你去引开一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}巡逻队，好让我们不受阻碍地进入基地装载货物。我们的设想是：你打那支巡逻队，他们呼叫增援，然后你把增援也干掉。之后我们卖掉东西，跟你分成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An OPTIONAL primary objective to destroy the second enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选的主要目标：摧毁第二支敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Why the subterfuge? Why not just come out and say 'we want you to blow up a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance'? I don't understand pirates at all.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干嘛要这么遮遮掩掩？为什么不直接说"我们要你去炸掉一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}分队"？我完全搞不懂海盗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've been offering our good friends, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}, the opportunity to buy an insurance policy on their 'Mechs. I mean, they're big, complicated pieces of machinery, right? And hardly anyone knows how to fix them? So we're offering to insure them just in case something accidental happens to them. Would you believe they said 'no thanks'? It was a really good offer. We want to show them just how good. We'd like you to cause something accidental to happen to their 'Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们一直在给我们好朋友{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}机会，让他们为自己的机甲买份保险。我是说，机甲是又大又复杂的机械，对吧？而且几乎没人知道怎么修？所以我们提出为他们承保，以防他们的机甲发生什么意外。你信不信，他们说了“不用了谢谢”？那可是份非常好的报价。我们要让他们看看有多好。我们希望你去让他们的机甲发生点意外。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once you hit them, keep your eyes open for reinforcements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一旦你打了他们，就要睁大眼睛注意援军.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The target lance is somewhere in this vicinity, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目标小队应该就在附近的某个地方，指挥官.
傲慢和虚荣

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Invade the noble's territory, seek out her forces and eliminate them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 侵入那位贵族的领地，搜寻她的部队并将其消灭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, as soon as you make contact, expect any nearby enemy forces to close on your position.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，一旦与目标接触，附近的敌军很可能会立即朝你的位置靠拢.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A family associated with {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has been threatening military action against their {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} neighbors on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. Neither of us has any legal claim in this system, but as our allied nobles have requested help and protection, we're willing to intervene. We need a deniable force to step in and destroy the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} threat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个与{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}有关联的家族一直威胁要对他们在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}上的{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}邻居采取军事行动。我们双方在这个星系都没有任何合法主权，但既然我们的盟友贵族请求帮助与保护，我们愿意介入。我们需要一支可否认的部队介入并摧毁{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的威胁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Interdict the enemy dropship before the 'Mechs can reach the civilization centers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在机甲抵达文明中心之前拦截敌方空投舰。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} wouldn't send a dropship if they didn't mean business. So if we take this job, we should stay alert down there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} 若无意动手就不会派空投舰来。所以接下这活，我们在下面就得保持警觉。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have detected an inbound dropship belonging to {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}. Our local defense forces in the expected drop area are ill-equipped to handle a lance of 'Mechs, but with your aid we can ensure that the raid does minimal damage. We'd like you to intercept the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance and destroy it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们侦测到一艘属于 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} 的降落飞船正在接近。我们在预计降落区域的当地防御部队装备简陋，无力应对一支机甲小队，但在你们的协助下，我们可以确保这次突袭造成的破坏降到最低。我们希望你们拦截并消灭这支 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The enemy dropship landed somewhere in this area, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌方空投艇已经降落在了这一地区的某个地方，指挥官.
拦截空投

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Interdict the enemy dropship before the 'Mechs can reach the civilization centers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在机甲抵达文明中心之前拦截敌方空投舰。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} wouldn't send a dropship if they didn't mean business. So if we take this job, we should stay alert down there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} 若无意动手就不会派空投舰来。所以接下这活，我们在下面就得保持警觉。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have detected an inbound dropship belonging to {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}. Our local defense forces in the expected drop area are ill-equipped to handle a lance of 'Mechs, but with your aid we can ensure that the raid does minimal damage. We'd like you to intercept the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance and destroy it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们侦测到一艘属于 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} 的降落飞船正在接近。我们在预计降落区域的当地防御部队装备简陋，无力应对一支机甲小队，但在你们的协助下，我们可以确保这次突袭造成的破坏降到最低。我们希望你们拦截并消灭这支 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Acquire their location and engage them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 获取他们的位置并与之交火.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} raiders are going to run roughshod over the region.

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌方空投艇已经降落在了这一地区的某个地方，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Send a message to {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} that there are few worse things than being late on payments.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 给{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}带个话：比付款迟到更糟的事可不多。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, they also mentioned that the target vehicles are currently on deployment with a secondary lance of 'Mechs. You can optionally destroy them as well, and there's a bonus.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，他们还提到目标车辆目前正与另一支机甲分队一同部署。你可以选择把它们也一并摧毁，另有奖金。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} leader has fallen behind on payments for their armored vehicles, and our leasing agent has been unable to repossess the heavily armored vehicles. We've decided that sending a more explosive message is the best way to ensure that others do not take future liberties.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一位{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}领导人的装甲车辆付款已经拖欠，而我们的租赁代理一直无法收回这些重装甲车辆。我们认定，发送一个更具爆炸性的信号是确保其他人今后不敢放肆的最好方式。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The target vehicles have been detected in this area, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 侦测到目标车辆出现在这一地区，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You certainly sent them a message, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你可真是给了他们一个教训，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've only got time to load 600 tons, but we know the enemy force will be limited as well.

拒绝搜索

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An OPTIONAL primary objective to destroy the second enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 可选的主要目标：摧毁第二支敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary objective to destroy the enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标：摧毁敌方小队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One guy in a spacer bar says the wrong thing and every major power goes scrambling after LosTech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 太空酒吧的那家伙说错了，每个主要势力都在争先恐后地争夺失落科技.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A prospector with a loose tongue mentioned that he'd located a possible cache of Star League technology on this backwater planet. We've assembled an expert team along with a military force to protect them. They're prepared to investigate, but we've received word that {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} also learned of this cache, and dispatched their own lance to find and secure it. We'd like you to intercept this hostile lance and destroy it while the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} team conducts a thorough search.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一名口风不严的勘探者提到，他在这颗偏远星球上找到了一处可能的星际联盟技术储藏点。我们已组建一支专家团队与一支部队来保护他们。他们准备前去调查，但我们收到消息，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}也得知了这个储藏点，并派出了自己的小队前去寻找并控制它。我们希望你在{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}团队进行全面搜索时，拦截并摧毁这支敌方小队。

狩猎愉快，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Move up to this area and make contact, and then engage and destroy them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前进到这一地区进行接触，然后与之交战并消灭他们.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our employer's intel was accurate, Commander. We've spotted our targets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们雇主的情报准确，指挥官。我们已经发现目标。
肃清边境

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An OPTIONAL primary objective to destroy the second enemy lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个可选的次要目标：摧毁敌方第二支分队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A straightforward job, Commander. This kind of back and forth is typical on Periphery worlds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个简单明了的任务，指挥官. 这种反反复复的事情在外围星域太典型了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} surveillance teams have picked up what we believe to be the signature of an active patrol of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 'Mechs engaging in reconnaissance near the borders of our holdings on this planet. This is technically not a violation of our sovereignty but it's clearly provocative. We need you to send a message, by destroying the patrol 'Mechs. Should you encounter any other {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units, there will be a bonus for destroying those as well.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}监视小队捕捉到我们认为是一支现役{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}机甲巡逻队在本星球我方领地边界附近侦察的信号特征。严格来说这并未侵犯我们的主权，但明显是挑衅。我们要你传个信号：摧毁那支巡逻队。若你遇到任何其他{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}单位，摧毁它们也有奖金。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A primary target is damaged, Commander! Keep it up!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个主要目标已受损，指挥官！继续保持！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Just the way I like missions to go: simple, with a fat payday at the end.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这就是我喜欢的任务类型: 简单，完成后还有丰厚的报酬.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Orbital surveillance suggests our targets are in this region.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 轨道监视表明我们的目标就在这个区域.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is the border region our employers are worried about.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这就是我们雇主担心的边境地区.
搜索与消灭

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a straightforward battle, Commander. Finding a military lance in a backwater like this should be no challenge at all.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是场简单明了的战斗，指挥官. 在这样闭塞的地方要找到一支军事小队根本就算不上挑战.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our intelligence confirms there is a lance of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} military units operating on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, within a region we control. All {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} operations are at risk as long as this lance is allowed to move unimpeded. Hunt down the enemy lance and eliminate it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的情报证实，一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军事小队正在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}上我方控制的区域内活动. 只要这支小队可以不受阻碍地行动，那{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的所有行动都将面临风险. 追捕并消灭这支敌方小队.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy all enemy forces you encounter.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摧毁你遭遇的所有敌军。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: If they want to show military strength here in {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}, we can do that for them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果他们想在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}展示军事力量，我们可以替他们办到.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Within the last three months, {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has struck our facilities, personnel, and supply convoys over half a dozen times. My superiors in the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Government} leadership would like to even the score. We'd like to hire you to find a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance and destroy it, to demonstrate we are not without military resources on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在过去三个月里，{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} 对我们的设施、人员和补给车队发动了六次以上的袭击。我在 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Government} 领导层中的上级希望讨回这笔账。我们想雇佣你找到并摧毁一支 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队，以表明我们在 {TGT_SYSTEM.Name} 上并非没有军事力量。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This lance of 'Mechs needs to be put into a long-overdue retirement.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这队机甲早该退休了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we can't underestimate these old-timers, but fortunately we can expect poorly maintained 'Mechs. Finish them quickly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们不能低估这些老家伙，但幸运的是可以预料他们的机甲保养不佳。快点解决他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Many years ago, we fought a lengthy conflict with {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName} here in {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Recently, however, news has trickled in from a remote region of the planet: enemy forces harrying regional transportation. Eyewitness reports describe very old 'Mechs in colors from the conflict long since ended. You are to show these old MechWarriors that the war is over for them as well.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 许多年前，我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}这里与{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}打过一场漫长的仗。然而最近，从该行星偏远地区传来消息：敌军在袭扰地区运输。目击报告描述的是涂着那场早已结束的战争配色的非常老旧的机甲。你要让这些老机师明白，对他们而言战争也结束了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A primary target is damaged, Commander! Keep it up!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Be careful. These Mechs may be old and poorly maintained, but they can still kill you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 小心. 也许这些机甲又老又旧维护也差，但它们依然可以杀死你.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like we've found our targets, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来我们找到目标了，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Move forward and clear them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前进并清除他们.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Well, those old timers still know a few tricks. They live to fight another day.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 好吧，那些老家伙还是有些技巧的. 让他们活到来日再战.
补给线

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I don't believe that \"mission of mercy\" line for a second, but there isn't anything here to be concerned about.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我一点不信那句"仁慈任务"的说辞，不过这里也没什么好担心的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we're trying to safely transport injured personnel to one of our facilities on {TGT_SYSTEM.Name}. Unfortunately, satellite surveillance has shown {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units operating in the region we're expecting to move our medical convoy through. We need a mercenary lance to sweep the area and eliminate any {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units. Please think of this contract as a mission of mercy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们正设法把伤员安全运送到我们在{TGT_SYSTEM.Name}上的一处设施。不幸的是，卫星监视显示{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}单位正活动在我们预计医疗车队要通过的区域。我们需要一支雇佣兵分队清扫该区域，消灭任何{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}单位。请把这份合约当作一次仁慈任务。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units have been eliminated, and {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName} can start moving their people through the area.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 所有{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}单位都消灭了，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.ShortName}可以开始让他们的人通过这一地区了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fall back, Commander. This is over.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 退后，指挥官. 到此为止.
狩猎愉快，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Move forward until you make contact, and clear them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 前进直到你与敌人接触，然后消灭他们.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is the area where the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units were spotted.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这里就是发现{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}单位的地区.
愿者上钩

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm not comfortable with how little information we have about the enemy forces, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们对敌军的情报如此之少，这让我不安，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name} is tracking an extremely heavy 'Mech with {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} heraldry. This provocation is almost certainly bait for a trap; we'd like you to spring this trap. Engage the heavy 'Mech, intercept the forces {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} sends to defend it, and destroy all of them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Name}正在追踪一台带有{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}纹章的极重型机甲。这次挑衅几乎肯定是陷阱的诱饵，我们希望你去主动触发它。攻击那台重型机甲，拦截{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}派去保护它的部队，并将他们全部消灭。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们从地面特工那里收到多份报告，称有一台涂着{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}涂装的强力机甲。一台机甲孤身出现在荒无人烟之处，听着就像陷阱。我们的计划是将计就计，触发这个陷阱，看看谁会来查看。交火那台机甲，拦截{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name}派出保护它的部队，并把他们全部摧毁。

咄咄逼人的闯入

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This is a straightforward battle, Commander, and nothing we haven't handled before. Finding a military lance in a backwater like this should be no challenge at all.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是一场直截了当的战斗，指挥官，没有什么是我们没处理过的。在这种穷乡僻壤找到一支军用分队应该毫无难度。
Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Primary (Optional)
Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Secondary (Optional)

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our intelligence confirms a lance of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} military units is engaged in maneuvers on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}, within a region we control. This is an aggressive action and {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} operations are at risk as long as this lance is allowed to move unimpeded. Hunt down the enemy lance and eliminate it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的情报证实，一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}军事小队正在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}参加演习，就在我们的控制区内. 这是一次侵略性的行为，如果这支小队不受阻碍地行动，那{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的行动就会受到威胁. 追捕并消灭这支敌方小队.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance has dropped in Commander!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一支 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队空降了，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Glad we could make it to the party Commander. Our orders are to assist in the Primary Objective and once that's done head for Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很高兴能赶上这场派对，指挥官。我们的命令是协助完成主要目标，完成后前往撤离点。
狩猎愉快，指挥官。奥利韦拉通话结束。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！
战场上出现更多 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our Employer has kindly added this group to the contract. If we want to get paid we need to take them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主好心地把这伙人加进了合同。想拿到报酬就得干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Olivera. We will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's complete we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们将提供支援以完成主要目标。完成后我们奉命前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: These guys are amateurs. Get eyes on them, take them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这帮人是业余的。锁定他们，干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Unknown mercenary force, you are intruding on a joint {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} and {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} operation. Withdraw or you will be destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 不明佣兵部队，你正在闯入{TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym}和{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的联合作战区域. 即刻离开不然你会被消灭.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've got them, Commander. Right out in the open.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们逮到他们了，指挥官。就在开阔地里。
赏金猎人

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This seems really straightforward, Commander. I'm not too worried about 'extremely heavily armed'; I'm sure it's nothing we haven't dealt with before.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这看起来相当直接，指挥官。我不太担心所谓“装备极其精良”；我确信那不是我们没对付过的。
Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Primary (Optional)
Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Secondary (Optional)

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've finally tracked down the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} terrorists responsible for a deadly attack on one of our facilities. Unfortunately, even though there's only two of them, they're extremely heavily armed and very, very dangerous. That's why we're turning to you; we simply don't have the forces available to reach them before they strike again.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们终于追踪到了那些应对一次针对我方设施的致命袭击负责的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}恐怖分子。不幸的是，尽管他们只有两个人，却武装到牙齿、极其危险。这就是我们求助你的原因；我们实在没有可用兵力能在他们再次动手之前找到他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'll be on station keeping an eye on things, comm--
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我会留在阵位上盯着情况，通讯——

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Olivera. We will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's complete we have orders to proceed to our Evac.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Unknown lance: this is {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} command. We are in pursuit of dangerous criminals. Leave the area or you will be fired on.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 身份不明的小队: 这里是{TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym}指挥部. 我们正在追捕一群危险的罪犯. 离开这一地区，不然就朝你们开火了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: What the-- Darius, did we just get sold out?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这到底--达吕斯，我们刚刚是不是被出卖了?
泰坦之战

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Taking down assault 'Mechs isn't going to be easy, Commander, but if we can play them off against each other, we might make out quite well on this one.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 干掉突击机甲不容易，指挥官，但如果我们能让他们互相打起来，这票我们可能收获颇丰。
Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Primary (Optional)
Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Secondary (Optional)

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've got an interesting opportunity for you, Commander. We've recently detected a major engine signature on the planet, probably an assault-class 'Mech. We can't have an assault-class {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 'Mech that big wandering around loose, and we'd like you to handle it. The interesting part is that we've also detected another assault power-up, and it's a different 'Mech entirely, and it's closing with the target. It's possible you can just swoop in and pick up the pieces. We're prepared to offer generous salvage terms.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们有个有趣的机会给你。我们最近在星球上探测到一个大型引擎信号，可能是突击级机甲。我们不能让一台那么大的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}突击级机甲四处乱转，希望你来处理。有趣的是，我们还探测到另一个突击级动力启动，而且是完全不同的另一台机甲，正朝目标逼近。你有可能只需俯冲过去捡个现成。我们准备提供优厚的战利品条件。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一支 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队空降了，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Glad we could make it to the party Commander. Our orders are to assist in the Primary Objective and once that's done head for Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很高兴能赶上这场派对，指挥官。我们的命令是协助完成主要目标，完成后前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！
战场上出现更多 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Olivera. We will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's complete we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们将提供支援以完成主要目标。完成后我们奉命前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're near where the engine signature was detected, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们已接近探测到引擎信号的位置。
逐个击破

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Brutal, but undeniably effective. A cored 'Mech isn't going to end up repaired and back in battle against you. Sounds like a lot of fighting, though; be prepared.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 残酷，但无可否认有效。被击穿核心的机甲不会修好后再回来跟你打。不过这听起来要打很多仗；做好准备。
Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Primary (Optional)
Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Secondary (Optional)

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: After a recent engagement, {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces have captured a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} stronghold. This has left the bulk of the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces in the field, with nowhere to withdraw to. We'd like you to engage those forces and destroy them in detail. The goal is to break their ability to take the field against us for the forseeable future; that means none of their units should survive.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在最近一次交战后，{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}部队夺取了一处{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}据点。这使{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的大部分部队滞留在野外，无处可退。我们希望你去与那些部队交战并将其各个击破。目标是让它们在可预见的未来失去上阵的能力；这意味着它们的单位一个都不该存活。
玩家 1
玩家 2
消灭所有敌方单位

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance has dropped in Commander!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一支 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队空降了，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another hostile Leopard inbound, Commander. Marking its destination.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又有一艘豹式空投艇飞来了，指挥官. 我在标记它的目的地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Glad we could make it to the party Commander. Our orders are to assist in the Primary Objective and once that's done head for Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很高兴能赶上这场派对，指挥官。我们的命令是协助完成主要目标，完成后前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！
战场上出现更多 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our Employer has kindly added this group to the contract. If we want to get paid we need to take them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主好心地把这伙人加进了合同。想拿到报酬就得干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Spotted another {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance closing on your position, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 观测到另一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}小队正在接近你的位置，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Olivera. We will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's complete we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们将提供支援以完成主要目标。完成后我们奉命前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces retreated to this area, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队撤退到了这一地区，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: There they are! Commander, I have eyes on a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance headed your way.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 他们在那儿! 指挥官，我注意到有一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}小队向你的位置来了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We were warned there might be multiple enemy lances out here. Take them out, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们收到警告说那里也许会有多支敌方小队. 干掉他们，指挥官.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。
防守小队
注意 安德鲁

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces are not the only ones interested in this lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队并非唯一对该小队感兴趣的一方.
Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Primary (Optional)
Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Secondary (Optional)

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} has attacked our Employer's forces. They seem particularly interested in one specific lance. It may be a vendetta, or they may just be after certain technology. Whatever the case, we need to defend the lance at all costs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Name} 袭击了我们雇主的部队。他们似乎对某一支特定的小队格外感兴趣。这可能是宿怨，也可能他们只是在追寻某种技术。无论如何，我们都必须不惜一切代价守住这支小队。
玩家 1
玩家 2

消灭{TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym}突击小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Escort Ally Lance to Evac Point
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 护送友军小队前往撤离点

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Rendezvous with Bravo Lance and Clear the AO
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与Bravo小队会面并清理任务区
支援并保护友军小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: All our objectives are complete, cover our withdrawal Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们所有目标都已完成，掩护我们撤退，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander {COMMANDER.LastName}! Thank you for the assist today.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {COMMANDER.LastName}指挥官! 感谢你今天的协助.
指挥官，敌方单位正在投放.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, our {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} friends have deployed forces to assist in our operation here. This is the Primary version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们的 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 朋友已派出部队协助我们此处的行动。这是主要版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, our {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} friends have deployed forces to assist in our operation here. This is the Secondary version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们的 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 朋友已派出部队协助我们此处的行动。这是次要版本。
指挥官，我们正在着陆.
收到，小队长。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Copy that, we have eyes on the targets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 收到，我们已经发现目标.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Glad we could make it to the party, Commander. Our orders are to assist in the Primary Objective and once eliminated head for Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很高兴我们能赶上这场战斗，指挥官. 我们接到的命令是协助完成首要目标，一旦将其消灭便前往撤离点.
祝你好运，指挥官。
我讨厌派对.
收到一条来电.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like more enemies have dropped.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来又有敌人空投下来了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like we have some unexpected support from other forces. This is the Secondary version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来我们得到了来自其他部队的意料之外的支援. 这是次要版本.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: More {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces on the field. This is the Primary Objective Version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战场上出现更多 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队。这是主要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: More {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces on the field. This is the Secondary Objective Version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战场上出现更多 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队。这是次要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Move up and try to keep the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces engaged.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 向前推进，设法让{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队持续交战.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: No problem. She will be pleased that you made it through.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 没问题. 她会很高兴你成功撑过来的.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our Allies have been pinned down and it looks like they have become primary targets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的盟友被压制住了，看起来他们已经成为主要目标.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our Employer has kindly added destroying this group to our contract. If we want to get paid we need to take them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主好心地把这伙人的歼灭加进了我们的合同。想拿到报酬就得干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our Employer has kindly added destroying this group to the contract as a bonus. If we want to make some extra C-bills we can take them out if we want.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主好心地把这伙人的歼灭列为合同的附加奖励。想多赚点 C 币的话，我们可以顺手干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: PLACHEHOLDER (Additional Target Forces Primary). Inbound hostile DropShip detected, drop zone marked.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: PLACHEHOLDER (主要额外目标部队). 侦测到敌对空投艇正在接近，已标记空投区域.
收到盟友的消息.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Success! Our Employer will be happy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 成功! 我们的雇主会很高兴.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Oliveira. We're on station and will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's destroyed we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们已就位，将提供支援以完成主要目标。目标被摧毁后我们奉命前往撤离点。
{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 已被摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hostile to All {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} lance has arrived! This is the Secondary Version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 所有人的敌人，{TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym}小队来了! 这是次要版本.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: There are additional DropShips inbound. Hopefully we can keep them off of our allies.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 有更多的空投舰正在赶来. 希望我们能让它们远离我们的盟友.
这些家伙看起来不好对付.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Understood Lance Leader, glad to have you with us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 明白，小队队长，很高兴你加入我们。
小心增援部队.
我们就靠你了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them. Plan accordingly, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了。请据此安排，指挥官。

指挥官，敌方单位正在投放.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, our {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} friends have deployed forces to assist in our operation here. This is the Primary version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们的 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 朋友已派出部队协助我们此处的行动。这是主要版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, our {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} friends have deployed forces to assist in our operation here. This is the Secondary version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们的 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 朋友已派出部队协助我们此处的行动。这是次要版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Copy that, we have eyes on the targets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 收到，我们已经发现目标.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Glad we could make it to the party, Commander. Our orders are to assist in the Primary Objective and once eliminated head for Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很高兴我们能赶上这场战斗，指挥官. 我们接到的命令是协助完成首要目标，一旦将其消灭便前往撤离点.
祝你好运，指挥官。
我讨厌派对.
收到一条来电.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like more enemies have dropped.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来又有敌人空投下来了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Looks like we have some unexpected support from other forces. This is the Secondary version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 看来我们得到了来自其他部队的意料之外的支援. 这是次要版本.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: More {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces on the field. This is the Primary Objective Version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战场上出现更多 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队。这是主要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: More {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} forces on the field. This is the Secondary Objective Version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战场上出现更多 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队。这是次要目标版本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Move up and try to keep the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} forces engaged.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 向前推进，设法让{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队持续交战.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: No problem. She will be pleased that you made it through.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 没问题. 她会很高兴你成功撑过来的.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our Allies have been pinned down and it looks like they have become primary targets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的盟友被压制住了，看起来他们已经成为主要目标.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our Employer has kindly added destroying this group to our contract. If we want to get paid we need to take them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主好心地把这伙人的歼灭加进了我们的合同。想拿到报酬就得干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our Employer has kindly added destroying this group to the contract as a bonus. If we want to make some extra C-bills we can take them out if we want.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主好心地把这伙人的歼灭列为合同的附加奖励。想多赚点 C 币的话，我们可以顺手干掉他们。
收到盟友的消息.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Success! Our Employer will be happy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 成功! 我们的雇主会很高兴.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Oliveira. We're on station and will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's destroyed we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们已就位，将提供支援以完成主要目标。目标被摧毁后我们奉命前往撤离点。
{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 已被摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Hostile to All {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} lance has arrived! This is the Secondary Version.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 所有人的敌人，{TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym}小队来了! 这是次要版本.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: There are additional DropShips inbound. Hopefully we can keep them off of our allies.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 有更多的空投舰正在赶来. 希望我们能让它们远离我们的盟友.
这些家伙看起来不好对付.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Understood Lance Leader, glad to have you with us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 明白，小队队长，很高兴你加入我们。
小心增援部队.
我们就靠你了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them. Plan accordingly, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了。请据此安排，指挥官。
敌对领土

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The implication, of course, is that if we're not quick enough, we'll have multiple {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units up our exhaust vents.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 言下之意当然是：如果我们不够快，就会有多支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}单位贴到我们的排气口上。
Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Primary (Optional)
Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Secondary (Optional)

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've come across a target of opportunity that we'd like you to take advantage of. There's a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance conducting a long-range patrol, and it's isolated from its supporting forces. If you strike quickly, it should be possible to destroy the lance before {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} command can order reinforcements into the area.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们碰上了一处可乘之机的目标，希望你能加以利用。有一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}分队正在进行远程巡逻，且与支援部队脱节。若你迅速出击，应该有可能在{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}指挥部下令增援该地区之前将其摧毁。
玩家 1
玩家 2
消灭另外的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}小队
消灭主要的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}小队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance has dropped in Commander!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一支 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队空降了，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Glad we could make it to the party Commander. Our orders are to assist in the Primary Objective and once that's done head for Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很高兴能赶上这场派对，指挥官。我们的命令是协助完成主要目标，完成后前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！
战场上出现更多 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our Employer has kindly added this group to the contract. If we want to get paid we need to take them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主好心地把这伙人加进了合同。想拿到报酬就得干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Olivera. We will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's complete we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们将提供支援以完成主要目标。完成后我们奉命前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're in the engagement area, Commander. The clock is ticking, so let's move out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们已经进入交战区域，指挥官。时间在流逝，出发吧。
紧急追击

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I don't like the idea of jumping into a battle with this little preparation or intelligence, Commander. Be careful with this one.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我不喜欢在如此缺乏准备与情报的情况下投入战斗。这一仗小心点。
Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Primary (Optional)
Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Secondary (Optional)

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we've got a priority target for you. An elite {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance has just been spotted by our orbital surveillance, out in the open and without any local support. What's more, they've got significant damage from a previous battle. This is an opportunity for us to severely weaken opposition forces on this planet, but we have no forces in range to make the strike. We need you to engage and destroy this lance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们有一个优先目标给你。我们的轨道监视刚刚发现一支精锐的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}分队，他们暴露在开阔地带且没有本地支援。更重要的是，他们在先前一场战斗中受了重伤。这是我们严重削弱该行星上敌军的机会，但我们没有部队在射程内发动打击。我们需要你交战并摧毁这支分队。
玩家 1
玩家 2
消灭{TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym}赏金猎人
摧毁 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Unit One of your lance must survive
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你机甲小队的一号单位必须存活
你的整个小队必须存活

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一支 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队空降了，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Glad we could make it to the party Commander. Our orders are to assist in the Primary Objective and once that's done head for Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很高兴能赶上这场派对，指挥官。我们的命令是协助完成主要目标，完成后前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hit them hard and get the hell out of there, Commander. I have a bad feeling about this one.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 狠狠地反击他们同时离开这鬼地方，指挥官. 我对这个任务有不好的感觉.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I knew this whole setup was sketchy. Gonna have words with the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} rep about sending us in without complete intel.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我知道整个布置很粗略. 我会和{TEAM EMP.partyDef.Demonym}代表讨论在没有完整情报的情况下把我们送进去的问题.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I think we pissed them off, folks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我想我们惹毛他们了，伙计们.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Olivera. We will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's complete we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们将提供支援以完成主要目标。完成后我们奉命前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're going in blind, Commander—no time to prepare terrain intel. Meyer, can you see the target lance?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们要盲飞进去了，指挥官——没时间准备地形情报。迈耶，你能看到目标分队吗？
遭拦截的战利品

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've handled situations like this before, Commander, but I'd still advise caution. If they need a whole merc unit to take out one 'Mech, it must be a pretty serious 'Mech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们以前处理过这类情况，指挥官，但我仍建议谨慎。如果他们需要整整一支雇佣兵部队来对付一台机甲，那一定是台相当棘手的机甲。
Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Primary (Optional)
Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Secondary (Optional)

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our people took a beating in a recent engagement, Commander, and we lost an entire lance. One of our pilots was killed when their 'Mech fell over, and the last of the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} survivors was able to get our 'Mech back on its feet. Now they're hoping to get it safely to their dropship and claim it for their own. We need you to stop their salvage attempt, and bring that 'Mech down. It's still an active battlefield down there, so no telling what you'll encounter.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的人在最近一次交战中挨了痛打，指挥官，我们损失了一整支分队。我们一名飞行员在机甲倒地时身亡，而{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}幸存的最后一人把我们的机甲扶了起来。现在他们希望能把它安全送到他们的空投艇并据为己有。我们需要你阻止他们的打捞企图，并把那台机甲打下来。下面仍是活跃战场，所以你会遇到什么说不准。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Primary target down, Commander. Meyer, head for the pickup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 首要目标完了，指挥官. 梅耶尔，前去接应.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Olivera. We will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's complete we have orders to proceed to our Evac.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're looking for a single 'Mech out there, possibly already damaged.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们在外面找的是单台机甲，可能已经受损。
联合行动

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Opponents whose identities we don't know give me heartburn, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 身份不明的对手让我胃疼，指挥官。
Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Primary (Optional)
Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Secondary (Optional)

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're tracking {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} units engaged in a secret military exercise in a remote portion of the planet's surface. This is an ideal time to strike, as they're likely damaged and exhausted from the operation, and we believe they're unaware of our presence. It isn't clear who the other party in the exercises is, but whoever it is, they're a potential witness, so we need you to eliminate them as well.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们正追踪在行星表面偏远地区进行秘密军事演习的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队。这是发动打击的理想时机，因为他们很可能在演习中受损且疲惫，而且我们相信他们并未察觉我们的存在。目前不清楚演习的另一方是谁，但无论他们是谁，都是潜在的目击者，所以我们也需要你把他们一并消灭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You're approaching the target area, Commander. There's definitely been fighting in this region; lots of low-intensity laser scoring.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你正在接近目标区域，指挥官。这一带肯定打过仗；有大量低强度激光灼痕。
与个人无关

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I get worried when enemies make stupid choices like moving in the open. It makes me think we're about to have a trap sprung on us.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敌人做出像在开阔地移动这样的蠢选择时，我会担心。这让我觉得我们马上要踩进陷阱了。
Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Primary (Optional)
Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Secondary (Optional)

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a developing situation, Commander, and we need your help to resolve it. One of our minor signals outposts on the planet was attacked and destroyed recently by a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} force, and they're now moving in the open towards a supply depot that we cannot afford to lose. We'd like your team to set down and intercept them; they're very heavily armed, but they're making no real effort to conceal their movement. They should be a relatively simple target.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们出现了一个新情况，指挥官，我们需要你帮忙解决。我们在该行星上的一处次要信号前哨最近遭到{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}部队袭击并被摧毁，而他们此刻正公开向一处我们承受不起损失的补给库移动。我们希望你的队伍降落并拦截他们；他们武装极为沉重，但完全没有隐藏行踪的意图。他们应该是个相对简单的目标。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: So we know this is a trap, and we're walking into it anyway. Well, flying. Dropping. Whatever.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Uh, Commander? I've got eyes on a new lance in the AO. Looks like {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} markings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 呃，指挥官？我在作战区域内看到一支新的小队。看起来是 {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} 的标识。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。
展示存在

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: On one hand, that mech can probably take care of itself, given the kind of opposition we're likely to run into out here. On the other hand, any official who thinks personally patrolling is a good idea may not be the best pilot around.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一方面，考虑到我们在这边可能遇上的那些对手，那台机甲大概能照顾好自己。另一方面，任何认为亲自巡逻是好主意的官员，可能都不是最出色的飞行员。
Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Primary (Optional)
Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Secondary (Optional)

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A mid-level {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} official has decided to personally patrol a moderately dangerous region of the planet. We've done our best to dissuade her, but she's insistent that she show the people she's willing to take risks on their behalf. Rather than let her stumble around in her family's ancestral mech until some opportunistic pirate decides to murder her, we'd like for you to escort her and keep her alive.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一位中层{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}官员决定亲自巡逻该行星一处中度危险的区域。我们尽力劝阻过她，但她坚持要向民众展示她愿意为他们承担风险。与其让她坐着家族祖传的机甲到处晃悠、直到某个投机海盗决定杀了她，我们希望你护送她并保住她的命。
玩家 1
玩家 2

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy Enemy Lance and Keep Official Alive
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭敌方小队，并保证官员存活
确认，我将就位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance has dropped in Commander!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一支 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队空降了，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Glad we could make it to the party Commander. Our orders are to assist in the Primary Objective and once that's done head for Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很高兴能赶上这场派对，指挥官。我们的命令是协助完成主要目标，完成后前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hey! Can you even hear me? Is this thing on? How do I tell if my radio is working? Hello? Hello?!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 嘿! 你们能听到我吗? 这东西开着吗? 我要怎么知道我的无线电是不是还在工作? 喂? 喂?!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hey, uh, XO? I'm tracking an inbound blip. Coming in fast and low, like they're making a dropoff.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 嘿，呃，副官？我跟踪到一个入境的信号。又快又低地飞进来，像是要卸货。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I suspect this will be a waste of your time, Commander. I'm perfectly capable of taking care of myself.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我怀疑这会浪费你的时间，指挥官。我完全有能力照顾好自己。
随时向我们汇报，迈耶。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Not as much of a milk run as you were expecting?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 并不像你预期的那样轻松?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our Employer has kindly added this group to the contract. If we want to get paid we need to take them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主好心地把这伙人加进了合同。想拿到报酬就得干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Olivera. We will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's complete we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们将提供支援以完成主要目标。完成后我们奉命前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary targets are down, Commander. You can evac at any time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标已倒下，指挥官。你可以随时撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Uh, Commander? I've got eyes on a new lance in the AO. Looks like {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} markings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 呃，指挥官？我在作战区域内看到一支新的小队。看起来是 {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} 的标识。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It might make sense to hang back and see how badly they bloody each other before leaping into the fray.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在跳进去参战之前，不妨先观望一下他们之间厮杀的有多惨烈.

Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Secondary (Optional)

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we've been tracking a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance moving through a contested area on the planet's surface. A few hours ago, our scouts reported another lance, of unknown allegiance, on an interception course. We suspect a fight is brewing, and we'd like you to act as a spoiler. Eliminate the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance, and the unknown ambushers as well. We don't want to leave any witnesses.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们一直在追踪一支正在行星地表争夺区移动的{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}分队。几小时前，我们的侦察兵报告另一支隶属不明的分队正朝拦截航线移动。我们怀疑一场战斗正在酝酿，希望你去搅局。消灭那支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}分队，也消灭那些身份不明的伏击者。我们不想留下任何目击者。
