Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another successful mission in the bag, Commander. Let's debrief once you're back aboard.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一场成功任务入袋，指挥官。等你回到舰上我们再做简报。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Glad we could make it to the party Commander. Our orders are to assist in the Primary Objective and once that's done head for Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很高兴能赶上这场派对，指挥官。我们的命令是协助完成主要目标，完成后前往撤离点。
祝你好运，指挥官。奥利维拉通话结束。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Got a Leopard on radar, Commander. Looks like it's making a drop; I'll mark its LZ for you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 雷达上有一艘"豹"级，指挥官。看来它要投放部队，我会为你标出它的着陆区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm inbound to the LZ, Commander. Get your people over there for pickup.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我正前往着陆区，指挥官。让你的人过去等待接运。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'm seeing new heat signatures on the field, Commander. Our mystery tangos, I'm guessing?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我在战场上看到新的热信号，指挥官。我猜是我们的神秘目标？
战场上出现更多 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our primary target, the {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance, is in this area.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的首要目标，这支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}小队，就在这一地区.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's affirmative. The {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} rep has offered a bonus if we eliminate them, as well. Your call, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认。{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 代表提出，如果我们把他们也消灭掉会有额外奖励。你决定，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Olivera. We will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's complete we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们将提供支援以完成主要目标。完成后我们奉命前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's unfortunate. I'll let our employers know what happened.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 真不巧。我会把情况告知我们的雇主。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary targets are down. That's a wrap.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标已倒下。收工。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The unknown enemy force was last seen here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这里就是最后看到不明敌军的地方.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: You're approaching the interception point, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 你正在接近拦截点，指挥官。
二人组

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'd prefer to handle things ourselves, but if they want us to play babysitter, I suppose that's what we'll do.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我更愿意我们自己处理，但如果他们想让我们当保姆，我想我们就照办吧。

Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Secondary (Optional)

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We have a situation here and we'd like your help. We've detected a joint task force of {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} and {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} units operating openly on the planet. We need to hunt them down and turn them to scrap, but even if we do manage to find them, our own forces aren't up to the task of engaging that many enemies at once. We'd like you to send a lance to accompany our own team; the two of you can then engage the enemy together and negate their numerical advantage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们这里出了点状况，想请你帮忙。我们侦测到一支由{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}与{TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym}单位组成的联合特遣部队，正公然在行星上活动。我们要把他们找出来、打成废铁，但就算真能找到他们，我们自己的兵力也不足以一次对付那么多敌人。希望你能派一支小队随我们的队伍同行，这样你们就能联手迎敌，抵消他们的数量优势。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主好心地把这伙人加进了合同。想拿到报酬就得干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our new friends are away and safe.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的新朋友安全离开了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Olivera. We will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's complete we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们将提供支援以完成主要目标。完成后我们奉命前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Then you can lift off and collect your payment. Agamemnon out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 那你可以起飞并得到报酬了. 阿伽门农完毕.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。
试驾

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I'd say this is a terrible idea, but those Cataphracts are beasts. Just make sure it doesn't get killed, or we don't get paid.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我会说这是个糟糕的主意，但那些甲胄是猛兽。只要确保它别被打死，否则我们就拿不到钱。
Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Primary (Optional)
Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Secondary (Optional)

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've captured the latest pride and joy of the Capellan Confederation: a Cataphract CTF-IM. Our scientists have been reverse-engineering the monster, but now they say they need real battle data before they can continue. We'd like you to provide that data. We've located a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance to use as a guinea pig. Take the CTF-IM down to the planet and eliminate that lance. Needless to say, we don't have another of these, so it's imperative that you return it intact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们缴获了卡佩兰联邦最新的骄傲与喜悦：一台甲胄CTF-IM。我们的科学家一直在逆向工程这个怪物，但现在他们说需要真实的战斗数据才能继续。我们希望你来提供那些数据。我们已定位一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}分队用作试验品。把CTF-IM带到行星上，消灭那支分队。不用说，我们没有第二台，所以你必须把它完好地带回来。
玩家 1
玩家 2
“重装骑兵”必须存活
摧毁 {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroy Enemy Lance and Keep Cataphract Alive
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 消灭敌方小队，并保证“重装骑兵”活着
确认，我将就位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, that is the ugliest damn 'Mech I've ever seen. Built like a brick shithouse, though.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这是我见过最丑的机甲。不过结实得像砖砌的茅房。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Glad we could make it to the party Commander. Our orders are to assist in the Primary Objective and once that's done head for Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很高兴能赶上这场派对，指挥官。我们的命令是协助完成主要目标，完成后前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hey, uh, XO? I'm tracking an inbound blip. Coming in fast and low, like they're making a dropoff.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 嘿，呃，副官？我跟踪到一个入境的信号。又快又低地飞进来，像是要卸货。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I hope that was enough data for the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} scientists.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我希望这些资料足够 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 的科学家使用.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Keep us updated, Meyer. Commander, things might be about to get complicated.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 随时通报情况，梅耶尔. 指挥官，事情可能要变复杂了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our Employer has kindly added this group to the contract. If we want to get paid we need to take them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主好心地把这伙人加进了合同。想拿到报酬就得干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Olivera. We will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's complete we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们将提供支援以完成主要目标。完成后我们奉命前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary targets are down, Commander. You can evac at any time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标已倒下，指挥官。你可以随时撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Uh, Commander? I've got eyes on a new lance in the AO. Looks like {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} markings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 呃，指挥官？我在作战区域内看到一支新的小队。看起来是 {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} 的标识。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。
飞虎队

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With any luck we won't have to do much more than confirm kills, easy money, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 运气好的话我们只需确认击杀，轻松赚钱，指挥官。
Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Primary (Optional)
Dialogue_Interrupt_EnemyAllyAppears_Secondary (Optional)

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Due to logistical issues we have only a single heavy air asset to task with the destruction of an isolated enemy force. We'd like to hire you to fill out the unit and temporarily place our asset under your control. Arrangements like this have generally worked well for us in the past, however our liability department insists on a deposit of 50% of your negotiated compensation for the safe return of our aircraft. We realize that losses are the reality of combat, but unfortunately some commanders are less than careful with units not regularly attached to their company. I'm sure you can understand our position.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由于后勤方面的困难，我们只有一件重型空中资产可用于摧毁一支孤立的敌军部队。我们希望雇佣你们来补足编制，并暂时将我们的资产交由你们指挥。过去这类安排对我们来说总体都很顺利，不过我们的责任部门坚持要收取你们议定报酬的50%作为保证金，以确保我们的飞行器安全归还。我们明白损失是战斗的常态，但遗憾的是，有些指挥官对不常隶属其连队的单位并不那么爱惜。相信您能理解我们的立场。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A milk run, just as we expected. Good work, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一如我们所料，轻松一趟。干得好，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance has dropped in Commander!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一支 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队空降了，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance has dropped in Commander!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一支 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队空降了，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Glad we could make it to the party Commander. Our orders are to assist in the Primary Objective and once that's done head for Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很高兴能赶上这场派对，指挥官。我们的命令是协助完成主要目标，完成后前往撤离点。
狩猎愉快，指挥官。奥利韦拉通话结束。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ha! I told you monitoring {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} comms would pay off. That looks like walking salvage, lads.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哈! 我告诉过你监控{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}的通讯会有所回报. 那些看起来就像是行走的战利品，小伙子们.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I don't know what went wrong, Commander, but we need to evac before we suffer any more losses.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我不知道哪里出了问题，指挥官，但我们得在承受更多损失之前撤离。
战场上出现更多 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Olivera. We will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's complete we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们将提供支援以完成主要目标。完成后我们奉命前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: These guys are amateurs. Get eyes on them, take them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这帮人是业余的。锁定他们，干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Unknown mercenary force, you are intruding on a joint {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} and {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} operation. Withdraw or you will be destroyed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 不明佣兵部队，你正在闯入{TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym}和{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}的联合作战区域. 即刻离开不然你会被消灭.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've got them, Commander. Right out in the open.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们逮到他们了，指挥官。就在开阔地里。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We've captured a rare {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} mech. Our scientists have been reverse-engineering it, but now they say they need real battle data before they can continue. We'd like you to provide that data. We've located a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance to use as a guinea pig. Take the mech down to the planet and eliminate that lance. Needless to say, we don't have another of these, so it's imperative that you return it intact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们缴获了一台罕见的{TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym}机甲。我们的科学家一直在对它进行逆向工程，但现在他们说，需要真实的战斗数据才能继续。我们希望你能提供这些数据。我们已经找到一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}长矛小队充当小白鼠。把这台机甲带到行星上，消灭那支小队。不用说，这样的机甲我们只有一台，所以务必让它完好无损地回来。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance has dropped in Commander!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一支 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队空降了，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance has dropped in Commander!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一支 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队空降了，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, that is the ugliest damn 'Mech I've ever seen. Built like a brick shithouse, though.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，这是我见过最丑的机甲。不过结实得像砖砌的茅房。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Glad we could make it to the party Commander. Our orders are to assist in the Primary Objective and once that's done head for Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很高兴能赶上这场派对，指挥官。我们的命令是协助完成主要目标，完成后前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hey, uh, XO? I'm tracking an inbound blip. Coming in fast and low, like they're making a dropoff.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 嘿，呃，副官？我跟踪到一个入境的信号。又快又低地飞进来，像是要卸货。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I hope that was enough data for the {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} scientists.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我希望这些资料足够 {TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym} 的科学家使用.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Keep us updated, Meyer. Commander, things might be about to get complicated.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 随时通报情况，梅耶尔. 指挥官，事情可能要变复杂了.
战场上出现更多 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our Employer has kindly added this group to the contract. If we want to get paid we need to take them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主好心地把这伙人加进了合同。想拿到报酬就得干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Olivera. We will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's complete we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们将提供支援以完成主要目标。完成后我们奉命前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary targets are down, Commander. You can evac at any time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标已倒下，指挥官。你可以随时撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Uh, Commander? I've got eyes on a new lance in the AO. Looks like {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} markings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 呃，指挥官？我在作战区域内看到一支新的小队。看起来是 {TEAM_HOST.FactionDef.Demonym} 的标识。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。
试驾

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: It's entirely possible this is less of a real test and more of a lazy attempt at a false flag to sow mistrust between {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.ShortName} and {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}. But it pays either way.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这完全可能不是什么真正的考验，而只是某人偷懒想搞一场假旗行动，好在{TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.ShortName}和{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.ShortName}之间播下猜忌。但无论哪种，钱都照付。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sounds like they want us to bring the big guns, Commander. I'll let Yang know; he's going to want to watch.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we're planning a joint patrol operation with our allies in a dangerous region of the planet. We're expecting trouble, but these joint exercises are part of a larger diplomatic effort and it's critical that they succeed. We'd like you to provide some additional firepower to ensure that both our lance and our allied lance complete the patrol and evac intact. We're expecting major enemy resistance so plan for a heavy drop.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们正筹划与盟友在该行星一处危险区域进行联合巡逻行动。我们预计会遇到麻烦，但这些联合演习是更大外交努力的一部分，其成功至关重要。我们希望你提供一些额外火力，确保我方分队与盟军分队都能完整完成巡逻并撤离。我们预计会遭遇强烈抵抗，所以按重型投放来准备。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔戈号指挥官，这里是{TEAM_EMP.FactionDef.Demonym}小队长. 很高兴和你们一起.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Commander, we're looking at a complex, messy situation here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 指挥官，我们面对的局势复杂而混乱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Glad we could make it to the party Commander. Our orders are to assist in the Primary Objective and once that's done head for Evac.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Leaving the AO, Argo. Good working with you.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 正在离开作战区域，阿尔戈号. 很高兴与你共事.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our Employer has kindly added this group to the contract. If we want to get paid we need to take them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主好心地把这伙人加进了合同。想拿到报酬就得干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our primary objective is to assist in the destruction of a {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance, which we believe is in this area.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的首要目标是协助摧毁一支{TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym}小队，我们相信它就在这一地区.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Olivera. We will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's complete we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们将提供支援以完成主要目标。完成后我们奉命前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This one looks like a catastrophe waiting to happen, so keep your eyes peeled, Commander. Good luck.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这任务看起来像是一场灾难准备发生，所以请睁大眼睛，指挥官. 祝你好运.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We're trying to build a local defense force of MechWarriors here on {TGT_SYSTEM.name}. Our pilots are inexperienced and untested, and we'd like you to help us train them. We've picked up a troubling signal which may represent hostile activity, which seems like a good opportunity to send our new defense force out to handle it. Can you bring along an experienced MechWarrior and 'Mech to keep them out of trouble?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们正打算在{TGT_SYSTEM.name}组建一支由机甲战士组成的本地防御部队。我们的飞行员缺乏经验、未经实战考验，希望你能帮我们训练他们。我们捕捉到一个令人不安的信号，可能意味着敌对活动，这似乎是让新防御部队出动处理的好机会。你能否带上一名经验丰富的机甲战士和机甲同行，帮他们免遭不测？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The {TEAM_EMP_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance must reach the evac zone
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: {TEAM_EMP_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队必须抵达撤离区

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance has dropped in Commander!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一支 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队空降了，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} lance has dropped in Commander!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一支 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队空降了，指挥官！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Glad we could make it to the party Commander. Our orders are to assist in the Primary Objective and once that's done head for Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很高兴能赶上这场派对，指挥官。我们的命令是协助完成主要目标，完成后前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Heads up Commander, its a hostile {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} lance!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 注意，指挥官，是一支敌对的 {TEAM_TAR_ALLY.FactionDef.Demonym} 小队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Hey, uh, XO? I'm tracking an inbound blip. Coming in fast and low, like they're making a dropoff.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 嘿，呃，副官？我跟踪到一个入境的信号。又快又低地飞进来，像是要卸货。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I think I peed in my cockpit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我想我尿在驾驶舱里了.
随时向我们汇报，迈耶。
战场上出现更多 {TEAM_TAR.FactionDef.Demonym} 部队！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Oh gosh, I'm really excited about this. I hope we see some fighting!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 天哪，我真的很兴奋。希望我们能见到些打斗！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Our Employer has kindly added this group to the contract. If we want to get paid we need to take them out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们的雇主好心地把这伙人加进了合同。想拿到报酬就得干掉他们。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That went pretty well! I feel ready for the real thing!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 进展相当顺利! 我感到自己准备好来真的了!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: That's an affirmative, XO Olivera. We will provide support to achieve the primary objective. When it's complete we have orders to proceed to our Evac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 确认收到，奥利韦拉副官。我们将提供支援以完成主要目标。完成后我们奉命前往撤离点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primary targets are down, Commander. You can evac at any time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要目标已倒下，指挥官。你可以随时撤离。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Um, was that supposed to happen? What do we do now?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 嗯，那应该发生吗? 我们现在怎么办?

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Up to you if you want to engage the new targets, Commander. If not, Sumire will make the pickup at the evac LZ.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 要不要和新目标交战你来决定，指挥官. 如果不交战，苏米尔会在撤离用着陆区接应.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Wait, where are we going? I just figured out how to turn on my radio.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 等等，我们去哪儿? 我刚刚搞明白怎么打开我的无线电.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We kill the new guys, too! Just like in the holovids!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我们也杀了菜鸟! 就像全息影视里的一样!

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: We won't get paid for covering their evac if we leave before them, plan accordingly Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如果我们比他们先撤，掩护他们撤离的钱就拿不到了，请据此安排，指挥官。
训练日

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: I can only imagine what kind of junk-heaps these locals are going to be piloting. I'm expecting Urbies. Bring something tough, Commander.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 我只能想象这些本地人会开些什么样的废铁。我猜是垃圾佬。带点硬货来，指挥官。
